source: Translate this sentence from eng to ilo: USA Gymnastics supports an independent investigation that may shine light on how abuse of the proportion described so courageously by the survivors of Larry Nassar could have gone undetected for so long and embraces any necessary and appropriate changes.

source: Translate this sentence from eng to ilo: Ever since the Federal Government stepped in to take over funding of the Mersey hospital in Devonport, Tasmania, the state government and some federal MPs have criticised this act as a stunt in the prelude to the federal election to be called by November.

source: Translate this sentence from eng to ilo: But Prime Minister John Howard has said the act was only to safeguard the facilities of the hospital from being downgraded by the Tasmanian government, in giving an extra AUD$45 million.

source: Translate this sentence from eng to ilo: According to the latest bulletin, sea level readings indicated a tsunami was generated. There was some definite tsunami activity recorded near Pago Pago and Niue.

source: Translate this sentence from eng to ilo: No major damage or injuries have been reported in Tonga, but power was temporarily lost, which reportedly prevented Tongan authorities from receiving the tsunami warning issued by the PTWC.

source: Translate this sentence from eng to ilo: Fourteen schools in Hawaii located on or near coastlines were closed all of Wednesday despite the warnings being lifted.

source: Translate this sentence from eng to ilo: U.S. President George W. Bush welcomed the announcement.

source: Translate this sentence from eng to ilo: Bush spokesman Gordon Johndroe called North Korea's pledge "a major step towards the goal of achieving the verifiable denuclearization of the Korean peninsula."

source: Translate this sentence from eng to ilo: The tenth named storm of the Atlantic Hurricane season, Subtropical Storm Jerry, formed in the Atlantic Ocean today.

source: Translate this sentence from eng to ilo: Commons Administrator Adam Cuerden expressed his frustration over the deletions when he spoke to Wikinews last month.
target: Iti Administrador ti Commons a ni Adam Cuerden ket nangiebkas iti pannakaupayna kadagiti panangikkat idi nagsao isuna iti Wikinews idi naudi a bulan.

source: Translate this sentence from eng to ilo: The community irritation led to current efforts to draft a policy regarding sexual content for the site which hosts millions of openly-licensed media.

source: Translate this sentence from eng to ilo: The work done was mostly theoretical, but the program was written to simulate observations made of the Sagittarius galaxy.
target: Kaaduanna a pattapatta ti naaramid nga obra, ngem ti naisurat ti programa tapno matulad dagiti naiwayat nga obserbasion iti galaxy ti Sagittarius.

source: Translate this sentence from eng to ilo: The effect the team was looking for would be caused by tidal forces between the galaxy's dark matter and the Milky Way's dark matter.
target: Ti epekto a sapsapulen ti grupo ket ti makaigapu kadagiti puersa ti gravity iti nabaetan ti dark matter ti galaxy ken ti dark matter ti Milky Way.

source: Translate this sentence from eng to ilo: Just like the moon exerts a pull on the earth, causing tides, so does the Milky Way exert a force on the Sagittarius galaxy.

source: Translate this sentence from eng to ilo: The scientists were able to conclude that the dark matter affect other dark matter in the same way regular matter does.

source: Translate this sentence from eng to ilo: This theory says that most dark matter around a galaxy is located around a galaxy in a kind of halo, and is made of lots of small particles.

source: Translate this sentence from eng to ilo: Television reports show white smoke coming from the plant.
target: Impakita dagiti report iti telebision ti puraw nga asuk nga aggapu iti planta.

source: Translate this sentence from eng to ilo: According to Japan's nuclear agency, radioactive caesium and iodine has been identified at the plant.
target: Manipud ti nuklear nga ahensia ti Japan, dagiti radioactive casesium ken iodine ket nailasin idiay planta

source: Translate this sentence from eng to ilo: Authorities speculate that this indicates that containers holding uranium fuel at the site may have ruptured and are leaking.

source: Translate this sentence from eng to ilo: Dr. Tony Moll discovered the Extremely Drug Resistant Tuberculosis (XDR-TB) in the South African region KwaZulu-Natal.
target: Nadiskobre ni Dr. Tony Moll ti Extremely Drug Resisant Tuberculosis (XDR-TB) iti rehion a KwaZulu-Natal iti Abagatan nga Africa.

target: Ti maysa nga interbiu, kinunana a ti klasena ket “nakabutbuteng ken makapadanag gapu ti nakangatngato a bilang ti patayenna.”

target: Pampanunoten ni Dr. Moll a mabalin nga iti ospital ti nakaimpektaran ti dadduma a pasiente iti dayta a bacteria, ken kasta met ti napasamak iti dua ken ad-adu pay nga agtrabtrabaho iti ospital.

source: Translate this sentence from eng to ilo: In one year's time, an infected person may infect 10 to 15 close contacts.
target: Iti uneg ti maysa a tawen, ti addaan sakit na a tao ket makaalis ti 10 agingga 15 a sabali a tattao.

source: Translate this sentence from eng to ilo: However, the percentage of XDR-TB in the entire group of people with tuberculosis still seems to be low; 6,000 of the total 330,000 people infected at any particular moment in South Africa.

source: Translate this sentence from eng to ilo: The satellites, both of which weighed in excess of 1,000 pounds, and traveling at approximately 17,500 miles per hour, collided 491 miles above the Earth.

source: Translate this sentence from eng to ilo: Scientists say the explosion caused by the collision was massive.

target: Padpadasenda pay la nga ammuen no kasano kadakkel ti pannakadungpar ken no kasano a maapektaran ti Daga.

source: Translate this sentence from eng to ilo: She directed officers to her black Oldsmobile Intrigue which was 500 feet away.

source: Translate this sentence from eng to ilo: There, they found the body of Saroja Balasubramanian, 53, covered with blood-stained blankets.

source: Translate this sentence from eng to ilo: The first cases of the disease this season were reported in late July.
target: Dagiti immuna a kaso ti sakit iti daytoy a tiempo ket naipadamag idi arinunos ti Hulio.

target: Adda ti sakit kadagiti baboy, nga umakar kadagiti tao babaen dagiti lamok.

source: Translate this sentence from eng to ilo: The outbreak has prompted the Indian government to undertake such measures as deployment of pig catchers in seriously affected areas, distributing thousands of mosquito curtains and spraying pesticides.

source: Translate this sentence from eng to ilo: Several million vials of encephalitis vaccine have also been promised by the government, which will help prepare health agencies for next year.

source: Translate this sentence from eng to ilo: In 1956 Słania moved to Sweden, where three years later he began work for the Swedish Post Office and became their chief engraver.

source: Translate this sentence from eng to ilo: His work is of such recognized quality and detail that he is one of the very few "household names" among philatelists. Some specialize in collecting his work alone.

source: Translate this sentence from eng to ilo: His 1,000th stamp was the magnificent "Great Deeds by Swedish Kings" by David Klöcker Ehrenstrahl in 2000, which is listed in the Guinness Book of World Records.

source: Translate this sentence from eng to ilo: He was also engaged in engraving banknotes for many countries, recent examples of his work including the Prime Ministerial portraits on the front of the new Canadian $5 and $100 bills.

source: Translate this sentence from eng to ilo: The U.N. also hopes to finalize a fund to help countries affected by global warming to cope with the impacts.

source: Translate this sentence from eng to ilo: The money could go toward flood-proof houses, better water management, and crop diversification.

source: Translate this sentence from eng to ilo: Fluke wrote that the efforts by some to drown out women from speaking out about women’s health were unsuccessful.

source: Translate this sentence from eng to ilo: When the fighting ceased after the wounded were transported to the hospital, about 40 of the other remaining inmates stayed in the yard and refused to return to their cells.

target: Ti nagbaetan ti 10:00 ken 11:00 ti rabii (MDT), inrugi dagiti balud ti puor iti arubayan.

source: Translate this sentence from eng to ilo: Final results from Namibian presidential and parliamentary elections have indicated that the incumbent president, Hifikepunye Pohamba, has been reelected by a large margin.

source: Translate this sentence from eng to ilo: Coalition and Afghan troops moved into the area to secure the site and other coalition aircraft have been sent to assist.

source: Translate this sentence from eng to ilo: The games kicked off at 10:00am with great weather and apart from mid morning drizzle which quickly cleared up, it was a perfect day for 7's rugby.

source: Translate this sentence from eng to ilo: Infrared images show that the temperature variations from night and day show that they are likely caves.

source: Translate this sentence from eng to ilo: In France, voting has traditionally been a low-tech experience: voters isolate themselves in a booth, put a pre-printed sheet of paper indicating their candidate of choice into an envelope.

Nakalpas met a maikaduapulo-ket- uppat ni Jong Seork Park ti South Korea iti para lalaki a patugaw a panag-ski iti Super-G.

source: Translate this sentence from eng to ilo: His research showed that if a hormone was administered it would speed up the baby's foetal lung maturation.
target: Maipakita iti panagsisarakna a no ti hormone ket nailak-am daytoy ket mangpapartak ti panag-mature ti panaganges iti sikog nga ubing.

source: Translate this sentence from eng to ilo: Xinhua reported that government investigators recovered two 'black box' flight recorders on Wednesday.
target: Imbaga ni Xinhua a dagiti imbestigador iti gobierno ket nakaisubli iti dua a “nangisit a kabil” a recorder iti panagtayab idi Miyerkules.

source: Translate this sentence from eng to ilo: Fellow wrestlers also paid tribute to Luna.
target: Nangipaay met iti pammadayaw ken ni Luna dagiti padana a wrestler.

source: Translate this sentence from eng to ilo: Tommy Dreamer said "Luna was the first Queen of Extreme. My first manager. Luna passed away on the night of two moons. Pretty unique just like her. Strong woman."
target: Kuna ni Tommy Dreamer “ni Luna ti immuna a Reyna ti Extreme. Umuna a manedierko. Pimmusay ni Luna iti rabii ti dua a bulan. Sabsabali isuna. Napigsa a babai.”

source: Translate this sentence from eng to ilo: Dustin "Goldust" Runnels commented that "Luna was as freaky as me...maybe even more...love her and will miss her...hopefully she's in a better place."
target: Imbaga ni Dustin “Goldust” Runnels a “Ni Luna ket komidiante a kasla met laeng kaniak… baka nakarkaro pay… ay-ayatek isuna ken mailiwak kaniana… sapay koma ta adda isunan iti nasaysayaat a lugar.”

source: Translate this sentence from eng to ilo: Out of 1,400 people polled prior to the 2010 federal election, those who oppose Australia becoming a republic grew by 8 per cent since 2008.
target: Iti 1,400 a tattao a nagsaludsodan sakbay ti pederal nga eleksion iti 2010, immadu   iti 8 porsiento sipud 2008 dagiti mangkonkontra iti panagbalin ti Australia a kas republika.

source: Translate this sentence from eng to ilo: Caretaker Prime Minister Julia Gillard claimed during the campaign of the 2010 federal election that she believed Australia should become a republic at the end of Queen Elizabeth II's reign.
target: Imbaga ni Caretaker Prime Minister Julia Gillard idi kampania para iti pederal nga eleksion idi 2010 a mamati isuna a masapul nga agbalin ti Australia a republika inton malpas ti panagturay ni Reyna Elizabeth II.

source: Translate this sentence from eng to ilo: 34 per cent of those in the poll share this view, wanting Queen Elizabeth II to be Australia's last monarch.
target: Agpapada ti kapanunotan ti 34 a porsiento kadagiti adda iti poll, a mangayat a ni Reyna Elizabeth II ti agbalin a maudi a monarkia ti Australia.

source: Translate this sentence from eng to ilo: At the extremes of the poll, 29 per cent of those surveyed believe Australia should become a republic as soon as possible, while 31 per cent believe Australia should never become a republic.
target: Ti agsinnumbangir a maudi a panagbutos, 29 porsiento kadagiti nadamag ket mamati a masapul nga agbalin a republika ti Australia iti nadaras a panawen, ken 31 porsiento ti mamati a saan koma agbalin a republika iti Australia.

source: Translate this sentence from eng to ilo: The Olympic gold medalist was due to swim in the 100m and 200m freestyle and in three relays at the Commonwealth Games, but due to his complaints his fitness has been in doubt.
target: Ti nakaala iti balitok a medalia iti Olympics ket naglangoy iti 100m ken 200m a freestyle ken iti tallo a relay idiay Commonwealth Games, ngem gapu kadagiti reklamona ket napagduaduaanda ti salun-atna.

source: Translate this sentence from eng to ilo: He has been unable to take the drugs needed to overcome his pain as they are banned from the Games.
target: Saanna a nabalinan a natomar dagiti agas a masapulna tapno madaeranna ti ut-otna gapu ta maiparit dagitoy iti Games.

source: Translate this sentence from eng to ilo: Curtis Cooper, a mathematician and computer science professor at the University of Central Missouri, has discovered the largest known prime number to date on January 25.
target: Ni Curtis Cooper, maysa a matematiko ken propesor iti siensia ti kompiuter idiay University of Central Missouri, ket nakadiskubre iti kadakkelan a maamuan a prime a numero inggana ita nga aldaw idi January 25.

source: Translate this sentence from eng to ilo: Several people verified the discovery using different hardware and software by the beginning of February and it was announced on Tuesday.
target: Sumagmamano a tattao ti nangpaneknek iti pannakadiskobre babaen ti panangusar iti nadumaduma a hardware ken software iti rugi ti Pebrero ken naiwaragawag idi Martes.

source: Translate this sentence from eng to ilo: Comets may possibly have been a source of water delivery to the earth along with organic matter that can form proteins and support life.
target: Dagiti bandus ket mabalin nga isu ti puon ti panagpasngay ti danum ditoy lubong kadua dagiti organiko a banag a mabalin a bumukel ti protina ken mangsuporta iti biag.

source: Translate this sentence from eng to ilo: Scientists hope to understand how planets form, especially how the Earth formed, since comets collided with the Earth long ago.
target: Mangnamnama dagiti sientista a maawatanda no kasano a nabukel dagiti planeta, nangruna no kasano a nabukel ti Daga, gapu ta nakidinnungpar dagiti kometa iti Daga idi un-unana.

source: Translate this sentence from eng to ilo: Cuomo, 53, began his governorship earlier this year and signed a bill last month legalizing same-sex marriage.
target: Ni Cuomo, 53, inrugina ti panaggobernadorna idi nasapsapa itatta a tawen ken nagpirma ti maysa a bill idi naudi a bulan a mangpalegal iti panagasawa ti agpada a sekso.

source: Translate this sentence from eng to ilo: He referred to the rumors as "political chatter and silliness".
target: Inawaganna dagiti tsismis a “pagpapatangan a politikal ken inaangaw”.

source: Translate this sentence from eng to ilo: He is speculated to make a run for president in 2016.
target: Mapattapatta a tumaray isuna para presidente into no 2016.

source: Translate this sentence from eng to ilo: NextGen is a system the FAA claims would allow aircraft to fly shorter routes and save millions of gallons of fuel each year and cut carbon emissions.
target: Ti NextGen ket maysa a sistema nga ibaga ti FAA a mangipalubos kadagiti lugan iti ere a tumayab iti naasideg a ruta ken makatipid iti milyon a galon iti langis kada tawen ket makaputed iti panangiruar iti karbon.

source: Translate this sentence from eng to ilo: It uses satellite-based technology as opposed to older ground-radar-based technology to allow air traffic controllers to pinpoint aircraft with greater precision and give pilots more accurate information.
target: Mausar daytoy iti teknolohia a nakabase iti satellite kontra iti daan a teknolohia a nakabase iti radar ti daga tapno mapalubusan dagiti agkontrol iti trapiko idiay tangatang tapno matukoyda ti eksakto no ayan ti eroplano ken makaited kadagiti piloto iti husto nga impormasion.

source: Translate this sentence from eng to ilo: No extra transport is being put on and overground trains will not stop at Wembley, and car parking and park-and-ride facilities are unavailable at the ground.
target: Awan ti ekstra a pagluganan nga inkabilda ken ti ngato iti daga a tren ken saan nga agsardeng idiay Wembley, ken ti pagparadaan iti lugar ken para-ken-lugan a pasilidad ket saan a magun-odan idiay lugar.

source: Translate this sentence from eng to ilo: Fears of lack of transportation raised the possibility that the game would be forced to play behind closed doors without the team's supporters.
target: Dagiti panagdadanag maipapan iti kaawan ti pagluganan, nangigapu iti posibilidad a ti paay-ayam ket kapilitan a maaramid iti uneg nga awan dagiti tagasuporta dagiti team.

source: Translate this sentence from eng to ilo: A study published on Thursday in the journal Science reported on formation of a new bird species on the Ecuadorean Galápagos Islands.
target: Iti maysa a panagadal a naipablaak idi Huebes iti journal a Science, naireport ti pannakabukel ti maysa a baro nga species ti billit iti Isla ti Galapagos iti Ecuador.

source: Translate this sentence from eng to ilo: Researchers from Princeton University in the United States and Uppsala University in Sweden reported the new species evolved in just two generations, though this process had been believed to take much longer, due to breeding between an endemic Darwin finch, Geospiza fortes, and the immigrant cactus finch, Geospiza conirostris.
target: Impadamag dagiti manangsirarak manipud iti Princeton University ti Estados Unidos ken Unibersidad ti Uppsala iti Sweden a dagiti baro a klase ket nagbaliw iti dua a henerasion, ngem daytoy a proseso ket mapatpati a nabaybayag, gapu iti panangpaadu bayat dagiti endemiko a Darwin finch, Geospiza fortes, ken ti imigrante a cactus funch, Geospiza conirostris.

source: Translate this sentence from eng to ilo: Gold may be worked into all sorts of shapes. It can be rolled into tiny shapes.
target: Ti balitok ket mabalin a maubra iti nadumaduma a porma. Mabalin a pagbalinen a babassit a porma daytoy.

source: Translate this sentence from eng to ilo: It can be pulled into thin wire, which can be twisted and plaited. It can be hammered or rolled into sheets.
target: Mabalin a guyoden nga agbalin a naingpis a barut, a mabalin a tiritiren ken lagaen. Mabalin a taltalen wenno ilukot kas naiingpis a kasla ap-ap.

source: Translate this sentence from eng to ilo: It can be made very thin, and stuck onto other metal. It can be made so thin that it was sometimes used to decorate the hand-painted pictures in books called "illuminated manuscripts".
target: Mabalin nga aramiden a nakaing-ingpis, ken maidekket iti sabali a metal. Mabalin nga aramiden nga naingpis unay isu a no dadduma, mabalin a pangarkos kadagiti impinta-iti-ima a ladawan kadagiti libro a maawagan iti “maanninaw a manuskrito”.

source: Translate this sentence from eng to ilo: This is called a chemical's pH. You can make an indicator using red cabbage juice.
target: Isu daytoy ti makuna a pH iti kemikal. Mabalinka nga agaramid iti paggantingan nga usarem ti ubbog ti nalabaga a repolyo.

source: Translate this sentence from eng to ilo: The cabbage juice changes color depending on how acidic or basic (alkaline) the chemical is.
target: Ti ubbog ti repolyo ket agsabali iti kolorna depende no kasano kaadu ti asidona wenno basiko (alkalino) a kemikal nga adda.

source: Translate this sentence from eng to ilo: The pH level is indicated by the amount of Hydrogen (the H in pH) ions in the tested chemical.
target: Maammuan ti nibel ti pH babaen kaadu ti bilang dagiti ion ti Hydrogen (ti H iti pH) iti naamiris a kemikal.

source: Translate this sentence from eng to ilo: Hydrogen ions are protons that had their electrons stripped off them (since Hydrogen atoms consist of one proton and one electron).
target: Dagiti ion ti hydrogen ket dagiti proton a naawanan iti elektron (gapu ta buklen dagiti atomo ti hydrogen ti maysa a proton ken maysa nga elektron).

source: Translate this sentence from eng to ilo: Swirl the two dry powders together and then, with clean wet hands, squeeze them into a ball.
target: Patayyekem ti dua a namaga a pulbura nga agkadua ken, agusar iti nadalus a nabasa nga ima, pespesem isuda nga agporma iti bola.

source: Translate this sentence from eng to ilo: The moisture on your hands will react with the outer layers, which will feel funny and form a sort of shell.
target: Makilangen dayta nagbabasa dita imam kadagiti akinruar a katuon, a pakariknaan iti makaay-ayo ken mangaramid iti kasla shell.

source: Translate this sentence from eng to ilo: The cities of Harappa and Mohenjo-daro had a flush toilet in almost every house, attached to a sophisticated sewage system.
target: Addaan iti mai-flush a kasilias iti agarup amin a balbalay kadagiti siudad ti Harappa ken Mohenjo-daro , a nakakonektar iti napintas a sistema ti pagayusan ti rugit.

source: Translate this sentence from eng to ilo: Remains of sewage systems have been found in the houses of the Minoan cities of Crete and Santorini in Greece.
target: Nasarakan dagiti nabatbati a sistema ti pagrugitan iti balbalay kadagiti siudad a Minoan iti Crete ken Santorini idiay Gresia.

source: Translate this sentence from eng to ilo: There were also toilets in ancient Egypt, Persia and China. In Roman civilization, toilets were sometimes part of public bath houses where men and women were together in mixed company.
target: Adda met kasilyas idiay kadaanan nga Ehipto, Persia ken Tsina. Idiay sibilisasion iti Roma, no maminsan dagiti kasilyas ket parte ti balay a pagdidigusan iti publiko no sadino a dagiti lallaki ken babbai ket agkakadua iti nagtitipon a buyot.

source: Translate this sentence from eng to ilo: When you call someone who is thousands of miles away, you are using a satellite.
target: No tumawagka iti maysa a tao a rinibo a milia ti kaadayona, agus-usarka iti satellite.

source: Translate this sentence from eng to ilo: The satellite in space gets the call and then reflects it back down, almost instantly.
target: Ti sattelite iti law-ang ti mangala iti awagmo sa insigida nga ibatona met laeng iti daga.

source: Translate this sentence from eng to ilo: The satellite was sent into space by a rocket. Scientists use telescopes in space because the Earth’s atmosphere distorts some of our light and view.
target: Naipan ti satellite iti law-ang babaen ti maysa a rocket. Agus-usar dagiti sientista kadagiti teleskopio iti law-ang ta ti atmospera ti Daga ket tiritirenna ti dadduma a lawag ket buya.

source: Translate this sentence from eng to ilo: It takes a giant rocket over a 100 feet high to put a satellite or telescope in space.
target: Kasapulan ti higante a rocket a nasurok a 100 kadapan ti katayagna tapno makaipan iti satellite wenno teleskopio iti law-ang.

source: Translate this sentence from eng to ilo: The wheel has changed the world in incredible ways. The biggest thing that the wheel has done for us is given us much easier and faster transportation.
target: Ti pilid ket binaliwna ti lubong iti makaskasdaaw a wagas. Dagiti dadakkel a banag a naaramid ti pilid kadatayo ket inikkannatayo ti nalaka ken napartak a panangakar.

source: Translate this sentence from eng to ilo: It has brought us the train, the car, and many other transportation devices.
target: Gapu iti dayta, naadda dagiti tren, kotse, ken adu pay a klase ti pagluganan.

source: Translate this sentence from eng to ilo: Under them are more medium sized cats that eat medium sized prey ranging from rabbits to antelopes and deer.
target: Adu pay ti babbabassit a klase ti pusa ngem kadakuada a mangmangan iti babbabassit a klase ti ayup a kas iti kuneho, antelope, ken ugsa.

source: Translate this sentence from eng to ilo: Finally, there are many small cats (including loose pet cats) that eat the far more numerous small prey like insects, rodents, lizards, and birds.
target: Kamaudianna, adda adu a babassit a pusa (agraman dagiti bulos a taraken a pusa) a mangmangan iti adayo ken ad-adu a babassit nga animal a kas insekto, utot, alutiit, ken billit.

source: Translate this sentence from eng to ilo: The secret to their success is the concept of the niche, a special job each cat holds that keeps it from competing with others.
target: Ti sikreto ti panagballigida ket ti konsepto ti niche, maysa a espesial nga obra nga iggem dagiti pusa a saan a mangipalubos nga aglalabanda.

source: Translate this sentence from eng to ilo: Lions are the most social cats, living in large groups called prides.
target: Dagiti leon dagiti kasasayaatan ti pannakikaduana a pusa, agnanaedda iti sidong ti dadakkel a grupo a maawagan iti pride.

source: Translate this sentence from eng to ilo: Prides are made up of one to three related adult males, along with as many as thirty females and cubs.
target: Dagiti pride ket pakairamanan ti maysa agingga tallo nga agkakabagyan a lallaki, ken agingga tallo a pulo a babbai ken ubbing.

source: Translate this sentence from eng to ilo: The females are usually closely related to each other, being a large family of sisters and daughters.
target: Kaaduanna a dagiti babbai dagiti asideg nga agkakabagian, kas maysa a dakkel a pamilia dagiti agkakabsat a babbai ken annak a babbai.

source: Translate this sentence from eng to ilo: Lion prides act much like packs of wolves or dogs, animals surprisingly similar to lions (but not other big cats) in behavior, and also very deadly to their prey.
target: Agtignay dagiti grupo ti leon a kas met laeng kadagiti grupo dagiti lobo wenno dagiti aso, ay-ayup a makapasiddaw a kapada dagiti leon (ngem saan dagiti dadduma a dadakkel a pusa) iti galadda, ken napeggad pay unay para kadagiti biktimada.

source: Translate this sentence from eng to ilo: A well rounded athlete, the tiger can climb (though not well), swim, leap great distances and pull with five times the force of a strong human.
target: Nalaing nga agay-ayam, ti tigre ket makauli (ngem saan unay), makalangoy, makalagto iti adayo a distansia ken mangguyod ti maminlima a puersa ti napigsa a tao.

source: Translate this sentence from eng to ilo: The tiger is in the same group (Genus Panthera) as lions, leopards, and jaguars. These four cats are the only ones who can roar.
target: Ti tigre ket mairaman iti pada a grupo (Genus Panthera) kas iti leon, leopard ken jaguar. Dagitoy nga uppat a pusa laeng ti agdaranudor.

source: Translate this sentence from eng to ilo: The tiger's roar is not like the full-voiced roar of a lion, but more like a sentence of snarly, shouted words.
target: Ti ngernger ti tigre ket saan a kas iti buo a boses a panagngernger ti leon, ngem kasla a sentensia nga adda nauyong, maipukkaw a sarsaritana.

source: Translate this sentence from eng to ilo: Ocelots like to eat small animals. They will catch monkeys, snakes, rodents and birds if they can. Almost all of the animals that the ocelot hunts are far smaller than it is.
target: Magustuan dagiti ocelot ti mangan kadagiti babassit nga ayup. Agtiliwda kadagiti sunggo, uleg, bao ken billit no mabaelanda. Dandani amin nga ay-ayup a tiltiliwen ti ocelot ket basbassit nga amang ngem iti daytoy.

source: Translate this sentence from eng to ilo: Scientists think that ocelots follow and find animals to eat (prey) by smell, sniffing for where they've been on the ground.
target: Panunoten dagiti sientipiko a dagiti ocelot surutenda ken biruken dagiti animal a kanenda (prey) babaen ti angot, agsinglot iti no ayanna da iti daga.

source: Translate this sentence from eng to ilo: They can see very well in the dark with night vision, and move very stealthily, too. Ocelots hunt their prey by blending in with their surroundings then pouncing on their prey.
target: Makakitada a nalaing iti kasipngetan gapu iti pannakakitada iti rabii, ken makapaggunayda a sililimed. Aganup dagiti ocelot iti taraonda babaen ti panagtagilingedda iti aglawlawda sadanto seppegen ti biktimada.

source: Translate this sentence from eng to ilo: When a small group of living things (a small population) gets separated from the main population that they came from (like if they move over a mountain range or a river, or if they move to a new island so that they can't easily move back) they will often find themselves in a different environment than they were in before.
target: No ti bassit a grupo dagiti nabiag a parsua (bassit a populasion) ket maisina kadagiti nangruna a populasion a naggapuanda (kasla immakarda iti ballasiw ti kabanbantayan wenno karayan, wenno immakarda iti baro nga isla tapno saanda a nalaka a makasubli) masansan a masarakanda ti bagbagida iti naiduma nga aglawlaw ngem iti nagtalinaedanda idi.

source: Translate this sentence from eng to ilo: This new environment has different resources and different competitors, so the new population will need different features or adaptations to be a strong competitor than what they had needed before.
target: Addaan daytoy baro nga aglawlaw iti agsasabali a rekursos ken agduduma nga agsasalisal, isu a kasapulan ti baro a populasion dagiti nadumaduma a galad wenno pannakairuam tapno agbalin a napigpigsa a makisalisal ngem iti  ania dagiti kasapulanna idi.

source: Translate this sentence from eng to ilo: The original population hasn't changed at all, they still need the same adaptations as before.
target: Saan man laeng a nagbaliw ti orihinal a populasionna, masapulda latta pay dagiti isu met la a pannakairuam a kas idi.

source: Translate this sentence from eng to ilo: Over time, as the new population begins to adapt to their new environment, they start to look less and less like the other population.
target: Bayat ti panawen, iti rugi ti panagplastar ti populasion iti baro nga aglawlawna, nangrugida nga aglanga a sabsabali kadagiti dadduma a populasion.

source: Translate this sentence from eng to ilo: Eventually, after thousands or even millions of years, the two populations will look so different that they can't be called the same species.
target: Kamaudianna, malpas ti ribo wenno milion pay a tawen, iti dua a populasion on ket agbalinton a maiduma ti langada a madidanton agbalin a maibaga a agpada a sebbangan.

source: Translate this sentence from eng to ilo: We call this process speciation, which just means the formation of new species. Speciation is an unavoidable consequence and a very important part of evolution.
target: Awagantayo daytoy a proseso iti speciation, a ti kayatna a sawen ket ti pannakabukel ti baro nga species. Saan a maliklikan a resulta ti speciation ket maysa daytiy a napateg unay a paset ti ebolusion.

source: Translate this sentence from eng to ilo: Plants make oxygen which humans breathe, and they take in carbon-dioxide which humans exhale (that is, breathe out).
target: Agparnuay dagiti mula iti oxygen nga ang-angsen dagiti tao, ken agalada iti carbon dioxide nga iruar dagiti tao (dayta ket paruar a panangyanges).

source: Translate this sentence from eng to ilo: Plants make their food from the sun by photosynthesis. They also provide shade.
target: Agpartuat dagiti mula iti taraonda manipud iti init babaen iti photosynthesis. Mangipaayda pay iti linong.

source: Translate this sentence from eng to ilo: We make our houses from plants and make clothes from plants. Most foods that we eat are plants. Without plants, animals could not survive.
target: Aramidenmi dagiti balaymi manipud iti mulmula ken agaramidkami iti bado manipud iti mulmula. Kaaduanna a taraon a kankanenmi ket mulmula. No awan dagiti mula, saan nga agbiag dagiti ayup.

source: Translate this sentence from eng to ilo: Mosasaurus was the apex predator of its time, so it feared nothing, except other mosasaurs.
target: Ti Mosasaurus ti kangrunaan nga agkaan kadagiti babbabasit nga animal idi panawenna, isu nga awan iti kabutengna, malaksid kadagiti padana a Mosasaurus.

source: Translate this sentence from eng to ilo: Its long jaws were studded with more than 70 razor-sharp teeth, along with an extra set in the roof of its mouth, meaning that there was no escape for anything that crossed its path.
target: Ti atitiddog a sungona ket nabunobunan ti 70 a labahas-katademna a ngipngipen, kasta met ti ekstra a set idiay atep iti ngiwatna, kayatna sawen awan ti takasna iti aniaman a masabatna.

source: Translate this sentence from eng to ilo: We don't know for sure, but it may have had a forked tongue. Its diet included turtles, large fish, other mosasaurs, and it may even have been a cannibal.
target: Sigurado a saantayo nga ammo, ngem mabalin nga addaan daytoy ti nagsanga a dila. Mairaman Iti dietana dagiti pag-ong, dadakkel nga ikan, sabsabali pay a mosasaur, ken mabalin a kanibal pay daytoy.

source: Translate this sentence from eng to ilo: It also attacked anything that entered the water; even a giant dinosaur such as T. rex would be no match for it.
target: Darupenna met ti aniaman nga mapan iti danum; uray pay higante a dinosaur a kas iti T. rex ket awan gawayna a lumaban kenkuana.

source: Translate this sentence from eng to ilo: While most of their food would be familiar to us, Romans did have their share of strange or unusual feast items, including wild boar, peacock, snails, and a type of rodent called a dormouse
target: Bayat a kaadduan a makanda ket pamilyar kadakami, dagiti Romano ket adda ti makaskasdaaw wenno naidumduma a bambanag iti pista, kadwa dita ti atap a baboy, paboreal, birruruko, ken ti maysa a klase a utot nga awaganda a dormouse.

source: Translate this sentence from eng to ilo: Another difference was that while the poor people and the woman ate their food while sitting in chairs, the rich men liked to have banquets together where they would lounge on their sides while they ate their meals.
target: Ti maysa a kinadumana ket numan pay dagitoy pobre a tattao ken dayta babae ken kinnanna daydiay makanda agdama a nakatugaw iti tugawan, dagiti baknang a lallaki ket kayat da nga adda bangketeda a mabalin a sala a pagurayan idiay igid bayat a mangmanganda.

source: Translate this sentence from eng to ilo: Ancient Roman meals couldn't have included foods that came to Europe from America or from Asia in later centuries.
target: Ti makmakan ti kadaanan a Roma ket mabalin a saan a pakairamanan dagiti makan a napan iti Europa a naggapu iti Amerika wenno naggapu iti Asia idi naud-udi a siglo.

source: Translate this sentence from eng to ilo: For instance, they didn't have corn, nor tomatoes, nor potatoes, nor cocoa, and no ancient Roman ever tasted a turkey.
target: Kas pagarigan, awananda iti mais, wenno kamatis, wenno patatas, wenno cocoa, ken saan a pulos nakaramraman iti pabo dagiti nagkakauna a Romano.

source: Translate this sentence from eng to ilo: The Babylonians built each of their gods a primary temple that was considered the home of the god.
target: Inyaramidan dagiti Babilonio dagiti diosda iti templo nga ibagada a balay ti dios.

source: Translate this sentence from eng to ilo: People would bring sacrifices to the gods and the priests would try to attend to the needs of the gods through ceremonies and festivals.
target: Mangitugot dagiti tattao kadagiti isakripisioda kadagiti didiosen ket padasen met dagiti papadi a maited dagiti kasapulan dagiti didiosen babaen kadagiti seremonia ken piesta.

source: Translate this sentence from eng to ilo: Each temple had an open temple courtyard and then an inner sanctuary that only the priests could enter.
target: Kada templo ket addaan nakalukat nga arubayan sa maysa nga akin-uneg a santuario a dagiti laeng padi ti makaserrek.

source: Translate this sentence from eng to ilo: Sometimes special pyramid shaped towers, called ziggurats, were built to be a part of the temples.
target: No dadduma, dagiti tore a naporma a kas naidumduma a piramide, a maaw-awagan a ziggurat, ket maaramid a kas maysa a paset dagiti templo.

source: Translate this sentence from eng to ilo: The top of the tower was special sanctuary for the god.
target: Maysa a naisangayan a santuario a para iti dios ti tuktok ti tore .

source: Translate this sentence from eng to ilo: In the warm climate of the Middle East, the house was not so important.
target: Ti nabara a klima iti Tengnga a Daya, ti balay ket saan unay a nasisita.

source: Translate this sentence from eng to ilo: Most of the life of the Hebrew family happened in the open air.
target: Kaaduan iti panagbiag dagiti Hebreo a pamilia ket napasamak ti awanan linong.

source: Translate this sentence from eng to ilo: Women did the cooking in the yard; stores were just open counters looking into the street. Stone was used for building houses.
target: Dagiti babbai ket aglutluto iti sango balayda; dagiti paglakuan ket nakalukat laeng a lamisaan iti kalkalsada. Bato ti nausar a pangipatakder dagiti balbalay.

source: Translate this sentence from eng to ilo: There were no large forests in the land of Canaan, so wood was extremely expensive.
target: Awan ti dakkel a kasamekan iti daga ti Canaan, isu a ti kayo ket nakanginngina.

source: Translate this sentence from eng to ilo: Greenland was settled sparsely. In the Norse sagas they say that Erik the Red was exiled from Iceland for murder, and when travelling further west, found Greenland and named it Greenland.
target: Saan unay a napagnanaedan ti Greenland. Kadagiti sarsarita a Norse, kunada a nadestiero ni Erik the Red manipud iti Iceland gapu iti pammapatay, ket idi nagdaliasat a nagpalaud, nasarakanna ti Greenland ket ninagananna daytoy iti Greenland.

source: Translate this sentence from eng to ilo: But regardless of his discovery, Eskimo tribes were already living there at the time.
target: Uray awan ti pannakadiskubrena, dagiti tribo ti Eskimo ket agtaltalinaed idiayen idiay a kanito.

source: Translate this sentence from eng to ilo: Though each country was 'Scandinavian', there were many differences between the people, kings, customs and history of Denmark, Sweden, Norway and Iceland.
target: Uray no ti sagmamaysa a pagilian ket “Scandinavian”, adu a nagdudumaan dagiti tattao, ar-ari, kaugalian ken pakasaritaan iti Denmark, Sweden, Norway ken Iceland.

source: Translate this sentence from eng to ilo: If you have watched the movie National Treasure, you may think a treasure map was written on the back of the Declaration of Independence.
target: No nabuyam ti pelikula a National Treasure, mabalin nga ipapanmo nga adda mapa ti gameng a naisurat iti likudan ti Deklarasion ti Independensia.

source: Translate this sentence from eng to ilo: However, that is not true. Although there is something written on the back of the document, it is not a treasure map.
target: Ngem saan nga agpayso dayta. Uray no adda nakasurat idiay likod ti dokumento, saan daytoy a mapa para iti gamgameng.

source: Translate this sentence from eng to ilo: Written on the back of the Declaration of Independence were the words "Original Declaration of Independence dated 4th July 1776". The text appears on the bottom of the document, upside down.
target: Nakasurat idiay likod ti Deklarasion ti Pannakawaya ket dagiti sao a “Orihinal a Deklarasion ti Pannakawaya nga addaan petsa mika-4 iti Hulio 1776”. Iti surat ket agparang idiay baba ti dokumento, nakabaliktad.

source: Translate this sentence from eng to ilo: While no one knows for certain who wrote it, it is known that early in its life, the large parchment document (it measures 29¾ inches by 24½ inches) was rolled up for storage.
target: Awan ti agpayso a makaammo no asino ti nangisurat kadagitoy, naammuan nga idi rugrugi ti biagna, ti dakkel a pergamino a dokumento (agrukod iti 29 ¾ a pulgada ken 24½ a pulgada) a nalukot tapno maidulin.

source: Translate this sentence from eng to ilo: So, it is likely that the notation was added simply as a label.
target: Ngarud, mabalin nga innayonda ti notasion a simple a kas laeng iti etiketa.

source: Translate this sentence from eng to ilo: The D-Day landings and the following battles had freed the north of France, but the south still wasn't free.
target: Dagiti panagsanglad ti D-Day ken dagiti simmaruno a laban, winayawayaanda ti amianan ti Pransia, ngem saan pay laeng a nawaya ti abagatan.

source: Translate this sentence from eng to ilo: It was ruled by the "Vichy" French. These were French people who had made peace with the Germans in 1940 and worked with the invaders instead of fighting them.
target: Pinarmek ti Pranses a “Vichy”. Dagitoy ket tattao a Pranses a nakikappia kadagiti German idi 1940 ken nagobra kakadua ti nangparmek imbes a labananda.

source: Translate this sentence from eng to ilo: On 15 August 1940, the Allies invaded southern France, the invasion was called "Operation Dragoon".
target: Idi maika-15 ti Agosto 1940, dagiti kaaliado nirautda ti abagatan a Pransia, ti panangraut ket naawagan a “Operation Dragoon”.

source: Translate this sentence from eng to ilo: In just two weeks the Americans and Free French forces had liberated southern France and were turning towards Germany.
target: Iti uneg ti dua a lawas laeng, pinaruk-atan dagiti Amerikano ken dagiiti puersa ti Free French ti abagatan ti France ket agturongdan iti Germany.

source: Translate this sentence from eng to ilo: A civilization is a singular culture shared by a significant large group of people who live and work co-operatively, a society.
target: Ti sibilisasion ket maysa a kultura a pinagraraman ti nangruna a grupo ti tattao nga agbibiag ken agtitinnulong nga agobra, maysa a kagimongan.

source: Translate this sentence from eng to ilo: The word civilization comes from the Latin civilis, meaning civil, related to the Latin civis, meaning citizen, and civitas, meaning city or city-state, and that also somehow defines the size of the society.
target: Ti balikas a sibilisasion ket manipud iti Latin a civilis, a kayatna a sawen ket civil, nainaig iti Latin a civis, a kayatna a sawen ket umili, ken civitas, a kayatna a sawen ket siudad wenno siudad-estado, ken isu pay dayta ti mangted kaipapanan iti kadakkel ti kagimongan.

source: Translate this sentence from eng to ilo: City-states are the precursors of nations. A civilizational culture implies the passing on of knowledge across several generations, a lingering cultural footprint and fair dissemination.
target: Dagiti siudad-estado dagiti immuna a nabangon a nagbalin a pagpagilian. Ti kultura ti sibilisasion ti mangipaspasaimudaag iti pannakaipasa ti pannakammo kadagiti sumagmamano a henerasion, maysa nga agtaltalinaed a tugot ti kultura ken patas a pannakaiwaras.

source: Translate this sentence from eng to ilo: Minor cultures often vanish without leaving relevant historic evidence and fail to be recognized as proper civilizations.
target: Masansan a mapukaw dagiti minoria a kultura nga awan mabatida a napateg a napnuan pakasaritaan nga ebidensia ket saan ida a mabigbig a kas naan-anay a sibilisasion.

source: Translate this sentence from eng to ilo: During the Revolutionary War, the thirteen states first formed a weak central government—with the Congress being its only component—under the Articles of Confederation.
target: Kabayatan ti Rebolusionario a Gubat, nangbukel dagiti sangapulo-ket-tallo nga estado iti nakapsut a sentral a gobierno—Kongreso laeng ti adda a pasetna—iti babaen ti Artikulo ti Konpederasion.

source: Translate this sentence from eng to ilo: Congress lacked any power to impose taxes, and, because there was no national executive or judiciary, it relied on state authorities, who were often uncooperative, to enforce all its acts.
target: Agkurang ti turay ti Kongreso a mangipataw ti buwis, ken, gapuna nga awan ti nasional nga ehekutibo wenno pangukuman, agpannurayda kadagiti autoridad iti gobierno, a masansan a saan mannakitulong, nga ipatungpal amin a lintegna.

source: Translate this sentence from eng to ilo: It also had no authority to override tax laws and tariffs between states.
target: Awan met ti turayna a mangbaliw kadagiti linteg ti buis ken taripa iti nagbaetan dagiti estado.

source: Translate this sentence from eng to ilo: The Articles required unanimous consent from all the states before they could be amended and states took the central government so lightly that their representatives were often absent.
target: Kasapulan dagiti Artikulo ti napagkaykaysaan ti amin a pammalubos manipud kadagiti amin nga estado sakbay a mabaliwan dagitoy ket saan nga inkankano unay dagiti estado ti central a gobierno isu a masansan nga awan dagiti pannakabagida.

source: Translate this sentence from eng to ilo: Italy's national football, along with German national football team is the second most successful team in the world and were the FIFA World Cup champions in 2006.
target: Ti nailian a grupo ti football ti Italy, kasta met ti nailian a grupo ti football ti Germany, ti maikadua a kababalligian a grupo iti sangalubongan ket isuda dagiti kampeon iti FIFA World Cup idi 2006.

source: Translate this sentence from eng to ilo: Popular sports include football, basketball, volleyball, water-polo, fencing, rugby, cycling, ice hockey, roller hockey and F1 motor racing.
target: Mairaman kadagiti nalatak nga isports iti football, basketball, volleyball, water-polo, fencing, rugby, cycling, ice hockey, roller hockey ken lumba ti motor ti F1.

source: Translate this sentence from eng to ilo: Winter sports are most popular in the Northern regions, with Italians competing in international games and Olympic events.
target: Kalalatakan dagiti isport a pang-winter kadagiti Umamianan a rehion, ket dagiti Italiano ti makisalsalisal kadagiti internasional a paay-ayam ken kadagiti pang-Olympics a paspasamak.

source: Translate this sentence from eng to ilo: Japans holds nearly 7,000 islands (the biggest being Honshu), making Japan the 7th largest island in the world!
target: Addaan ti Japan ti dandani 7,000 nga isla (ti kadakkelan ket Honshu), a namagbalin iti Japan a maika-7 a kadadakkelan nga isla iti lubong!

source: Translate this sentence from eng to ilo: Due to the cluster/group of islands Japan has, Japan is often referred to, on a geographical stance, as an "archipelago"
target: Gapu ta agga-abay/nangrupo-grupo dagiti isla iti Japan, masansan a  matukoy ti geograpia ti Japan kas maysa nga "arkipelago."

source: Translate this sentence from eng to ilo: Taiwan beginning start way back in 15th century where European sailors passing by record the island’s name as Ilha Formosa, or beautiful island.
target: Nangrugi ti Taiwan sipud idi maika-15 a siglo no sadino a ti isla ket pinanaganan dagiti limmabas a tao iti baybay a naggapu iti Europa nga Ilha Formosa, wenno napintas nga isla.

source: Translate this sentence from eng to ilo: In 1624,Dutch East India Company establishes a base in southwestern Taiwan, initiating a transformation in aboriginal grain production practices and employing Chinese laborers to work on its rice and sugar plantations.
target: Idi 1624, nagpatakder ti Dutch East India Company ti base idiay abagatan-laud a Taiwan, a pinaunaanna ti panagbalbaliw kadagiti panagaramid ti aborihinal a bukbukel ken mangtangdan kadagiti trabahador a Tsino tapno agtrabaho para iti plantasion ti bagas ken asukar.

source: Translate this sentence from eng to ilo: In 1683, Qing dynasty (1644-1912) forces take control of Taiwan’s western and northern coastal areas and declared Taiwan as a province of the Qing Empire in 1885.
target: Idi 1683, sinakup dagiti puersa ti dinastia ti Qing (1644-1912)  dagiti lumaud ken umamianan nga ig-igid ti baybay ti Taiwan ket indelarada ti Taiwan a kas probinsia ti Imperio ti Qing idi 1885.

source: Translate this sentence from eng to ilo: In 1895, after defeat in the First Sino-Japanese War (1894-1895), the Qing government signs the Treaty of Shimonoseki, by which it cedes sovereignty over Taiwan to Japan, which rules the island until 1945.
target: Idi 1895, kalpasan ti pannakaabak iti Umuna a Gubat a Sino-Japanese (1894-1895), pinirmaan ti gobierno ti Qing ti Katulagan ti Shimonoseki, a nangisuko iti soberania ti Taiwan iti Japan, a nangituray iti isla agingga iti 1945.

source: Translate this sentence from eng to ilo: Machu Picchu consist of three main structures, namely Intihuatana, the Temple of the Sun, and the Room of the Three Windows.
target: Nilaon ti Machu Picchu ti tallo a nangruna nga istruktura, agnagan ti Intihuatana, iti Templo ti Init, ken iti Kuarto ti Tallo a Tawa.

source: Translate this sentence from eng to ilo: Most of the buildings on the edges of the complex have been rebuilt in order to give tourists a better idea of how they originally appeared.
target: Kaaduan kadagiti pasdek kadagiti igid ti complex ti nabaliwan a naaramid tapno maikkan dagiti turista iti napimpintas nga idea no kasano ti dati a langa dagitoy.

source: Translate this sentence from eng to ilo: By 1976, thirty percent of Machu Picchu had been restored and restoration continues till today.
target: Dumteng ti 1976, tallo a pulo a porsiento ti Machu Pichu ket naisublin ken madama pay laeng ti panangisubli agingga itatta.

source: Translate this sentence from eng to ilo: For example, the most common still image photography format in the world is 35mm, which was the dominant film size at the close of the analog film era.
target: Kas pagarigan, ti gagangay a porma ti film ti retrato iti intero a lubong ket 35mm, nga isu dayta ti kaaduanna a maus-usar a rukod ti film sakbay a nagpatingga ti panawen ti analog a film.

source: Translate this sentence from eng to ilo: It is still produced today, but more importantly its aspect ratio has been inherited by digital camera image sensor formats.
target: Maparpartuat pay laeng agingga ita, ngem ti kangrunaanna, ti aspect ratio ket natawid dagiti pormat ti image sensor ti kamera a digital.

source: Translate this sentence from eng to ilo: The 35mm format is actually, somewhat confusingly, 36mm in width by 24mm in height.
target: Kinapudnona, ti 35mm a pormat ket maka-allilaw, 36mm ti kinaakabana ken 24mm ti kangatona.

source: Translate this sentence from eng to ilo: The aspect ratio of this format (dividing by twelve to obtain the simplest whole-number ratio) is therefore said to be 3:2.
target: Ti ratio daytoy a porma (ti tunggal rukod ket i-divide iti 12 tapno maala ti kabassitan a buo a numero) ket maibaga a 3:2.

source: Translate this sentence from eng to ilo: Many common formats (APS family of formats, for example) are equal to or closely approximate this aspect ratio.
target: Adu a gagangay a format (pamilia ti format nga APS, kas pagarigan) ket maipada wenno asideg a mainaig iti daytoy nga aspect ratio.

source: Translate this sentence from eng to ilo: The much-abused and often-ridiculed rule of thirds is a simple guideline creating dynamism while keeping a measure of order in an image.
target: Ti kanayon a maabuso  ken masansan a maumsi nga annuroten dagiti maikatlo ket maysa a simple a giya iti pannakaparnuay ti dinamismo kabayatan a pagtaltalinaedenna ti panangrukod iti kinaurnos ti maysa nga imahen.

source: Translate this sentence from eng to ilo: It states that the most effective place for the main subject is at the intersection of lines dividing the image into thirds vertically and horizontally (see example).
target: Ibaga daytoy a ti pinakaepektibo a lugar para iti kangrunaan a banag ket idiay pagsabatan ti linya a mangguddua iti litrato ti tallo a patakder ken paidda (kitan ti ehemplo).

source: Translate this sentence from eng to ilo: During this period of European history, the Catholic Church, which had become rich and powerful, came under scrutiny.
target: Idi datoy a panawen iti napalabas iti Europeo, iti Simbaan Katoliko, a nagbalinen a nabaknang ken managturay, ket naipasirok iti panangsukimat.

source: Translate this sentence from eng to ilo: For over a thousand years the Christian religion had bound European states together despite differences in language and customs. I
target: Iti nasurok a sangaribu a tawen ti relihion a Kristiyano ket napagmaymaysa dagiti estado ti Europa uray addaan ti panagsasabali ti pagsasao ken panagbiag.

source: Translate this sentence from eng to ilo: Its all-pervading power affected everyone from king to commoner.
target: Iti nasaknap a panagturayna maapektaranna amin manipud ari agingga iti gagangay a umili.

source: Translate this sentence from eng to ilo: One of the main Christian tenets is that wealth should be used to alleviate suffering and poverty and that the monetary funds of the church are there specifically for that reason.
target: Maysa kadagiti kangrunaan a Nakristianuan a sursuro a ti kinabaknang ket masapul a mausar tapno mapalag-anan ti panagsagaba ken kinakurapay ket adda a nairanta dagiti pondo a kuarta ti simbaan para iti dayta a rason.

source: Translate this sentence from eng to ilo: The central authority of the church had been in Rome for over a thousand years and this concentration of power and money led many to question whether this tenet was being met.
target: Ti sentro ti autoridad ti simbaan ket adda iti Roma iti nasurok a sangaribu a tawen ket gapu ta dita ti sentro ti pannakabalin ken kuarta, adun ti agduadua no masursurot met laeng daytoy a sursuro.

source: Translate this sentence from eng to ilo: Soon after the outbreak of hostilities, Britain initiated a naval blockade of Germany.
target: Saan a nagbayag kalpasan ket bimtak ti gubat, ti Britania ket nangrugi ti pananglappedda iti panaglayag ti Germany.

source: Translate this sentence from eng to ilo: The strategy proved effective, cutting off vital military and civilian supplies, although this blockade violated generally accepted international law codified by several international agreements of the past two centuries.
target: Napaneknekan nga epektibo ti pamay-an, ti panagikkat kadagiti kasapulan a suplay ti militar ken sibilian, ngem daytoy a panagserra ilabsingna ti kangrunaan nga akseptado a internasional a linteg nga ipaay dagiti sumagmamano a tulagan iti naudi a dua a siglo.

source: Translate this sentence from eng to ilo: Britain mined international waters to prevent any ships from entering entire sections of ocean, causing danger to even neutral ships.
target: Inikkan ti Britania kadagiti mina ti internasional a dandanum tapno malapdan ti ania man a barko nga umuneg iti entiro a paset ti taaw, a nangipoaay iti peggad uray kadagiti neutral a barko.

source: Translate this sentence from eng to ilo: Since there was limited response to this tactic, Germany expected a similar response to its unrestricted submarine warfare.
target: Gapu ta adda ti limitado a sungbat kadagitoy a taktika, ninamnama ti Germany ti agpada a sungbat para kadagiti saan a malapdan a pannakigubat a submarino.

source: Translate this sentence from eng to ilo: During the 1920s, the prevailing attitudes of most citizens and nations was that of pacifism and isolation.
target: Idi 1920s, ti nangruna nga ugali ti kaadduan a tattao ken pagilian ket ti pasifismo ken panagsarili.

source: Translate this sentence from eng to ilo: After seeing the horrors and atrocities of war during World War I, nations desired to avoid such a situation again in the future.
target: Kalpasan a nakita dagiti nakabutbuteng ken naranggas a pasamak bayat ti Gubat Sangalubongan I, kayat idi dagiti nasion a liklikan ti kasta manen a situasion iti masanguanan.

source: Translate this sentence from eng to ilo: In 1884, Tesla moved to the United States of America to accept a job with the Edison Company in New York City.
target: Idi 1884, ti Tesla ket napan iti Estados Unidos tapno akseptaren ti maysa a trabaho iti Kumpanya ti Esidon idiay siudad ti New York.

source: Translate this sentence from eng to ilo: He arrived in the US with 4 cents to his name, a book of poetry, and a letter of recommendation from Charles Batchelor (his manager in his previous job) to Thomas Edison.
target: Dimteng isuna iti US nga addaan laeng iti 4 a sentimo, maysa a libro ti daniw, ken maysa a surat a rekomendasion manipud ken ni Charles Batchelor (ti manedierna iti immuna a trabahona) a para ken ni Thomas Edison.

source: Translate this sentence from eng to ilo: Ancient China had a unique way of showing different time periods; each stage of China or each family that was in power was a distinctive dynasty.
target: Iti nagkauna a Tsina ket adda ti sabsabali a dalanna a panangipakita iti agsasabali a paset ti oras; kada paset ti Tsina wenno kada pamilia nga agturay ket maysa a sabsabali a dinastia.

source: Translate this sentence from eng to ilo: Also between each dynasty was an unstable age of divided provinces. The best-known of these periods was the Three Kingdoms epoch taking place for 60 years between the Han and the Jin Dynasty.
target: Ken iti baet ti kada dinastia ket ti nariribuk a panawen ti pannakasinasina dagiti probinsia. Ti kalatakan kadagitoy a tiempo ket ti panawen ti Tallo a Pagarian a napasamak iti las-ud ti 60 a tawen iti nagbaetan dagiti dinastia ti Han ken ti Jin.

source: Translate this sentence from eng to ilo: During these periods fierce warfare took place between many nobles fighting for the throne.
target: Agdama kadagitoy a panawen nauyong a gubat ket napasamak iti adu nga agturay a lumaban para iti trono.

source: Translate this sentence from eng to ilo: The Three Kingdoms was one of the bloodiest eras in Ancient China’s history thousands of people died fighting to sit in the highest seat in the grand palace at Xi’an.
target: Iti Tallo a Pagarian ket maysa kadagiti nadara a panawen ti napalabas iti Kadaanan a Tsina ribu-ribo a tattao ti natay a makigubgubat tapno laeng makatugaw iti kangatuan a puesto iti dakkel a palasio idiay Xi'an.

source: Translate this sentence from eng to ilo: There are a lot of social and political effects such as the use of metric system, a shift from absolutism to republicanism, nationalism and the belief the country belongs to the people not to one sole ruler.
target: Adu iti sosial ken pulitikal nga epekto kas ti panagusar iti sistema metriko, panagiakar aggapu iti absolutismo mapan republikanismo, nasionalismo ken ti pammati a ti nasion ket bagi iti tattao saan nga iti maymaysa laeng a daulo.

source: Translate this sentence from eng to ilo: Also after the Revolution occupations were open to all male applicants allowing the most ambitious and successful to succeed.
target: Kasta pay a kalpasan ti Rebolusion, nakalukat dagiti pagobraan iti amin nga aplikante a lallaki a nangipalubos kadagiti addaan nasged nga ambision ken nalalaing tapno agballigi.

source: Translate this sentence from eng to ilo: Same goes for the military because instead of army rankings being based on class they were now based on cailaber.
target: Kasta met dagiti militar gapu ta imbes a maibasar ti ranggo ti suldado iti klaseda ibasbasarda itan iti kalibre.

source: Translate this sentence from eng to ilo: The French Revolution also inspired many other repressed working class people of other country's to began their own revolutions.
target: Nangipaltiing iti Rebolusion idiay Pransia iti adu pay a dadduma a naidadanes nga agtatrabaho a klase ti tattao iti sabali a nasion tapno rugianda iti rebolusionda.

source: Translate this sentence from eng to ilo: Muhammad was deeply interested in matters beyond this mundane life. He used to frequent a cave that became known as “Hira‘” on the Mountain of “Noor” (light) for contemplation.
target: Nauneg ti panaginteres ni Muhammad kadagiti bambanag iti labes ti gagangay a biag. Masansan a mapan iti maysa a kueba a naam-ammo kas “Hira” iti Bantay ti “Noor” (lawag) tapno agmennamenna.

source: Translate this sentence from eng to ilo: he cave itself, which survived the times, gives a very vivid image of Muhammad’s spiritual inclinations.
target: Ti mismo a kueba, nga adda pay laeng agingga ita, ket mangted iti nalawag a pammaneknek nga interesado ni Muhammad kadagiti espiritual a bambanag.

source: Translate this sentence from eng to ilo: Resting on the top of one of the mountains north of Mecca, the cave is completely isolated from the rest of the world.
target: Nakaparabaw iti tuktok ti maysa a bantay iti amianan ti Mecca, iti kueba ket naisina ti dadduma a paset ti lubong.

source: Translate this sentence from eng to ilo: In fact, it is not easy to find at all even if one knew it existed. Once inside the cave, it is a total isolation.
target: Iti kinagpaysuananna, narigat makasapul uray pay ammo tayo nga adda. No addaka iti uneg ti kuweban, permi a bukbukodamon.

source: Translate this sentence from eng to ilo: Nothing can be seen other than the clear, beautiful sky above and the many surrounding mountains. Very little of this world can be seen or heard from inside the cave.
target: Awan ti makita malaksid ti klaro, napintas a tangatang iti ngato ken ii adu nga aglawlaw a banbantay. Bassit kadaytgitoy a lubong iti makita wenno mangngeg iti uneg ti kueba.

topic: seven wonders of the world/pyramid at giza
source: Translate this sentence from eng to ilo: The Great Pyramid at Giza is the only one of the seven wonders that is still standing today.
target: Iti Dakkel a Piramid idiay Giza ket isu ti kakaisunan a nakatakder tatta a maysa iti pito a nakaskasdaaw.

topic: seven wonders of the world/pyramid at giza
source: Translate this sentence from eng to ilo: Built by the Egyptians in the third century BCE, the Great Pyramid is one of many large pyramid structures built to honor dead Pharaoh.
target: Inaramid dagiti Ehipsio idi maikatlo a siglo BCE, dagiti Naindaklan a Piramide ti maysa kadagiti adu a dadakkel nga istruktura ti piramide a naaramid a pangdaydayaw iti natay a Pharaoh.

topic: seven wonders of the world/pyramid at giza
source: Translate this sentence from eng to ilo: The Giza Plateau, or "Giza Necropolis" in the Egyptian Valley of the Dead contains several pyramids (of which the great pyramid is the largest), several small tombs, several temples, and the great Sphinx.
target: Ti Giza Plateau, wenno “Giza Necropolis” iti Valley of the Dead ti Ehipto, addaan iti sumagmamano a piramide (a ti naindaklan a piramide ti kadakkelan), sumagmamano a babassit a tantanem, sumagmamano a temtemplo, ken ti naindaklan nga Sphinx.

topic: seven wonders of the world/pyramid at giza
source: Translate this sentence from eng to ilo: The great pyramid was created to honor the Pharaoh Khufu, and many of the smaller pyramids, tombs, and temples were built to honor Khufu's wives and family members.
target: Iti dakkel a piramida ket naaramid tapno mapadayawan ni Parao Khufu, ken adu pay a babassit a piramida, tanem, ken templo ti naaramid tapno mapadayawan ti asawa ni Khufu ken dagiti miyembro ti pamilya.

source: Translate this sentence from eng to ilo: The "up bow" mark looks like a V and the "down bow mark" like a staple or a square missing its bottom side.
target: Ti marka nga “up bow” ket aglanglanga a kasla V ken ti “down bow" kasla maysa nga staple wenno maysa a kuadrado a mapukpukaw ti akimbaba nga igidna.

source: Translate this sentence from eng to ilo: Up means you should start at the tip and push the bow, and down means you should start at the frog (which is where your hand is holding the bow) and pull the bow.
target: Kayatna a sawen ti pangato, mangrugika iti pungto ket iduronmo ti pana, ket ti pababa, kayatna a sawen a mangrugika iti frog (nga isu ti imam a mangig-iggem iti pana) samo guyoden ti pana.

source: Translate this sentence from eng to ilo: An up-bow usually generates a softer sound, while a down-bow is stronger and more assertive.
target: Iti up-bow ket gagangay nga ag-araramid ti nakapkapsut nga uno, ngem iti down-bow ket napigpigsa ken natibtibker.

source: Translate this sentence from eng to ilo: Feel free to pencil in your own marks, but remember the printed bowing marks are there for a musical reason, so they should usually be respected.
target: Dikay bumdeng nga isurat ti bukodmo a marka, ngem tandaanam a ti naiyimprenta nga agrukob a marka ket adda maigapu iti musika, isu a kasapulan a dayawen.

source: Translate this sentence from eng to ilo: The terrified King Louis XVI, Queen Marie Antoinette their two young children (11 year old Marie Therese and four year old Louis-Charles) and the King's sister, Madam Elizabeth, on the 6th October 1789 were forced back to Paris from Versailles by a mob of market women.
target: Pinuersa ti grupo dagiti aglaklako a babbai ti napabutngan nga Ari Louis XVI, Reyna Marie Antoinette ken dagiti dua nga annakda (11 ti tawenna a ni Marie Therese ken ti uppat ti tawenna a ni Louis-Charles) ken ti kabsat ti Ari a ni Madam Elizabeth, nga agsubli idiay Paris manipud Versailles, idi maika-6 ti Oktubre 1789.

source: Translate this sentence from eng to ilo: In a carriage, they traveled back to Paris surrounded by a mob of people screaming and shouting threats against the King and Queen.
target: Idiay karuahe, nagbiaheda a nagsubli idiay Paris a nalikmutan tu bunggoy ti tattao nga agririyaw ken agpukpukaw i pammutbuteng laban iti Ari ken Reyna.

source: Translate this sentence from eng to ilo: The mob of people forced the King And Queen to have their carriage windows wide open.
target: Pinilit ti grupo dagiti agririri a tattao ti Ari ken Reyna a lukatan dagitoy dagiti tawa ti karuaheda.

source: Translate this sentence from eng to ilo: At one point a member of the mob waved the head of a royal guard killed at Versailles in front of the terrified Queen.
target: Iti maysa a gundaway, maysa a miembro ti nariribuk nga ummong ti nangitag-ay iti ulo ti guardia ti ari a napapatay idiay Versailles iti sango ti napabutngan a Reyna.

source: Translate this sentence from eng to ilo: The war expenditures of U.S. imperialism in the conquest of the Philippines were paid for by the Filipino people themselves.
target: Binayadan met la a bukbukod dagiti Filipino dagiti nagastos iti gubat ti imperialismo ti U.S. iti panangsakupda iti Filipinas

source: Translate this sentence from eng to ilo: They were compelled to pay taxes to the U.S. colonial regime to defray a major part of the expenditures and the interest on bonds floated in the name of the Philippine government through the Wall Street banking houses.
target: Napilitanda nga agbayad kadagiti buis iti kolonial a turay ti Estados Unidos tapno mabayadan ti kadakkelan a paset dagiti gastos ken dagiti interes kadagiti bono a nausar iti nagan ti gobierno ti Filipinas babaen kadagti banko ti Wall street.

source: Translate this sentence from eng to ilo: Of course, the superprofits derived from the protracted exploitation of the Filipino people would constitute the basic gains of U.S. imperialism.
target: Siempre, dagiti superprofit a maala kadagiti napaut a pannanggundaway kadagiti Pilipino ket buklenna ti kangrunaan a kita iti Imperyalismo ti U.S.

source: Translate this sentence from eng to ilo: To understand the Templars one must understand the context that prompted the creation of the order.
target: Tapno maawatan dagiti Templar, masapul a maawatan ti konteksto no apay a natignay ti pannakabukel daytoy a gunglo.

source: Translate this sentence from eng to ilo: The age where the events took place is commonly referred as the High Middle Ages the period of European history in the 11th, 12th, and 13th centuries (AD 1000–1300).
target: Ti panawen a naaramid dagita a pasamak ket gagangay a maawagan a kas  High Middle Ages, ti panawen iti pakasaritaan ti Europa iti maika-11, maika-12, ken maika-13 a siglo (AD 1000-1300).

source: Translate this sentence from eng to ilo: The High Middle Ages were preceded by the Early Middle Ages and followed by the Late Middle Ages, which by convention ends around 1500.
target: Dagiti tawtawen a High Middle Age ket inunaan dagti tawtawen nga Early Middle ken sinaruno dagiti tawtawen a Late Middle, a nagleppas idi 1500.

source: Translate this sentence from eng to ilo: Technological determinism is a term that encompasses a wide range of ideas in practice, from technology-push or the technological imperative to a strict sense that human destiny is driven by an underlying logic associated with scientific laws and their manifestation in technology.
target: Ti teknolohikal a determinismo ket termino a mangsaklaw iti nakaad-adu nga ideya a madaman a maus-usar, kas iti panagpartuat iti produkto gapu iti teknolohia wenno ti pannakausar ti teknolohia para iti pagsayaatan ken ti istrikto a kapanunotan a ti pagtungpalan dagiti tattao ket iturturong ti saan a makita a lohika a konektado  kadagiti linteg iti siensia ken no ania dagiti ipakita ti teknolohia.

source: Translate this sentence from eng to ilo: Most interpretations of technological determinism share two general ideas: that the development of technology itself follows a path largely beyond cultural or political influence, and that technology in turn has "effects" on societies that are inherent, rather than socially conditioned.
target: Kaadwan nga interpretasion iti teknolohikal a pangdetermina ket mangited iti dua a kapanunutan: a ti pannakaaramid ti teknolohiya ket sumursurot iti dalan a limmabes iti impluwensia ti kultura wenno pulitika, ken iti teknolohia ket addaan met ti “epekto” kadagiti natawid a gimong, ngem kadagiti nakundison iti gimong.

source: Translate this sentence from eng to ilo: For example, one might say that the motor car necessarily leads to the development of roads.
target: Kaspagarigan, mabalin a maibaga ti maysa a ti kotse a de-motor ket masapul a mangiturong iti panagpasayaat kadagiti kalsada.

source: Translate this sentence from eng to ilo: However, a nationwide road network is not economically viable for just a handful of cars, so new methods of production are developed to reduce the cost of car ownership.
target: Kas pagarigan, nagastos ti kaadda ti agkakamang a kalsada iti intero a pagilian no manmano met dagiti lugan, isu a napataud dagiti baro a pamay-an ti panagaramid iti lugan tapno nalaklaka ti presio ti panggatang iti lugan.

source: Translate this sentence from eng to ilo: Mass car ownership also leads to a higher incidence of accidents on the roads, which leads to the invention of new techniques in healthcare for repairing damaged bodies.
target: Ti pannakabagi ti kotse ti masa ket mangitunda met iti nangatngato nga insidente ti aksidente iti kalkalsada, a nangitunda iti pannakaaramid dagiti baro a teknik ti panag-aywan iti salun-at tapno urnosen dagiti naperdi a bagbagi.

source: Translate this sentence from eng to ilo: Romanticism had a large element of cultural determinism, drawn from writers such as Goethe, Fichte, and Schlegel.
target: Ti romantisismo ket adda ti dakkel nga elemento ti panangdetermina ti kultura, a naala kadagiti mannurat a kas ni Goethe, Fichte ken Schlegel.

source: Translate this sentence from eng to ilo: In the context of Romanticism, the geography molded individuals, and over time customs and culture related to that geography arose, and these, being in harmony with the place of the society, were better than arbitrarily imposed laws.
target: Iti konteksto ti Romantisismo, ti heograpiya ti mangmuli kadagiti indibidual a tattao, ket iti panaglabas ti panawen sumangbay dagiti aramid ken kultura a mainaig iti dayta a heograpia, ket dagitoy, addaan iti pannakinaig iti lugar ti gimong, ket nasaysayaat ngem kadagiti saan a masnop a naipakat a linlinteg.

source: Translate this sentence from eng to ilo: In the manner that Paris is known as the fashion capital of the contemporary world, Constantinople was regarded as the fashion capital of feudal Europe.
target: Maiyarig a ti Paris ket nalatak a kapitolio ti moda ti kapanawenan nga lubong, Constantinople ket makuna met a kapitolio ti moda ti feudal a Europe.

source: Translate this sentence from eng to ilo: Its renown for being an epicenter of luxury began in about 400 A.D. and lasted up until about 1100 A.D.
target: Ti kinalatakna a kas sentro ti nabaknang a panagbiag, nangrugi idi 400 A.D. ken nagpaut agingga iti agarup 1100 A.D

source: Translate this sentence from eng to ilo: Its status declined during the twelfth century mainly due to the fact that Crusaders had returned bearing gifts such as silks and spices that were valued more than what Byzantine markets offered.
target: Bimmaba ti estadona idi maikasangapulo ket duwa a siglo gapo iti pudno a dagiti Krusada ket nagsubli nga adda inpaayda kas ti silk ken rekrekado a nanginngina ngem dagiti lako ti Byzantine.

source: Translate this sentence from eng to ilo: It was at this time that the transfer of the title of Fashion Capital from Constantinople to Paris was made.
target: Ti kastoy a panawen naaramid ti panagiakar ti titulo nga Fashion Capital manipud Constantinople mapan iti Paris.

source: Translate this sentence from eng to ilo: Gothic style peaked in the period between the 10th - 11th centuries and the 14th century.
target: Naitandudo ti istilo a Gothic iti panawen a nagbaetan ti maika-10-11 a siglo ken maika-14 a siglo.

source: Translate this sentence from eng to ilo: At the beginning dress was heavily influenced by the Byzantine culture in the east.
target: Idi un-unana dagiti kawes ket nadagsen a maimpluensiaan dagiti kultura ti Byzantine idiay daya.

source: Translate this sentence from eng to ilo: However, due to the slow communication channels, styles in the west could lag behind by 25 to 30 year.
target: Nupay kasta, gapu iti nabayag a komunikasion, dagiti istilo iti laod ket mamaudi iti 25 inggana 30 a tawen.

source: Translate this sentence from eng to ilo: towards the end of the Middle Ages western Europe began to develop their own style. one of the biggest developments of the time as a result of the crusades people began to use buttons to fasten clothing.
target: Iti panagleppas ti Middle Ages, nangrugi a mangbukel ti lumaud nga Europa iti bukodda nga istilo. Maysa kadagiti kadadakkelan a nagdur-asan iti dayta a panawen a kas resulta dagiti krusada, nangrugi dagiti tattao nga agusar iti butones a pangiserra iti badbado.

source: Translate this sentence from eng to ilo: Subsistence agriculture is agriculture carried out for the production of enough food to meet just the needs of the agriculturalist and his/her family.
target: Ti pagbiagan nga agrikultura ket agrikultura a maisaysayangkat para iti pannakapataud ti makaanay a taraon a para laeng iti kasapulan ti mannalon ken ti pamiliana.

source: Translate this sentence from eng to ilo: Subsistence agriculture is a simple, often organic, system using saved seed native to the ecoregion combined with crop rotation or other relatively simple techniques to maximize yield.
target: Ti subsistence nga agrukultura ket maysa a simple, kaaduanna nga organiko, a sistema nga agus-usar iti naidulin a bukel a natibo iti rehion ken nanayonan kadagiti teknik a crop rotation wenno sabsabali pay a simple laeng a teknik tapno mapaadu ti apit.

source: Translate this sentence from eng to ilo: Historically most farmers were engaged in subsistence agriculture and this is still the case in many developing nations.
target: Segun iti pakasaritaan, adu kadagiti mannalon ti nangar-aramid iti pagbiagan nga agrikultura ket kastoy pay laeng ti maar-aramid iti adu kadagiti agdurdur-as a pagilian.

source: Translate this sentence from eng to ilo: Subcultures bring together like-minded individuals who feel neglected by societal standards and allow them to develop a sense of identity.
target: Dagiti subkultura ket mangtiptipon kadagiti agkakapanunutan nga indibidwal no siasino ket rikrikanenda a mabaybay-anda ti gimong ken mangpalpalubos kanyada nga agaramid ti rikna iti pannakaamammo.

source: Translate this sentence from eng to ilo: Subcultures can be distinctive because of the age, ethnicity, class, location, and/or gender of the members.
target: Dagiti subkultura ket mailasin gapu iti edad, kina-etniko, klase, lugar, ken/wenno kinalalaki wenno kinababai dagiti miembro.

source: Translate this sentence from eng to ilo: The qualities that determine a subculture as distinct may be linguistic, aesthetic, religious, political, sexual, geographical, or a combination of factors.
target: Dagiti kalidad a mangibaga a ti subkultura ket usto ket mabalin a pagsasao, langa, relihiyon, pulitikal, sekswal, heograpikal, wenno iti nagtitipon a pagkikitaaan.

source: Translate this sentence from eng to ilo: Members of a subculture often signal their membership through a distinctive and symbolic use of style, which includes fashions, mannerisms, and argot.
target: Masansan nga ipaduyakyak dagiti miembro ti subkultura ti kinamiembroda babaen ti mailasin ken simboliko a panagusar iti istilo, a pakairamanan dagiti uso nga aruaten, galad, ken pagsasao.

source: Translate this sentence from eng to ilo: One of the most common methods used to illustrate the importance of socialization is to draw upon the few unfortunate cases of children who were, through neglect, misfortune, or wilful abuse, not socialized by adults while they were growing up.
target: Maysa kadagiti gagangay a sistema tapno maipakita ti kinapateg ti pannakilangen ket mangala kadagiti manmano a napaay a kasasaad dagiti ubbing a gapu iti panangbaybay-a, desgrasia, wenno panangabuso, saan a pinakelangenan iti nataengan bayat a dumakdakkelda.

source: Translate this sentence from eng to ilo: Such children are called "feral" or wild. Some feral children have been confined by people (usually their own parents); in some cases this child abandonment was due to the parents' rejection of a child's severe intellectual or physical impairment.
target: Maawagan a "feral" wenno atap dagita nga ubbing. Dadduma a feral nga ubbing ti impupok dagiti tattato (masansan a dagiti nagannakda); iti sumagmamano a kaso, daytoy panangabandona iti ubing ket maigapu iti pananglaksid dagiti nagannak iti nakaro nga an-annayen ti panunot wenno bagi ti ubing.

source: Translate this sentence from eng to ilo: Feral children may have experienced severe child abuse or trauma before being abandoned or running away.
target: Dagiti ubbing a naiyadayo iti tattao ket mabalin a nakapadas ti nakaro a pannakaabuso wenno nakarigrigat a kasasaad sakbay a nabaybay-an wenno nagtalaw.

source: Translate this sentence from eng to ilo: Others are alleged to have been brought up by animals; some are said to have lived in the wild on their own.
target: Maipagarup a dagiti dadduma ket pinadakkel dagiti ayup; kunada a sumagmamano ti nagbibiag nga is-isuda iti langalang.

source: Translate this sentence from eng to ilo: When completely brought up by non-human animals, the feral child exhibits behaviors (within physical limits) almost entirely like those of the particular care-animal, such as its fear of or indifference to humans.
target: No pinadakkel ti saan-a-tao nga animal, ti atap nga ubing ket agpakita ti ugali (nga adda pisikal a limitasionna) a kasla kadagidiay animal a manangasikaso, kaspagarigan iti butengna wenno panangidumdumana kadagiti dadduma a tao.

source: Translate this sentence from eng to ilo: While project based learning should make learning easier and more interesting, scaffolding goes a step beyond.
target: Idinto a ti nakabasar iti proyekto a pannakasursuro ket palakaenna ken pagbalinenna a mas interesante ti pannakasursuro, nasaysayaat manen ti sistema nga scaffolding.
