source: Translate this sentence from eng to ilo: Scaffolding is not a method of learning but rather an aid that provides support to individuals whom are undergoing a new learning experience such as using a new computer program or beginning a new project.
target: Ti scaffolding ket saan a wagas ti panagadal no diketdi maysa a tulong a mangted ti suporta kadagiti indibidual nga agad-adal ti baro a kapadasan kasla ti panagusar ti baro a programa ti kompiuter wenno panangirugi ti baro a proyekto.

source: Translate this sentence from eng to ilo: Scaffolds can be both virtual and real, in other words, a teacher is a form of scaffold but so is the little paperclip man in Microsoft Office.
target: Dagiti scaffold ket agpada a mabalin a birtual wenno aktual, iti sabali a pannao, ti maysa a mannursuro ket maysa a porma ti scaffold ngem isu met diay bassit a tao a paperclip idiay Microsoft Office.

source: Translate this sentence from eng to ilo: Virtual Scaffolds are internalized in the software and are meant to question, prompt, and explain procedures that may have been to challenging for the student to handle alone.
target: Dagiti Virtual Scaffold ket naipauneg iti software ken nairanta nga agsaludsod, mangiturong, ken mangilawlawag kadagiti pamay-an a mabalin a narigat para kadagiti estudyante no bukbukodda laeng.

source: Translate this sentence from eng to ilo: Children are placed in Foster Care for a wide variety of reasons that range from neglect, to abuse, and even to extortion.
target: Maipan iti Foster Care dagiti ubbing gapu iti nadumaduma a rason manipud iti pannakabaybay-a, agingga iti pannakaabuso, ken agingg uray pay iti extortion.

source: Translate this sentence from eng to ilo: No child should ever have to grow up in an environment that is not nurturing, caring, and educational, but they do.
target: Awan ti ubing a masapul a dumakkel iti aglawlaw a saan a makatulong, maka-aywan, ken makasursuro, ngem saan a maliklikan.

source: Translate this sentence from eng to ilo: We perceive the Foster Care System to be a safety zone for these children.
target: Maamiris tayo a ti Sistema iti Panangtaripato kadagiti Ulila ket natalged a lugar para kadagitoy nga ubbing.

source: Translate this sentence from eng to ilo: Our foster care system is supposed to provide safe homes, loving caregivers, stable education, and reliable health care.
target: Ti sistema ti foster caremi ket mangted koma ti natalged a paggianan, managayat a manangasikaso, natalged nga edukasion, ken mapagtalkan a manangasikaso iti salun-at.

source: Translate this sentence from eng to ilo: Foster care is supposed to provide all the necessities that were lacking in the home they were previously taken from.
target: Manamnama nga ipaay ti Foster Care ti amin a kasapulanda nga awan idi iti dati nga ayanda a balay.

source: Translate this sentence from eng to ilo: The Internet combines elements of both mass and interpersonal communication.
target: Ti internet ket pinagtiponna nga agpada ti elemento ti kaaduan ken ti pannakilangen.

source: Translate this sentence from eng to ilo: The distinct characteristics of the Internet lead to additional dimensions in terms of the uses and gratifications approach.
target: Ti pakailasinan ti Internet ket agresulta ti kanayunanna pay a dimension maipapan kadagiti panangaramat ken no kasano a makapnek dayta.

source: Translate this sentence from eng to ilo: For example, “learning” and “socialization” are suggested as important motivations for Internet use (James et al., 1995).
target: Kas pagarigan, “ti panagadal” ken “pannakilangen” ket naisingasing a napateg a pakatignayan para iti panagusar ti Internet (James et al. , 1995).

source: Translate this sentence from eng to ilo: “Personal involvement” and “continuing relationships” were also identified as new motivation aspects by Eighmey and McCord (1998) when they investigated audience reactions to websites.
target: “Ti Personal a pannakikadua” ken “agtultuloy a pannakirelasion” ket mailasin a baro nga aspeto a pammaregta kuna ni Eighmey ken McCord (1998) idi inimbestigaranda ti reaksion dagiti agbuybuya iti websites.

source: Translate this sentence from eng to ilo: The use of video recording has led to important discoveries in the interpretation of micro-expressions, facial movements which last a few milliseconds.
target: Ti panangaramat ti video recording ket nangituggod kadagiti nagpateg a pannakatakuat ti paspasamak iti interpretasion ti micro-expressions, panaggaraw ti rupa a mabalin a mapasamak iti mano a millisecond.

source: Translate this sentence from eng to ilo: In particular, it is claimed that one can detect whether a person is lying by interpreting micro-expressions correctly.
target: Maysa a nangruna a mapapati a mabalin a maammuan no agul-ulbod ti maysa a tao babaen iti umno a panangitarus kadagiti babassit unay nga ekspresion.

source: Translate this sentence from eng to ilo: Oliver Sacks, in his paper The President's Speech, indicated how people who are unable to understand speech because of brain damage are nevertheless able to assess sincerity accurately.
target: Ni Oliver Sacks, iti papelna a Ti Sao ti Presidente, ket nangindikar no kasanu a ti tao ket saan a makaawat ti sao gapu iti perdi iti utak ket saanna a maamiris ti kinapudno a nasayaat.

source: Translate this sentence from eng to ilo: He even suggests that such abilities in interpreting human behavior may be shared by animals such as domestic dogs.
target: Imbagana pay a dagitoy nga abilidad iti panangawat iti galad ti tattao ket mabalin a tagigaladen met dagiti ayup a kas dagiti taraken nga aso.

source: Translate this sentence from eng to ilo: Twentieth century research has shown that there are two pools of genetic variation: hidden and expressed.
target: Imparang ti maika-20 a siglo a panagsuskisok nga adda dua a henetiko a panagdududma: nailemmeng ken makitkita.

source: Translate this sentence from eng to ilo: Mutation adds new genetic variation, and selection removes it from the pool of expressed variation.
target: Ti mutasion ket mangnaynayon ti genetiko a kinanadumaduma, ken ti panagpili ket mangik-ikkat kadagitoy iti pagpilyan.

source: Translate this sentence from eng to ilo: Segregation and recombination shuffle variation back and forth between the two pools with each generation.
target: Panangilasin ken panagtitipon ket mangisubli ken mangiturong iti panangbalasa ti panagduduma iti baet ti dua a dan-aw iti tunggal henerasion.

source: Translate this sentence from eng to ilo: Out on the savanna, it is hard for a primate with a digestive system like that of humans to satisfy its amino-acid requirements from available plant resources.
target: Iti savanna, narigat para iti maysa a primate nga addaan ti sistema ti panagtunaw a kas iti tattao a pagustuan ti pakasapulanna nga amino acid manipud kadagiti adda a rekursos a mulmula.

source: Translate this sentence from eng to ilo: Moreover, failure to do so has serious consequences: growth depression, malnutrition, and ultimately death.
target: Kanayunanna pay, ti saan mo panangaramid iti dayta ket adda ti serioso a resultana: saan a panagdakkel, malnutrision, ken ti papatay.

source: Translate this sentence from eng to ilo: The most readily accessible plant resources would have been the proteins accessible in leaves and legumes, but these are hard for primates like us to digest unless they are cooked.
target: Mabalin a dagiti protina nga adda kadagiti bulong ken bukbukel ti kalakaan a maala a rekursos a mula, ngem narigat dagitoy para kadagiti primate a kas kadatayo a runawen malaksid no mailuto.

source: Translate this sentence from eng to ilo: In contrast, animal foods (ants, termites, eggs) not only are easily digestible, but they provide high-quantity proteins that contain all the essential amino acids.
target: Ti pagdumaanna, dagiti taraon ti ayup (kuton, anay, itlog), saan la a nalaka a matunaw, ngem makaipaay pay iti nangato a kaadu ti protina nga addaan iti amin a kasapulan nga amino acid.

source: Translate this sentence from eng to ilo: All things considered, we should not be surprised if our own ancestors solved their "protein problem" in somewhat the same way that chimps on the savanna do today.
target: No kitaentayo ti amin a banag, saantayo a makigtot no dagiti kapuontayo ket sinolbarda ti “problema ti protina” a kapada ti ar-aramiden dagiti sunggo iti savanna ita a panawen.

source: Translate this sentence from eng to ilo: Sleep interruption is the process of purposefully awakening during your normal sleep period and falling asleep a short time later (10–60 minutes).
target: Ti pannakaistorbo iti panagturog ket ti proseso a panangpilit ti panagriing iti tiempo ti normal a pannaturog ken pannaturog manen iti apagbiit (manipud 10 agingga iti 60 a minuto).

source: Translate this sentence from eng to ilo: This can be easily done by using a relatively quiet alarm clock to bring you to consciousness without fully waking you.
target: Daytoy ket nadaras laeng a maaramid babaen ti saan unay a napigsa nga alarm a relo a mangisubli ti puotmo ngem saan nga agpayso a mangriing kenka.

source: Translate this sentence from eng to ilo: If you find yourself resetting the clock in your sleep, it can be placed on the other side of the room, forcing you to get out of bed to turn it off.
target: No masapulmo nga iplastar ti orasam no maturogka, mabalin a maipan daytoy iti bangir nga igid ti kuartom, aa mangpilit kenka a bumangon iti pagiddaam no iddepem.

source: Translate this sentence from eng to ilo: Other biorhythm-based options involve drinking lots of fluid (particularly water or tea, a known diuretic) prior to sleep, forcing one to get up to urinate.
target: Iti sabali pay a pagpilyan a nakabasar iti biorythm ket pakairamanan ti panaginom ti adu a likido (nangruna iti danum wenno tsaa, maammuan a dayoretiko) sakbay ti pannaturog, a mangituntunda ti panagbangon ti maysa tao tapno umisbo.

source: Translate this sentence from eng to ilo: The amount of inner peace a person possesses correlates oppositely to the amount of tension in one’s body and spirit.
target: Ti kaadu ti talna iti kaunggan nga adda iti maysa a tao ket kanaigna a kasupadi ti kaadu ti tension iti bagi ken espiritu ti maysa a tao.

source: Translate this sentence from eng to ilo: The lower the tension, the more positive the life force present. Every person has the potential to find absolute peace and contentment.
target: No nababbaba ti tension, ad-adda a positibo ti puersa ti biag nga adda. Tunggal maysa ket addaan ti potensial a makasarak ti naan-anay a talna ken pannakapnek.

source: Translate this sentence from eng to ilo: Everyone can achieve enlightenment. The only thing standing in the way of this goal is our own tension and negativity.
target: Mabalin ti amin a makagun-od iti pannakalawlawag. Ti laeng banag a manglaplapped iti daytoy a panggep ket ti bukodtayo a panagdandanag ken kinanegatibo.

source: Translate this sentence from eng to ilo: The Tibetan Buddhism is based on the teachings of Buddha, but were extended by the mahayana path of love and by a lot of techniques from Indian Yoga.
target: Naibasar kadagiti sursuro ni Buddha ti Budismo a Tibetan, ngem napalawa ti dalan ti ayat ti mahayana ken babaen iti adu pay a teknik manipud iti Yoga nga Indian.

source: Translate this sentence from eng to ilo: In principle the Tibetan Buddhism is very simple. It consists of Kundalini Yoga, meditation and the path of all-embracing love.
target: Nakasimsimple ti prinsipio ti Budismo iti Tibet. Buklen daytoy ti Kundalini Yoga, meditasion ken ti dalan ti amin a panangarakup ti ayat.

source: Translate this sentence from eng to ilo: With Kundalini Yoga the Kundalini energy (enlightenment energy) is awakened through yoga postures, breathing exercises, mantras and visualizations.
target: Kadua iti Kundalini Yoga, ti enerhia ti Kundalini (enerhia ti pannakalawlawag) ket nariing manipud kadagiti postura ti yoga, ehersisio ti panaganges, mantra ken pannakasirmata.

source: Translate this sentence from eng to ilo: The center of Tibetan meditation is the Deity Yoga. Through the visualization of various deities the energy channels are cleaned, the chakras are activated and the enlightenment consciousness is created.
target: Ti Dios a Yoga ti tengnga ti meditasIon a Tibet. Babaen iti bisualisasion ti nadumaduma a dios, madalusan dagiti pagdalanan ti enerhia, maparuk-atan dagiti dagiti chakra, ken maparnuay ti pannakalawlawag ti nakem.

source: Translate this sentence from eng to ilo: Germany was a common enemy in World War 2, leading to cooperation between the USSR and USA. With the end of the war the clashes of system, process and culture led to the countries falling out.
target: Ti Germany ket kalaban ti amin idi Gubat Sangalubungan II, a nagresulta iti panagkadua ti USSR ken USA. Idi agpatingga ti gubat, saanen nga agtutunos dagiti sistema, proseso, ken kultura isu nga aglilinnabanen dagiti pagpagilian.

source: Translate this sentence from eng to ilo: With two years of the end of the war, the former allies were now enemies and the Cold War began.
target: Dua a tawen kalpasan ti gubat, agkabusor itan dagiti dati nga agkakaaliado, ket nangrugin ti Cold War.

source: Translate this sentence from eng to ilo: It was to last for the next 40 years and would be fought for real, by proxy armies, on battlefields from Africa to Asia, in Afghanistan, Cuba and many other places.
target: Nagbayag daytoy iti uppat a pulo a tawen ken panaglaban a napaypayso, dagiti proxy nga armada, ti paglalabanan sipud iti Africa agingga iti Asia, iti Afghanistan, Cuba ken iti nadumaduma pay a lugar.

source: Translate this sentence from eng to ilo: By September 17, 1939, the Polish defense was already broken, and the only hope was to retreat and reorganise along the Romanian bridgehead.
target: Idi Setiembre 17, 1939, ti depensa ti Polish ket nadadaelen, ket ti isu laeng a namnamada ket ti panagatras ken agplastar manen idiay birdgehead iti Romania.

source: Translate this sentence from eng to ilo: However, these plans were rendered obsolete nearly overnight, when over 800,000 soldiers from the Soviet's Union Red Army entered and created the Belarussian and Ukrainian fronts after invading the eastern regions of Poland in violation of the Riga Peace Treaty, the Soviet-Polish Non-Aggression Pact, and other international treaties, both bilateral and multilateral.
target: Nupay kasta, naawan serbinan dagitoy a plano iti dandani nagpatnag laeng, idi  dandani 800,000 a soldado manipud iti Red Army ti Soviet Union ti simrek ken nangbukel kadagiti Belarussian ken Ukraine fronts kalpasan a rautenda ti dagiti akindaya a rehion ti Poland nga isu a linabsingda ti Riga Peace Treaty, ti Soviet-Polish Non-Aggresion Pact, ken dadduma pay nga internasional a katulagan, nga agpada a bilateral ken multilateral.

source: Translate this sentence from eng to ilo: Using ships to transport goods is by far the most efficient way to move large amounts of people and goods across oceans.
target: Ti panagusar ti barko tapno iyakar dagiti tagilako ket isu ti kasayaatan a pamay-an tapno maiyakar dagiti dadakkel a gatad ti tao ken tagilako iti ballasiw taaw.

source: Translate this sentence from eng to ilo: The job of navies has traditionally been to ensure that your country maintains the ability to move your people and goods, while at the same time, interfering with your enemy's ability to move his people and goods.
target: Ti ubra dagiti navy ket kadawyanna a masiguro a ti pagilian ket agnaed iti kabaelanna a maiyakar dagiti tattao ken tagilako, kabayatanna, pakibiangan ti kabaelan ti kaapam a mangiyakar ti tattaona ken tagilako.

source: Translate this sentence from eng to ilo: One of the most noteworthy recent examples of this was the North Atlantic campaign of WWII. The Americans were trying to move men and materials across the Atlantic Ocean to help Britain.
target: Ti maysa kadagiti makapainteres a kaspagarigan daytoy iti nabiit a panawen pay laeng ket ti kampanya iti Amianan nga Atlantika para WWII. Padasen dagiti Amerikano nga iyakar dagiti lallaki ken materiales a bumallasiw iti Baybay Atlantiko tapno tumulong idiay Britania.

source: Translate this sentence from eng to ilo: At the same time, the German navy, using mainly U-boats, was trying to stop this traffic.
target: Kagiddanna, ti German ga navy, nga agus-usar laeng ti bangka nga U, ket padpadasenna a pasardengen daytoy a trapiko.

source: Translate this sentence from eng to ilo: Had the Allies failed, Germany probably would have been able to conquer Britain as it had the rest of Europe.
target: No saan koma a nagballigi ti Allies, mabalin a naparmek koma ti Germany ti Britania ta addan iti daytoy ti amin a paset ti Europa.

source: Translate this sentence from eng to ilo: Goats seem to have been first domesticated roughly 10,000 years ago in the Zagros Mountains of Iran.
target: Mabalin nga immuna a napaamo dagiti kalding agarup 10,000 a tawenen ti napalabas iti Kabambantayan ti Zagros iti Iran.

source: Translate this sentence from eng to ilo: Ancient cultures and tribes began to keep them for easy access to milk, hair, meat, and skins.
target: Dagiti kadaanan a kultura ken dagiti tribu ket nangrugi a nangtaraken kadakuada tapno adda ti nalaka a pangalaanda ti gatas, buok, karne, ken lalat.

source: Translate this sentence from eng to ilo: Domestic goats were generally kept in herds that wandered on hills or other grazing areas, often tended by goatherds who were frequently children or adolescents, similar to the more widely known shepherd. These methods of herding are still used today.
target: Dagiti taraken a kalding ket kadawyanna a maiwarwar kas arban ken mapabus-oyanda a mapan kadagiti turod ken dadduma pay a pagaraban, nga ubbing wenno agtutubo ti masansan a mangiturong kadakuada, kas iti ar-aramiden ti pastor ti karnero a mas pamiliar iti adu. Maar-aramid pay laeng ita ti kasta a pamay-an ti panagipastor kadagiti kalding.

source: Translate this sentence from eng to ilo: Wagonways were built in England as early as the 16th Century.
target: Nasapa a naaramid ti Wagonways idiay England idi maika-16 a siglo.

source: Translate this sentence from eng to ilo: Although wagonways merely consisted of parallel planks of wood, they allowed horses pulling them to achieve greater speeds and pull larger loads than on the slightly more rough roads of the day.
target: Uray pay no dagiti dalan ti bagon ket naaramid laeng babaen kadagiti tabla a kayo, pinalubosanda dagiti kabalio a mangguyod kadakuada tapno magun-od ti kinapaspas ken maguyod ti dadakkel pay nga awit uray pay no madalanan dagiti lasong-lasong a dalan iti aldaw.

source: Translate this sentence from eng to ilo: Crossties were introduced fairly early to hold the tracks in place. Gradually, however, it was realised that tracks would be more efficient if they had a stip of iron on the top.
target: Dagiti crosstie ket naipakaammo a nasapa tapno iplastar dagiti track. Ngem, idi bumaybayag, napalutpot a namaymayat met laeng no adda ti landokna iti ngato.

source: Translate this sentence from eng to ilo: This became common practice, but the iron caused more wear on the wooden wheels of the wagons.
target: Nagbalinen a gagangay nga aramid daytoy, ngem ti landok ti nakaigapu iti ad-adda a pannakarunot ti kayo a ligay dagiti karison.

source: Translate this sentence from eng to ilo: Eventually, wooden wheels were replaced by iron wheels. In 1767, the first full-iron rails were introduced.
target: Idi agangay, nasuktan dagiti pilid a kayo iti pilid a landok. Idi 1767, nayam-ammo ti umuna a riles a landok amin ti pannakaaramidna .

source: Translate this sentence from eng to ilo: The first known transportation was walking, humans began walking upright two million years ago with the emergence of Homo Erectus (meaning upright man).
target: Ti umuna a transportasion ket babaen iti pannagna, dagiti tao ket nangrugi a nagnagna a nakatakder dua a milion a tawenen ti napalaban ti panagruar ti Homo Erectus (kayatna sawen nakatakder a tao).

source: Translate this sentence from eng to ilo: Their predecessors, the Australopithecus did not walk upright as habitually.
target: Dagiti immun-una kadakuada, dagiti Australopithecus ket saan a nagna a nakatakder a kas kaugalian.

source: Translate this sentence from eng to ilo: Bipedal specializations are found in Australopithecus fossils from 4.2-3.9 million years ago, although Sahelanthropus may have walked on two legs as early as seven million years ago.
target: Nasarakan dagiti ti naisangayan a kabaelan pannakapagna babaen ti dua a saka kadagiti fossil nga Australopithecus a 4.2-3.9 milion a tawenen ti napalabas, uray no ti Sahelanthropus ket mabalin a nagna iti dua a sakana iti kas kasapa a pito a milion a tawen ti napalabas.

source: Translate this sentence from eng to ilo: We can start living more friendly to the environment, we can join to the environmental movement, and we can even be activists in order to reduce the future suffering in some degree.
target: Mabalintayo nga agbiag a mannakigayyem iti aglawlaw, mabalintayo a tumulad iti panaggaraw ti aglawlaw, ken mabalintayo nga ag-aktibista tapno ad-adda a maliklikan ti panagsagaba ti masakbayan.

source: Translate this sentence from eng to ilo: This is just like symptomatic treatment in many cases. However, if we do not only want a temporary solution, then we should find the root of the problems, and we should deactivate them.
target: Daytoy ket kasla mangipasimudaag a panangagas ti kaduanna. Ngem no saantayo a kayat ti temporario a solusion, mapantayo ngarud kitaen ti puon dagita problema, ket rumbeng nga intayo ida ikkaten.

source: Translate this sentence from eng to ilo: It is obvious enough that the world has changed much because of humankind's scientific and technological advancements, and problems have become greater because of overpopulation and mankind's extravagant lifestyle.
target: Nalawag a nagbalbaliwen ti lubong gapu ta dagiti sientipiko ken teknolohikal a pagsayaatan dagiti tattao, ken dagiti problema ket dimmakelen gapu iti panagado unay iti populasion ken nangina a panagbiag dagiti tattao.

source: Translate this sentence from eng to ilo: After its adoption by Congress on July 4, a handwritten draft signed by the President of Congress John Hancock and the Secretary Charles Thomson was then sent a few blocks away to the printing shop of John Dunlap.
target: Kalpasan ti pannakaipasana ti Kongreso idi 4 ti Hunio, maysa nga insurat ti ima a draft a pinirmaan ti Presidente ti Kongresso a ni John Hancock ken ni Sekretaryo Charles Thomson ket naipaw-it iti asideg a pag-imprentaan ni John Dunlap.

source: Translate this sentence from eng to ilo: Through the night between 150 and 200 copies were made, now known as "Dunlap broadsides".
target: Iti agpatnag iti 150 agingga iti 200 a kopia ti naaramid, maaw-awagan ita a “Dunlap broadsides”.

source: Translate this sentence from eng to ilo: The first public reading of the document was by John Nixon in the yard of Independence Hall on July 8.
target: Ti umuna a panagbasa para iti publiko ti dokumento ket inaramid ni John Nixon idiay paraangan ti Independence Hall idi July 8.

source: Translate this sentence from eng to ilo: One was sent to George Washington on July 6, who had it read to his troops in New York on July 9. A copy reached London on August 10.
target: Maysa ti naipatulod ken ni George Washington idi Hulio 6, a nangipabasa iti daytoy kadagiti tropana iti New York idi Hulio 9. Maysa a kopia ti nakadanon iti London idi Agosto 10.

source: Translate this sentence from eng to ilo: The 25 Dunlap broadsides still known to exist are the oldest surviving copies of the document. The original handwritten copy has not survived.
target: Dagiti 25 a Dunlap broadside nga am-ammo nga adda pay laeng isuda dagiti kadadaanan a nakalasat a kopia ti dokumento. Saan a nakalasat ti orihinal a kopia a naisurat iti ima.

source: Translate this sentence from eng to ilo: Many paleontologists today believe that one group of dinosaurs survived and is alive today. We call them birds.
target: Ado a paleontolohista ita ti mamati a maysa a grupo ti dinosaur ti nakalasat ken sisibiag ita. Awa-wagentay ida a tumaytayab.

source: Translate this sentence from eng to ilo: Many people don't think about them as dinosaurs because they have feathers and can fly.
target: Adu kadagiti tattao a saanda panunoten a dinosaurda gapu ta adda iti dutdotda ken makatayabda.

source: Translate this sentence from eng to ilo: But there are a lot of things about birds that still look like a dinosaur.
target: Ngem adda ti adu a banag nga addaan kadagiti billit a kapadpada dagiti dinosaur.

source: Translate this sentence from eng to ilo: They have feet with scales and claws, they lay eggs, and they walk on their two back legs like a T-Rex.
target: Adda sakada nga addaan kadagiti siksik ken karamut, agitlogda, ken magnada nga usarenda ti dua nga akinlikud a sakada a kas ti T-Rex.

source: Translate this sentence from eng to ilo: Virtually all computers in use today are based on the manipulation of information which is coded in the form of binary numbers.
target: Dandani amin a kompiuter a maus-usar iti agdama ti naibasar iti pannakamanipula ti impormasion a naisurat iti wagas dagiti binary a numero.

source: Translate this sentence from eng to ilo: A binary number can have only one of two values, i.e. 0 or 1, and these numbers are referred to as binary digits - or bits, to use computer jargon.
target: Ti maysa a binary a numero ket mabalin laeng a maaddaan iti dua a pateg, isu ti 0 wenno 1, ken dagitoy a numero maawaganda a binary a digit, wenno bits, no usaren ti panagsarsarita a para iti kompiuter.

source: Translate this sentence from eng to ilo: Internal poisoning may not be immediately apparent. Symptoms, such as vomiting are sufficiently general that an immediate diagnosis cannot be made.
target: Ti pannakasabidong iti uneg ket mabalin a saan a dagus a marikna. Dagiti simtomas, kas panagsarua ket mabalin a sabali isu a ti dagus a pannakapalutpot ket saan a maaramid.

source: Translate this sentence from eng to ilo: The best indication of internal poisoning may be the presence of an open container of medication or toxic household chemicals.
target: Ti kangrunaan a pagilasinan ti internal a pannakasabidong ket ti kaadda ti nakalukat a pagyanan ti agas wenno dagiti makasabidong a kemikal a maus-usar iti balay.

source: Translate this sentence from eng to ilo: Check the label for specific first aid instructions for that specific poison.
target: Kitaem ti etiketana para iti umiso a panangipakat ti first aid para iti naibaga a sabidong.

source: Translate this sentence from eng to ilo: The term bug is used by entomologists in a formal sense for this group of insects.
target: Ti termino a bug ket usaren dagiti entomoloho iti pormal a pamay-an para kadagitoy a grupo ti insekto.

source: Translate this sentence from eng to ilo: This term derives from ancient familiarity with Bed-bugs, which are insects highly adapted to parasitize humans.
target: Naggapu daytoy a termino iti nagkauna a pannakaammo kadagiti Kiteb, dagiti insekto a nalaka nga agbalin a parasito kadagiti tattao.

source: Translate this sentence from eng to ilo: Both Assassin-bugs and Bed-bugs are nidicolous, adapted to living in nest or housing of their host.
target: Agpada a ti asasino a timel ken ti kiteb ket agnaed iti aponda, nairuamdan nga agbiag iti umokda wenno agnaedda iti pagbibiaganda.

source: Translate this sentence from eng to ilo: Across the United States of America, there are approximately 400,000 known cases of Multiple Sclerosis (MS), leaving it as the leading neurological disease in younger and middle aged adults.
target: Iti pakabuklan ti Estados Unidos ti Amerika, adda iti agarup 400,000 a naammuan a kaso ti Multiple Sclerosis (MS), a namagbalin a kangrunaan a sakit a neurolohikal kadagiti naubbing ken apagtengnga ti edadna a nataengan.

source: Translate this sentence from eng to ilo: MS is a disease that affects the central nervous system, which is made up of the brain, the spinal cord and the optic nerve.
target: Maysa a sakit t MS a makaapektar iti sentro ti a sistema ti nerbios, a pakairamanan ti utek, duri ken dagiti urat ti mata.

source: Translate this sentence from eng to ilo: Research has found that females are two times more likely to have MS then males.
target: Naduktalan iti panagsukisok a mamindua a daras a mabalin a maaddaan iti MS dagiti babbai ngem dagiti lallaki.

source: Translate this sentence from eng to ilo: A couple may decide it is not in their best interest, or in the interest of their child, to raise a baby.
target: Ti agassawa ket mabalin a agdesision no daytoy ket saan a para iti pagsayaatanda, wenno no pagsayaatan ti anakda, ti panangpadakkel ti ubing.

source: Translate this sentence from eng to ilo: These couples may choose to make an adoption plan for their baby.
target: Dagitoy nga agkada ket mabalin nga agaramid iti plano ti panagampon para iti anakda.

source: Translate this sentence from eng to ilo: In an adoption, the birth parents terminate their parental rights so that another couple may parent the child.
target: Iti panagampon, ikkatenen dagiti nagipasngay a nagannak dagiti karbenganda a kas nagannak tapno mabalin ti sabali nga agassawa ti agbalin a nagannak ti ubing.

source: Translate this sentence from eng to ilo: Science’s main goal is to figure out the way the world works through the scientific method. This method in fact guides most scientific research.
target: Ti kangrunaan a gandat ti siensia ket ammuen no kasano ti panagtaray ti lubong bayat ti panagusar ti pamay-an a sientipiko. Daytoy a pamay-an ket mangtartarigagay iti kaaduan a panagadal a sientipiko.

source: Translate this sentence from eng to ilo: It isn’t alone though, experimentation, and an experiment is a test that is used to eliminate one or more of the possible hypotheses, asking questions, and making observations also guide scientific research.
target: Ngem saan la a dayta, eksperimentasion pay, maysa a pannubok ti eksperimento a mausar tapno maikkat ti maysa wenno ad-adu pay a mabalin a pattapatta, panagsaludsod, ken panagpaliiw ket mangiturong pay a sientipiko a panagsukisok.

source: Translate this sentence from eng to ilo: Naturalists and philosophers focused on classical texts and, in particular, on the Bible in Latin.
target: Nakapokus dagiti naturalista ken pilosopo kadagiti klasikal a teksto ken, partikular, iti Biblia iti Latin.

source: Translate this sentence from eng to ilo: Accepted were Aristotle's views on all matters of science, including psychology.
target: Naawat dagiti kapanunotan ni Aristotle iti amin a bambanag maipapan iti siensia, a pakairamanan ti sikolohia.

source: Translate this sentence from eng to ilo: As knowledge of Greek declined, the West found itself cut off from its Greek philosophical and scientific roots.
target: Iti ibabassit ti pannakaammo iti Greek, nasarakan ti Laud ti bagbagina a naputeden manipud iti nagramutanna a pilosopikal ken sientipiko a Greek.

source: Translate this sentence from eng to ilo: Many observed rhythms in physiology and behavior often crucially depend on the presence of endogenous cycles and their production through biological clocks.
target: Adu a maobserbaran a ritmo iti pisiolohia ken ugali ket masansan a napateg a nakadepende iti presensia ti siklo nga endogenous ken ti panagpa-aduda babaen iti orasan a biolohikal.

source: Translate this sentence from eng to ilo: Periodic rhythms, which are not simply responses to external periodic cues, have been documented for most living beings, including bacteria, fungi, plants, and animals.
target: Dagiti ritmo a periodiko, a saan laeng a simple a sungbat para kadagiti nakinruar a signal, ken naidokumento para iti kaaduan a sibibiag a parsua, agraman dagiti bakteria, fungi, mula, ken animal.

source: Translate this sentence from eng to ilo: Biological clocks are self sustaining oscillators which will continue a period of free-running cycling even in the absence of external cues.
target: Mangtaginayon kadagiti bukbukodna nga oscillator dagiti biolohikal a pagorasan nga agtultuloy iti maysa a panawen nga is-isuna nga agan-andar uray awan ti mangpagaraw.

source: Translate this sentence from eng to ilo: The Hershey and Chase experiment was one of the leading suggestions that DNA was a genetic material.
target: Ti eksperimento ti Hershey ken Chase iti maysa kadagiti nalatak nga agibagbaga a ti DNA ket genetiko a material.

source: Translate this sentence from eng to ilo: Hershey and Chase used phages, or viruses, to implant their own DNA into a bacterium.
target: Ni Hershey ken Chase ket nagusar ti mikrobio, wenno birus, tapno maimulada ti bukodda a DNA idiay bakteria.

source: Translate this sentence from eng to ilo: They did two experiments marking either the DNA in the phage with a radioactive phosphorus or the protein of the phage with radioactive sulfur.
target: Nagaramidda ti dua nga ekperimento a nangmarka iti DNA ti phage nga addaan iti radioactive phosphorus wenno ti protina iti phage nga addaan ti radioactive sulfur.

source: Translate this sentence from eng to ilo: Mutations can have a variety of different effects depending on the type of mutation, the significance of the piece of genetic material affected and whether the cells affected are germ-line cells.
target: Adda mabalin a nadumaduma nga epekto dagiti mutation depende iti klase ti mutation, ti kinapateg ti piraso ti genetiko a material a naapektaran ken no dagiti selula ket naapektaranna dagiti selula a germ-line.

source: Translate this sentence from eng to ilo: Only mutations in germ-line cells can be passed on to children, while mutations elsewhere can cause cell-death or cancer.
target: Dagiti laeng mutation ti selula iti germline ti mabalin a maipatawid kadagiti annak, ngem dagiti mutation ti sabali pay a lugar ket makaigapu iti pannakatay ti selula wenno kanser.

source: Translate this sentence from eng to ilo: Nature-based tourism attracts people interested in visiting natural areas for the purpose of enjoying the scenery, including plant and animal wildlife.
target: Ti Nature-based Tourism ket mangawis kadagiti tattao nga interesado iti panagbisita kadagiti natural a lugar para iti panagragsak kadagiti makitkita, pakairamanan ti mulmula ken ay-ayup.

source: Translate this sentence from eng to ilo: Examples of on-site activities include hunting, fishing, photography, bird watching, and visiting parks and studying information about the ecosystem.
target: Dagiti pagarigan dagiti aktibidad ti lugar iramanna ti panaganup, panagbanniit, panaglitrato, panagbuya ti bilbillit, ken panagbisita kadagiti parke ken panagadal ti impormasion maipapan iti ekosistema.

source: Translate this sentence from eng to ilo: An example is visiting, photographing, and learning about organgatuangs in Borneo.
target: Pagarigan ti panangbisita panangretrato, ken panangammo maipapan kadagiti orangutan idiay Borneo.

source: Translate this sentence from eng to ilo: Every morning, people leave small country towns in cars to go their workplace and are passed by others whose work destination is the place they have just left.
target: Kada bigat, agluglugan dagiti tattao nga aggapo iti babassit nga ili a mapan kadagiti pagubraanda ken kasinnabat dagiti tao a ti pagubraanna ket ti lugar a naggapuanda laeng.

source: Translate this sentence from eng to ilo: In this dynamic transport shuttle everyone is somehow connected with, and supporting, a transport system based on private cars.
target: Iti daytoy a dinamiko a pagluganan a pagitulod nga amin a tao ket kas man nakakonektar, ken mangsupsuporta, iti maysa a sistema ti transportasion a naibasar kadagiti pribado a lugan.

source: Translate this sentence from eng to ilo: Science now indicates that this massive carbon economy has dislodged the biosphere from one of its stable states that has supported human evolution for the past two million years.
target: Ibaga itatta ti sensia a ti dakkel nga ekonomia ti karbon ket pinapanawna ti biospere iti nalagda nga estadona a simmuporta iti ebolusion ti tattao iti napalabas a dua a milion a tawen.

source: Translate this sentence from eng to ilo: Everyone participates in society and uses transportation systems. Almost everyone complains about transportation systems.
target: Makiraman amin iti kagimongan ken mangusar ti sistema ti transportasion. Dandani amin ket agreklamo maipapan iti sistema ti transportasion.

source: Translate this sentence from eng to ilo: In developed countries you seldom hear similar levels of complaints about water quality or bridges falling down.
target: Iti nababaknang a pagilian ket manmano a mangeg ti agpapada a reklamo maipapan iti kalidad ti danum wenno rangtay a madaddadael.

source: Translate this sentence from eng to ilo: Why do transportation systems engender such complaints, why do they fail on a daily basis? Are transportation engineers just incompetent? Or is something more fundamental going on?
target: Apay a dagiti sistema ti pagluganan ket agaramidda ti kasta nga reklamo, apay a saanda a mapaayda iti inaldaw? Awan kadi ti sirbi dagiti inheniero ti pagluganan? Wenno adda pay napatpateg a bambanag?

source: Translate this sentence from eng to ilo: Traffic Flow is the study of the movement of individual drivers and vehicles between two points and the interactions they make with one another.
target: Ti kinaurnos ti Trapiko ket isu ti panagadal ti garaw ti saggaysa a mangiturturong ken luglugan iti nagbaet ti dua a punto ken dagiti interaksion nga araramidenda iti maysa ken maysa.

source: Translate this sentence from eng to ilo: Unfortunately, studying traffic flow is difficult because driver behavior cannot be predicted with one-hundred percent certainty.
target: No man pay kasta, ti panagadal iti urnos ti trapiko ket narigat gapu iti ugali ti agmanmaneho ket sigurado a saan a mapugtuan iti sangagasut a porsiento.

source: Translate this sentence from eng to ilo: Fortunately, drivers tend to behave within a reasonably consistent range; thus, traffic streams tend to have some reasonable consistency and can be roughly represented mathematically.
target: Pagsayaatanna, agtungpal dagiti agmanmaneho iti ikub ti nainkalintegan a nga agtutunos a sakup; isu nga addan met dagiti agus ti trapiko iti nainkalintegan a panagtutunos ken mabalin a mailadawan babaen iti matematika.

source: Translate this sentence from eng to ilo: To better represent traffic flow, relationships have been established between the three main characteristics: (1) flow, (2) density, and (3) velocity.
target: Tapno maipakita a nasaysayaat ti urnos ti luglugan, dagiti relasion ket napatalgedan ti nagbaetan dagiti tallo a kangrunaan a pakaidumaan: (1) urnos, (2) kinaadu, ken (3) kinapartak.

source: Translate this sentence from eng to ilo: These relationships help in planning, design, and operations of roadway facilities.
target: Makatulong dagitoy a relasion iti panagplano, disenio, ken panangpataray kadagiti pasilidad ti kalsada.

source: Translate this sentence from eng to ilo: Insects were the first animals to take to the air. Their ability to fly helped them evade enemies more easily and find food and mates more efficiently.
target: Dagiti insekto ti kaunaan a tumatayab. Ti abilidadda a tumayab ti nakatulong kadakuada tapno nadardaras a makalibas kadagiti kalabanda ken epektibo a makasapul ti makan ken kapareha.

source: Translate this sentence from eng to ilo: Most insects have the advantage of being able to fold their wings back along the body.
target: Kaaduan nga insekto ti adda pagsayaatanna ti kabaelanda a mangkupin kadagiti payyakda a mangisubli a paurnos iti bagida.

source: Translate this sentence from eng to ilo: This gives them a wider range of small places to hide from predators.
target: Mangted daytoy kadakuada ti nalawlawa a lugar tapno makalemmengda kadagiti mabalin a mangan kadakuada.

source: Translate this sentence from eng to ilo: Today, the only insects that cannot fold back their wings are dragon flies and mayflies.
target: Itatta, ti kakaisuna nga insekto a saan a makupin palikod ket dagiti tuwato ken dagiti mayfly.

source: Translate this sentence from eng to ilo: Thousands of years ago, a man called Aristarchus said that the Solar System moved around the Sun.
target: Rinibu a tawenen ti naglabas, maysa a tao a naawagan kas Aristarchus ti mangibaga a ti Sistema a Solar ket agrikus iti aglawlaw ti Init.

source: Translate this sentence from eng to ilo: Some people thought he was right but many people believed the opposite; that the Solar System moved around the Earth, including the Sun (and even the other stars).
target: Napanunot ti dadduma a tattao nga umiso isuna ngem adu a tao ti mamati a saan; a ti Sistema a Solar ket aggaraw a manglawlaw iti Lubong, kadua ti Init (ken ti dadduma pay a bituen).

source: Translate this sentence from eng to ilo: This seems sensible, because the Earth doesn't feel as if it's moving, does it?
target: Kasla agpayso daytoy, gapu ta saan a marikna a kasla aggargaraw ti Lubong, saan kadi?

source: Translate this sentence from eng to ilo: The Amazon River is the second longest and the biggest river on Earth. It carries more than 8 times as much water as the second biggest river.
target: Ti Karayan Amazon ti maikadua a kaatiddogan ken ti kadadakkelan a karayan iti Daga. Addaan iti nasurok a walo a daras nga ad-adu a danum ngem iti maikadua a kadakkelan a karayan.

source: Translate this sentence from eng to ilo: The Amazon is also the widest river on Earth, at times six miles wide.
target: Ti Amazon pay ti kalalawaan a karayan iti Daga, nga iti kalawaan a pasetna addaan iti innem a milia a kalawa.

source: Translate this sentence from eng to ilo: A full 20 percent of the water that pours out of the planet's rivers into the oceans comes from the Amazon.
target: Maysa a sibubukel a 20 a porsiento ti danum a mairuruar manipud kadagiti karayan ti planeta a mapan kadagiti baybay ket aggapu iti Amazon.

source: Translate this sentence from eng to ilo: The main Amazon River is 6,387 km (3,980 miles). It collects water from thousands of smaller rivers.
target: Ti sentro ti Karayan Amazon ket 6,387 km (3,980 milia). Unongenna dagiti danum nga aggapu iti nadumaduma pay a babassit a karayan.

source: Translate this sentence from eng to ilo: Although pyramid-building in stone continued until the end of the Old Kingdom, the pyramids of Giza were never surpassed in their size and the technical excellence of their construction.
target: Uray no ti pagaramid iti piramida babaen ti bato ket nagtultuloy agingga iti Daan a Pagarian, dagiti piramida iti Giza ket saanna naartapan ti kinadakkelna ken ti nagsayaat a pannakaaramidna.

source: Translate this sentence from eng to ilo: New Kingdom ancient Egyptians marvelled at their predecessors monuments, which were then well over a thousand year old.
target: Nasdaaw dagiti nagkauna nga Egyptian ti Baro a Pagarian kadagiti monumento dagiti immun-una kadakuada, nga idi ket agedad iti nasurok a sangaribun a tawen.

source: Translate this sentence from eng to ilo: Vatican City's population is around 800. It is the smallest independent country in the world and the country with the lowest population.
target: Ti populasion ti Vatican City ket agarup 800. Daytoy ti kabassitan a nawaya a pagilian iti lubong ken ti pagilian nga addaanti kabassitan a populasion.

source: Translate this sentence from eng to ilo: Vatican City uses Italian in its legislation and official communications.
target: Italian ti usar ti Siudad ti Vatican a pagsasao iti lehislatura ken kadagti opisial a komunikasionda.

source: Translate this sentence from eng to ilo: Italian is also the everyday language used by most of those who work in the state while Latin is often used in religious ceremonies.
target: Ti Italian met ti inaldaw a panagsasao nga us-usaren ti kaaduan kadagidiay agtabtrabaho ket Latin met ti masansan a mausar kadagiti relihioso a seremonia.

source: Translate this sentence from eng to ilo: All citizens of Vatican City are Roman Catholic.
target: Amin nga agnanaed iti Vatican City ket Romano Katoliko.

source: Translate this sentence from eng to ilo: People have known about basic chemical elements such as gold, silver, and copper from antiquity, as these can all be discovered in nature in native form and are relatively simple to mine with primitive tools.
target: Ammon dagiti tattao ti maipapan iti kangrunaan nga elemento a kemikal kaspagarigan balitok, pirak, ken tanso manipud pay laeng idi un-unana, ta mabirukan laeng dagitoy iti aglawlaw ken nalaka a minasen uray no dagiti nagkauna nga rimienta.

source: Translate this sentence from eng to ilo: Aristotle, a philosopher, theorised that everything is made up of a mixture of one or more of four elements. They were earth, water, air, and fire.
target: Ni Aristotle, maysa a pilosopo, ket nangiteoria nga amin a banag ket nabukel gapu ti panaglalaok ti maysa wenno ad-adu pay kadagiti uppat nga elemento. Dagitoy ket daga, danum, angin, ken apoy.

source: Translate this sentence from eng to ilo: This was more like the four states of matter (in the same order): solid, liquid, gas, and plasma, though he also theorised that they change into new substances to form what we see.
target: Daytoy ket kasla kadagiti uppat nga estado ti banag (ti agpada nga urnos): solido, likido, gas, ken plasma, uray pay impagarupna nga agsabalida nga agbalin iti baro a substansia tapno mabukel dayta intayo makita.

source: Translate this sentence from eng to ilo: Alloys are basically a mixture of two or more metals. Don't forget that there are many elements on the periodic table.
target: Dagiti alloy ket naglaok a dua wenno ad-du pay a metal. Saanmo a liplipatan nga adu dagiti metal itiperiodic table.

source: Translate this sentence from eng to ilo: Elements like calcium and potassium are considered metals. Of course, there are also metals like silver and gold.
target: Maibilang a metal dagiti elemento a kas iti calcium ken potassium. Siempre, adda met dagiti metal a kas iti pirak ken balitok.

source: Translate this sentence from eng to ilo: You can also have alloys that include small amounts of non-metallic elements like carbon.
target: Mabalin ti maaddaan met kadagiti alloy nga addaan babassit a laokna a saan a metal nga elemento a kas iti carbon.

source: Translate this sentence from eng to ilo: Everything in the Universe is made of matter. All matter is made of tiny particles called atoms.
target: Naaramid iti matter ti amin a banag nga adda iti Uniberso. Amin a matter, naaramid kadagiti babassit a particle a maawagan iti atomo.

source: Translate this sentence from eng to ilo: Atoms are so incredibly tiny that trillions of them could fit into the period at the end of this sentence.
target: Nakabasbassit la unay dagiti atom ket trilones kadakuada ti mabalin a malaon ti tulnek a masarakan iti ngudo daytoy a sentensia.

source: Translate this sentence from eng to ilo: Thus, the pencil was a good friend to many people when it came out.
target: Gapuna, ti lapis ket imbilang dagiti tattao kas gayyem.

source: Translate this sentence from eng to ilo: Sadly, as newer methods of writing have emerged, the pencil has been relegated to lesser status and uses.
target: Makapaladingit, bayat ti panagruar ti baro a wagas ti panagsurat, ti lapis ket saanen unay a maus-usar.

source: Translate this sentence from eng to ilo: People now write messages on computer screens, never having to come close to a sharpener.
target: Dagiti tattao itatta ket agsuratda laengen babaen ti kompiuter ket saanda pay ketdin a masagid ti pagtahar.

source: Translate this sentence from eng to ilo: One can only wonder what the keyboard will become when something newer comes along.
target: Awan ti makaibaga iti pagbalinan ti keyboard no adda ti sumangpet a baro.

source: Translate this sentence from eng to ilo: The fission bomb works on the principle that it takes energy to put together a nucleus with many protons and neutrons.
target: Agobra ti fission bomb babaen ti prinsipio a kasapulan ti enerhia tapno maaramid maysa a nucleus nga addaan iti adu a proton ken neutron.

source: Translate this sentence from eng to ilo: Sort of like rolling a heavy cart up a hill. Splitting the nucleus up again then releases some of that energy.
target: Kasla mangipatulid iti nadagsen a kariton a pasang-at iti turod. Ti panangsina manen iti nucleus ket mangiparuar iti dadduma kadagita nga enerhia.

source: Translate this sentence from eng to ilo: Some atoms have unstable nuclei which means that they tend to break apart with little or no nudging.
target: Addaan kadagiti narukop a nucleus ti sumagmamano nga atom a kayatna sawen ket adda labitna nga agsisinada uray iti bassit wenno uray awan panaggarawda.

source: Translate this sentence from eng to ilo: The surface of the Moon is made of rocks and dust. The outer layer of the Moon is called the crust.
target: Ti rabaw ti Bulan ket naaramid iti batbato ken tapok. Iti nakinruar a rabaw ti Bulan ket maaw-awagan a crust.

source: Translate this sentence from eng to ilo: The crust is about 70 km thick on the near side and 100 km thick on the far side.
target: Agarup 70 km ti kapuskol ti crust iti asideg a bangirna ken 100 km ti kapuskolna iti adayo a bangirna.

source: Translate this sentence from eng to ilo: It is thinner under the maria and thicker under the highlands.
target: Naing-ingpis iti sirok ti maria ken napuspuskol iti sirok ti nangato a daga.

source: Translate this sentence from eng to ilo: There may be more maria on the near side because the crust is thinner. It was easier for lava to rise up to the surface.
target: Mabalin nga ad-adu ti maria iti asideg ti igidna ta naing-ingpis ti dagana. Nalaklaka nga agpangato ti lava iti rabaw.

source: Translate this sentence from eng to ilo: Content theories are centered on finding what makes people tick or appeals to them.
target: Nakasentro dagiti content theory iti panangsukimat no ania ti makatignay kadagiti tattao wenno no ania ti magustuanda.

source: Translate this sentence from eng to ilo: These theories suggest that people have certain needs and/or desires which have been internalized as they mature to adulthood.
target: Isingasing dagitoy a teoria nga adda dagiti naipangruna a kasapulan dagiti tattao ken/wenno dagiti tarigagay a makairuamanda kabayatan ti panagtaengda.

source: Translate this sentence from eng to ilo: These theories look at what it is about certain people that make them want the things that they do and what things in their environment will make them do or not do certain things.
target: Dagitoy a teoria ket kitkitaenda no anIa ti panggep dagiti tattao a mangpabalin kadakuada a mangayat kadagiti bambanag a kayatda ken no ania dagiti banag iti aglawlawda a mangpabalin kadakuada nga aramiden wenno haan dagiti banbanag.

source: Translate this sentence from eng to ilo: Two popular content theories are Maslow's Hierarchy of Needs Theory and Hertzberg's Two Factor Theory.
target: Dua a kalalatakan a teoria ket ti teoria ti Maslow's Heirarchy of Needs ken Teorya ti Two Factor ni Herzberg.

source: Translate this sentence from eng to ilo: Generally speaking, two behaviors can emerge as managers begin to lead their former peers. One end of the spectrum is trying to remain “one of the guys” (or gals).
target: Iti gagangay a sarita, iti dua a galad ket mabalin nga agtaud bayat ti panagiyun-una dagiti manager iti dati a kakaduada. Ti maysa a pungto ti bambanag ket ti panangipadas nga agbalin a “maysa kadagiti lallaki” (wenno babbai).

source: Translate this sentence from eng to ilo: This type of manager has difficulty making unpopular decisions, performing disciplinary action, performance evaluations, assigning responsibility, and holding people accountable.
target: Marigatan daytoy a tipo ti manarawidwid a mangaramid kadagiti narikut a desision, panangdisiplina, panangamiris iti panagtrabaho, panangted iti responsibilidad, ken panangpasungbat kadagiti tattaona.

source: Translate this sentence from eng to ilo: At the other end of the spectrum, one morphs into an unrecognizable individual that feels he or she must change everything the team has been doing and make it their own.
target: Iti maysa a ngudo ti ispektrum, maysa ket agbalbaliw a mapan iti saan a maamammo nga indibidual a makarekna a masapulna a balbaliwan amin a naaramidna iti grupo ket pagbalinenna a bukodna.

source: Translate this sentence from eng to ilo: After all, the leader is ultimately responsible for the success and failure of the team.
target: Kalpasan ti amin, ti lider ti talaga a responsable para iti panagballigi wenno pannakapaay iti grupo.

source: Translate this sentence from eng to ilo: This behavior oftentimes results in rifts between the leaders and the rest of the team.
target: Daytoy nga ugali ket masansan a resultaiti di-pagkikinnaawatan dagiti lider ken dagiti dadduma a miembro ti grupo.

source: Translate this sentence from eng to ilo: Virtual teams are held to the same standards of excellence as conventional teams, but there are subtle differences.
target: Dagiti pinartuat a grupo ket addaan iti agpada a pagalagadan a kas gagangay a grupo, ngem adda met ti saan a madlaw a nagdumaanda.

source: Translate this sentence from eng to ilo: Virtual team members often function as the point of contact for their immediate physical group.
target: Dagiti miembro ti birtual a grupo ket agtrabtrabaho a kas punto ti panagsarita para iti kangrunaan a pisikal a grupoda.

source: Translate this sentence from eng to ilo: They often have more autonomy than conventional team members as their teams may meet according to varying time zones which may not be understood by their local management.
target: Masansan a nawaywayada ngem kadagiti gagangay a miembro ti grupo gapu ta mabalin dagiti grupoda ti agtataripnong segun kadagiti agduduma a time zone kadagiti ayanda a mabalin a saan a maawatan ti lokal nga agmanmanehar kadakuada.

source: Translate this sentence from eng to ilo: The presence of a true “invisible team” (Larson and LaFasto, 1989, p109) is also a unique component of a virtual team.
target: Ti kaadda iti agpayso a “saan a makitkita a grupo” (Larson ken LaFasto, 1989, p109) ket maysa met a naiduma a paset ti birtual a grupo.

source: Translate this sentence from eng to ilo: The “invisible team” is the management team to which each of the members report. The invisible team sets the standards for each member.
target: Ti “saan a makita a grupo” iti bunggoy a mangimando a ti tunggal maysa a miembro ket agipadamag. Ti saan a makita a grupo ti mangipasdek ti pagalagadan para iti tunggal miembro.

source: Translate this sentence from eng to ilo: Why would an organization want to go through the time consuming process of establishing a learning organization? One goal for putting organizational learning concepts into practice is innovation.
target: Apay a kayat ti maysa nga organisasion ti agdalan iti makaibus oras a proseso ti panangipasdek iti maysa nga organisasion ti panagsursuro? Maysa a panggep ti panangipakat kadagiti konsepto ti panagsursuro ti organisasion ket panagbalbaliw.

source: Translate this sentence from eng to ilo: When all available resources are effectively used across the functional departments of an organization, creativity and ingenuity can transpire.
target: No ti amin a gameng ket epektibo a nausar iti entero a departamento iti maysa nga organisasion, agtalinaed ti kinamanagparnuay ken kinasirib.

source: Translate this sentence from eng to ilo: As a result, the process of an organization working together to overcome an obstacle can lead to a new innovative process to serve the customer's need.
target: Kas resultana, ti proseso ti organisasion ket agtitinnulong tapno malasatan dagiti lapped ken mabalin nga agresulta iti baro ken nagsayaat a proseso tapno ad-adda a maited ti talaga a kasapulan dagiti kustomer.

source: Translate this sentence from eng to ilo: Before an organization can be innovative, leadership must create a culture of innovation as well as shared knowledge and organizational learning.
target: Sakbay a mabalin a makapagbalbaliw ti maysa nga organisasIon, masapul a mangparnuaydagiti agidadaulo masapul a mangparnuayda iti kultura ti panagbalbaliw kasta met ti pagbibinglayan a pannakaammo ken organisasional a panagsursuro.

source: Translate this sentence from eng to ilo: Angel (2006), explains the Continuum approach as a method being used to help organizations reach a higher level of performance.
target: Ilawlawag ni Angel (2006) a ti panangsungad a Continuum a kas metodo a mausar tapno matulungan dagiti organisasIon a madanun ti nangatngato a patag ti panagubra.

source: Translate this sentence from eng to ilo: Neurobiological data provide physical evidence for a theoretical approach to the investigation of cognition. Therefore it narrows the research area and makes it much more exact.
target: Ti neurobiological data ket mangmangted ti pisikal nga ebidensia para iti teoretikal a panangsango iti imbestigasion iti cognition. Isu a pailetenna ti kalawa ti panagsarsarak ken pagbalinna daytoy a mas eksakto.

source: Translate this sentence from eng to ilo: The correlation between brain pathology and behaviour supports scientists in their research.
target: Ti korelasion iti nagbaetan ti patolohia ken galad ti utek ti magsupsuporta kadagiti sientipiko iti panagsukisokda.

source: Translate this sentence from eng to ilo: It has been known for a long time that different types of brain damage, traumas, lesions, and tumours affect behaviour and cause changes in some mental functions.
target: Maamuan daytoyi ti nabayagen a ti nadumaduma a klase ti pannakaperdi ti utek, trauma, sugat, ken tumor ket makaapektar iti galad ken mangitunda ti panagbalbaliw iti dadduma a taray iti panagpanpanunot.

source: Translate this sentence from eng to ilo: The rise of new technologies allows us to see and investigate brain structures and processes never seen before.
target: Ti ibabangon dagiti baro a teknolohia, palubosannatayo a mangkita ken mangsukisok dagiti istruktura ken dagiti proseso ti utek saan pay a nakitkita.

source: Translate this sentence from eng to ilo: This provides us with a lot of information and material to build simulation models which help us to understand processes in our mind.
target: Mangted daytoy iti adu nga impormasion ken materyales tapno makaaramid iti modelo ti simulasion a makatulong kadatayo a mangawat dagiti proseso iti panunot tayo.

source: Translate this sentence from eng to ilo: Although AI has a strong connotation of science fiction, AI forms a very important branch of computer science, dealing with behavior, learning and intelligent adaptation in a machine.
target: Uray no ti AI ket dakkel ti pakainaiganna iti science fiction, maysa ti AI a nakapatpateg a sanga ti computer science, a mangad adal kadagiti pamay-an ti panangikabil kadagiti ugali, sursuro, ken laing iti maysa a makina.

source: Translate this sentence from eng to ilo: Research in AI involves making machines to automate tasks that require intelligent behavior.
target: Karaman ti panagsukisok iti AI ti panagaramid kadagiti makina tapno ma-automate dagiti trabaho a kasapulan iti masirib a galad.

source: Translate this sentence from eng to ilo: Examples include control, planning and scheduling, the ability to answer customer diagnoses and questions, as well as handwriting recognition, voice and face.
target: Dagiti pagarigan ket pakairamanan ti kontrol, panagplano ken panangiskediul, ti pannakabalin nga agsungbat ti diagnosis ken damdamag dagiti kustomer, kasta met ti panangkita ti surat iti ima, boses ken rupa.

source: Translate this sentence from eng to ilo: Such things have become separate disciplines, which focus on providing solutions to real life problems.
target: Nagbalinen a nakasina a disiplina dagita a bambanag , a naitalimudok iti panangted kadagiti solusion para kadagiti pudpudno a problema iti biag.

source: Translate this sentence from eng to ilo: The AI ​​system is now often used in the fields of economics, medicine, engineering and the military, as has been built in several home computer and video game software applications.
target: Ti sistema ti AI ket masansan tattan nga us-usaren iti tay-ak ti ekonomiko, medisina, inhenieria ken iti militar, ta isu ket nakapagtakderen iti adu a kompiuter iti balay ken dagiti video game software application.

source: Translate this sentence from eng to ilo: Field trips are a large part of any classroom. Quite often a teacher would love to take her students places to which a bus trip is not an option.
target: Maysa a dakkel a paset ti aniaman a pagadalan dagiti field trip. Kankanayon a maayatan ti maysa a mannursuro a mangipan kadagiti estudiantena kadagiti lugar a saan madanon ti bus.

source: Translate this sentence from eng to ilo: Technology offers the solution with virtual field trips. Students can look at museum artifacts, visit an aquarium, or admire beautiful art while sitting with their class.
target: Mangted ti teknolohia kadagiti solusion a kas kadagiti birtual a panagpasiar iti tay-ak. Mabalin a makita dagiti estudiante dagiti artipak iti museo, agbisita iti aquarium, wenno mabuya iti nagpipintas nga art bayat a nakatugawda kadua ti klase.

source: Translate this sentence from eng to ilo: Sharing a field trip virtually is also a great way to reflect a on a trip and share experiences with future classes.
target: Iti pannakiraman iti birtual a field trip ket maysa met a napintas a dalan tapno malaglagip dagiti field trip ken panangiranod kadagiti kapadasan para iti sumaganad a klase.

source: Translate this sentence from eng to ilo: For example, each year students from Bennet School in North Carolina design a website about their trip to the State Capital, each year the website gets remodeled, but old versions are kept online to serve as a scrapbook.
target: Kas pagarigan, iti kada tawen agdesinio dagiti estudiante manipud iti Bennet School iti North Carolina iti maysa a website maipapan iti biaheda iti Kapitolio ti Estado, iti kada tawen mabalbaliwan dayta website, ngem agtalinaed nga online dagiti daan a bersion tapno a agserbi a kas scrapbook.

source: Translate this sentence from eng to ilo: Blogs can also help improve student writing. While students often begin their blog experience with sloppy grammar and spelling, the presence of an audience generally changes that.
target: Makatulong met dagiti blog tapno mapasayaat dagiti estudiante ti panagsuratda. Bayat a padpadasem ti agsurat iti blog uray adda dagiti pagkamaliam iti gramatika ken ispeling, ket in-inut dayta a maparang-aymo bayat mabasbasa wenno makitkitan ti dadduma.

source: Translate this sentence from eng to ilo: Since students are often the most critical audience, the blog writer begins to strive to improve writing to avoid criticism.
target: Gapu ta dagiti estudiante ket masansan nga isu ti agbasbasa, ar-aramiden ngarud ti blog writer ti amin tapno agbalin a nabagas ken nasayaat ti pannakaisuratna ket maliklikan ti pakadillawan.

source: Translate this sentence from eng to ilo: Also blogging "forces students to become more savvy about the world around them." The need to feed the interest of the audience inspires students to be clever and interesting (Toto, 2004).
target: Ti panagblog ket “ mangipaganetget kadagiti estudiante nga agbalin a nasirib panggep iti aglikmut a lubong kadakuada.” Ti kasapulan a mangpakan ti interes dagiti dum-dumngeg ti mangparegget kadagiti estudiante nga agbalin a nasirib ken interesado.

source: Translate this sentence from eng to ilo: Blogging is a tool that inspires collaboration, and encourages students to extend learning well beyond the traditional school day.
target: Ti blogging ket maysa nga alikamen iti panagtinnulong, ken paregtaenna dagiti estudiante nga ipamaysa ti panagadal uray awanen iti eskuelaan.

source: Translate this sentence from eng to ilo: Appropriate use of blogs "can empower students to become more analytical and critical; through actively responding to Internet materials, students can define their positions in the context of others' writings as well as outline their own perspectives on particular issues (Oravec, 2002).
target: Ti umisu a panagusar kadagiti blog ket "mabalin a mangpapigsa kadagiti estudiante tapno agbalinda a kritikal ken analitikal; babaen iti aktibo a panangsungbat kadagiti material iti Internet, maikkan kaipapanan dagiti estudiante dagiti posisionda iti konteksto ti sinurat dagiti sabali ken kasta met a maiparangda ti bukodda a perspektibo kadagiti partikular nga isyu" (Oravec, 2002).

source: Translate this sentence from eng to ilo: Ottawa is Canada's charming, bilingual capital and features an array of art galleries and museums that showcase Canada's past and present.
target: Ti Ottawa ket napintas, dua ti panagsasaoda a kapital ti Canada ket itedna ti adu nga art gallery ken museums a mangipabuya iti napalabas ken kinaagdama ti Canada.

source: Translate this sentence from eng to ilo: Farther south is Niagara Falls and the north is home to the untapped natural beauty of the Muskoka and beyond.
target: Iti ad-adayo nga abagatan, masarakan ti Niagara Falls ket iti amianan ti pagtaengan ti saan pay a nagaraw a natural a kinapintas ti Muskoka ken iti labesna.

source: Translate this sentence from eng to ilo: All these things and more highlight Ontario as what is considered quintessentially Canadian by outsiders.
target: Amin dagitoy a bambanag ken ad-adu pay a panagraniag iti Ontario nga isu ti maituding a Canadian para kadagiti taga-ruar.

source: Translate this sentence from eng to ilo: Large areas further north are quite sparsely populated and some is nearly uninhabited wilderness.
target: Ti dakkel a lugar iti adayo nga amianan ket bassit laeng ti populasionna ken dagiti dadduma ket dandani saan mabalin a paggianan a let-ang.

source: Translate this sentence from eng to ilo: For a comparison of population that surprises many: There are more African Americans living in the US than there are Canadian citizens.
target: Adu ti masdaaw iti daytoy a panagkompara iti populasion: Ad-adu ti Aprikano Amerikano nga adda iti US ngem iti bilang ti amin nga umili iti Canada.

source: Translate this sentence from eng to ilo: The East African Islands are in the Indian Ocean off the eastern coast of Africa.
target: Ti East African Islands ket diay Indian Ocean nga asideg iti makindaya a baybay ti Aprika.

source: Translate this sentence from eng to ilo: Madagascar is by far the biggest, and a continent on its own when it comes to wildlife.
target: Ti Madagascar pay laeng ti kadakkelan, ken maysa a kontinente iti bukbukodna no maipanggep iti biag nga atap.

source: Translate this sentence from eng to ilo: Most of the smaller islands are independent nations, or associated with France, and known as luxury beach resorts.
target: Kaadduan kadagiti babassit a isla ket dagiti nasion nga agwaywayas, wenno nainaig iti Pransia, ken nalatak para kadagiti nangingina a pagayuyangan nga aplaya.

source: Translate this sentence from eng to ilo: The Arabs also brought Islam to the lands, and it took in a big way in the Comoros and Mayotte.
target: Intugot dagiti Arabo ti Islam iti uneg ti daga, ket nagdisso daytoy ti dakkel a pamay-an idiay Comoros ken Mayotte.

source: Translate this sentence from eng to ilo: European influence and colonialism began in the 15th century, as Portuguese explorer Vasco da Gama found the Cape Route from Europe to India.
target: Nangrugi dagiti impluensia ken kolonialismo a Europeo idi maika-15 a siglo, idi a nasarakan ti managdaliasat a Portuges a ni Vasco da Gama ti Cape Route manipud Europa agingga iti India.

source: Translate this sentence from eng to ilo: In the north the region is bounded by the Sahel, and in the south and west by the Atlantic Ocean.
target: Ti amianan diay rehion ket napaigidan ti Sahel, ken idiay abagatan ken laud ket iti Taaw Atlantico.

source: Translate this sentence from eng to ilo: Women: It is recommended that any women travellers say that they are married, regardless of actual marital status.
target: Dagiti babbai: Mairekomenda a asinoman a babai nga agbibiahe ket ibagada nga adda asawada, uray no aniaman iti aktual nga estado iti pannakiasawada.

source: Translate this sentence from eng to ilo: It is helpful to also wear a ring (just not one that looks too expensive.
target: Makatulong ti agisuot ti singsing (dayta maysa a saan a kasla nangina unay.

source: Translate this sentence from eng to ilo: Women should realize that cultural differences may result in what they would consider harassment and it is not uncommon to be followed, grabbed by the arm, etc.
target: Masapul nga amuen dagiti babbai nga iti panagsasabali ti kultura ket mabalin nga agresulta iti maikonsiderada a panangrames ket iti daytoy ket saan a gagangay a masurot, makallabay, etc.

source: Translate this sentence from eng to ilo: Be firm in turning down men, and don't be afraid to stand your ground (cultural differences or not, it doesn't make it ok!).
target: Agbalinka a natibker a mangliklik kadagiti lallaki, ken saanka a mabuteng a mangidependa iti bagim (agsasabali man ti kultura wenno saan, saan nga isyu dayta).

source: Translate this sentence from eng to ilo: The modern city of Casablanca was founded by Berber fishermen in the 10th century BCE, and was used by the Phoenicians, Romans, and the Merenids as a strategic port called Anfa.
target: Binangon dagiti mangngalap a Berber ti moderno a siudad ti Casablanca idi maika-10 a siglo BCE, ken inusar dagiti Phoenician, Romano, ken dagiti Merenid kas istratehiko a sangladan a naawagan iti Anfa.

source: Translate this sentence from eng to ilo: The Portuguese destroyed it and rebuilt it under the name Casa Branca, only to abandon it after an earthquake in 1755.
target: Dinadael daytoy dagiti Portuges ken impatakder manen ti sirok iti baro a nagan a Casa Branca, tapno laeng maibati daytoy kalpasan iti gingined idi 1755.

source: Translate this sentence from eng to ilo: The Moroccan sultan rebuilt the city as Daru l-Badya and it was given the name Casablanca by Spanish traders who established trading bases there.
target: Imbangon manen ti sultan ti Morocco ti siudad ket pinanagananna iti Daru I-Badya sa Casablanca ti impanagan dagiti negosiante nga Español a nakipatakder kadagiti paglakuan ditoy.

source: Translate this sentence from eng to ilo: Casablanca is one of the least interesting places to shop in all of Morocco.
target: Ti Casablanca ket maysa kadagiti saan unay a makapainteres dagiti paggatangan iti Morocco.

source: Translate this sentence from eng to ilo: Around the old Medina it's easy to find places selling traditional Moroccan goods, such as tagines, pottery, leather goods, hookahs, and a whole spectrum of geegaws, but it's all for the tourists.
target: Aglawlaw ti daan a Medina nadaras laeng ti mangbirok kadagiti lugar nga aglaklako ti bambanag a Moroccan, kas tagine, pariok, lalat, hookah, ket nadumaduma a geegaw, ngem amin dagitoy ket para kadagiti turista.

source: Translate this sentence from eng to ilo: Goma is a tourist city of the Democratic Republic of Congo in the extreme east near Rwanda.
target: Goma ket maysa a siudad a pangturista ti Demokratiko a Republika ti Congo iti pannakadaya asideg Rwanda.

source: Translate this sentence from eng to ilo: In 2002 Goma was destroyed by lava from the Nyiragongo volcano which buried most of the town’s streets, particularly the town centre.
target: Idi 2002 ti Goma ket nadadael ti lava gapu iti bulkan ti Nyiragongo a nangikali ti kaaduan a kalsada iti ili, aglalo iti sentro ti ili.

source: Translate this sentence from eng to ilo: While Goma is reasonably safe, any visits outside of Goma should be researched to understand the state of the fighting that persists in the North Kivu province.
target: Nupay natalged ti Goma, masapul nga ammuen nga umuna ti situasion ti agdama a panaglalaban iti probinsia ti Amianan a Kivu sakbay ti aniaman a panagpasiar iti ruar ti Goma.

source: Translate this sentence from eng to ilo: The city is also the base to climb the Nyiragongo volcano along with some of the cheapest Mountain Gorilla tracking in Africa.
target: Ti siudad met ti pagrugianan ti panagkalay-at iti bulkan a Nyiragongo ken iti dadduma a nalalaka a panagsapul iti Gorilla ti Bantay idiay Africa.

source: Translate this sentence from eng to ilo: You can use boda-boda (motorcycle taxi) to get around Goma. The normal (local) price is ~500 Congolese Francs for the short ride.
target: Mabalinka aglugan iti boda-boda (taxi a motor) tapno aglikaw iti Goma. Ti gagangay (lokal) a plete ket ~500 a Congolese Franc para iti asideg a biahe.

source: Translate this sentence from eng to ilo: Combined with its relative inaccessibility, "Timbuktu" has come to be used as a metaphor for exotic, distant lands.
target: Karaman ti karigatna a maaramat iti daytoy, ti “Timbuktu” ket nagbalin a mausar a kas metapora para iti eksotiko, adayo a daga.

source: Translate this sentence from eng to ilo: Today, Timbuktu is an impoverished town, although its reputation makes it a tourist attraction, and it has an airport.
target: Iti agdama, napanglaw nga ili ti Timbuktu, uray no ti reputasionna ket pakaawisan dagiti turista, ken addaan pay daytoy iti airport.

source: Translate this sentence from eng to ilo: In 1990, it was added to the list of world heritage sites in danger, due to the threat of desert sands.
target: Idi 1990, nainayon daytoy iti listaan ti dagiti agpeggad a tawid a luglugar iti sangalubongan, gapu iti pangta ti darat ti disierto.

source: Translate this sentence from eng to ilo: It was one of the major stops during Henry Louis Gates' PBS special Wonders of the African World.
target: Daytoy ket maysa kadagiti nangruna a pagsardengan kabayatan iti espesial a PBS ni Henry Lous Gates a Siddaaw iti Lubong ti Aprikano.

source: Translate this sentence from eng to ilo: The city is in stark contrast to the rest of the country's cities, because it has more of an Arabic flair than of an African.
target: Ti siudad ket naiduma unay kadagiti dadduma a siudad ti pagilian, gapu ta ad-adu iti sagudayna nga Arabo ngem iti African.

source: Translate this sentence from eng to ilo: The Kruger National Park (KNP) lies in the north-east of South Africa and runs along the border of Mozambique in the east, Zimbabwe in the north, and the southern border is the Crocodile River.
target: Ti Nasional a Parke iti Kruger (KNP) ket adda ti amianan a daya ti Abagatan nga Aprika ken tumaray iti pagpatinggaan ti Mozambique iti daya, Zimbabwe iti amianan, ken iti abagatan a pagpatinggaanna ket isu ti Crocodile River.

source: Translate this sentence from eng to ilo: The park covers 19,500 km² and is divided in 14 different ecozones, each supporting different wildlife.
target: Sakupen ti parke iti 19,500 km² ken nasina-sina iti 14 nga agsasabali a ecozones, tunggal maysa ti mangsupsuporta iti naduma-duma nga atap nga animal.

source: Translate this sentence from eng to ilo: It is one of the main attractions of South Africa and it is considered the flagship of South African National Parks (SANParks).
target: Isu ti maysa kadagiti kangrunaan a pangawis ti South Africa ket maibilang daytoy a mangibambandera iti South African National Parks (SANParks).

source: Translate this sentence from eng to ilo: As with all South African National Parks, there are daily conservation and entry fees for the park.
target: Kas met dagiti Nasional a Parke iti Abagatan nga Aprika, adda inaldaw a panagkonserba ken bayad tapno makastrek idiay parke.

source: Translate this sentence from eng to ilo: It may also be beneficial for one to buy a Wild Card, which provides entry to either selections of parks in South Africa or all of the South African National Parks.
target: Mabalin pay a makatulong ti pananggatang iti Wild Card, a mangipalubos iti iseserrek iti aniaman kadagiti mapili a parke iti South Africa wenno iti amin a National Parks ti South Africa.

source: Translate this sentence from eng to ilo: Hong Kong Island gives the territory of Hong Kong its name and is the place that many tourists regard as the main focus.
target: Inikkkan ti Isla ti Hong Kong iti teritorio ti Hongkong iti nagan ken ti lugar nga adu a turista a mangipagarup a kangrunaan a naipamaysa.

source: Translate this sentence from eng to ilo: The parade of buildings that make the Hong Kong skyline has been likened to a glittering bar chart that is made apparent by the presence of the waters of Victoria Harbour.
target: Ti parada dagiti naipatakder a mangbalbalin ti skyline ti Hong Kong ket naipada iti aggilgilap a karto ti bar nga aglalao napapintas iti danm ti Victoria Harbour.

source: Translate this sentence from eng to ilo: To get the best views of Hong Kong, leave the island and head for the Kowloon waterfront opposite.
target: Tapno makitam ti kapintasan a langa ti Hong Kong, panawam ti isla ket mapanka iti Kowloon sango iti danum iti bangirna.

source: Translate this sentence from eng to ilo: The great majority of Hong Kong Island's urban development is densely packed on reclaimed land along the northern shore.
target: Ti kadakkelan a parte iti urban a panagpasayaat iti Isla ti Hong Kong ket iramanna a dakkel dagiti nababawi a daga idiay baybay iti amianan.

source: Translate this sentence from eng to ilo: This is the place the British colonisers took as their own and so if you are looking for evidence of the territory's colonial past, this is a good place to start.
target: Daytoy ti lugar nga inagom dagiti manangsakop a Briton ken no agbirbirokka iti ebidensia iti napalabas a panagsakop dagiti teritorio, nasayaat no mangrugika ditoy a lugar.

source: Translate this sentence from eng to ilo: The Sundarbans are the largest littoral mangrove belt in the world, stretching 80 km (50 mi) into the Bangladeshi and Indian hinterland from the coast.
target: Dagiti Sundarbansdagiti kadadakkelan a takdang a napno ti parakad iti entero a lubong, a nayunnat iti 80 km (50 mi) kadagiti aw-away ti Bangladesh ken India manipud iti igid ti baybay .

source: Translate this sentence from eng to ilo: The Sundarbans has been declared a UNESCO World Heritage Site. The part of the forest within Indian territory is called Sundarbans National Park.
target: Naideklara dagiti Sundarban kas UNESCO World Heritage Site. Ti parte iti bakir nga adda iti uneg ti teritorio ti India ket maawagan a Sundarbans National Park.

source: Translate this sentence from eng to ilo: The forests aren't just mangrove swamps though — they include some of the last remaining stands of the mighty jungles which once covered the Gangetic plain.
target: Dagiti bakir ket saan nga aluguog ti parakad ngem - inkadua kadagiti manmano a maudi nga agtalinaed a takder iti napigsa a kabakiran a naminsan a tininep ti patag ti Ganges.

source: Translate this sentence from eng to ilo: The Sundarbans cover an area of 3,850 km², of which about one-third is covered in water/marsh areas.
target: Ti kalawa ti Suburbans ket 3,850 a kilometro kuadrado, km2, nga agarup kakatlo iti dayta ket kadandanuman a parte.

source: Translate this sentence from eng to ilo: Since 1966 the Sundarbans have been a wildlife sanctuary, and it is estimated that there are now 400 Royal Bengal tigers and about 30,000 spotted deer in the area.
target: Manipud idi 1966, nagbalin ti Sundarbans a santuario ti atap a nabiag, ket mapattapatta nga adda itan 400 a tigre a Royal Bengal ken agarup 30,000 a labang nga ugsa iti lugar.
