source: Translate this sentence from eng to ilo: Buses depart the inter-district bus station (across the river) throughout the day, though most, especially those heading to the east and Jakar/Bumthang leave between 06:30 and 07:30.
target: Pumanaw dagiti bus idiay istason ti bus a pang inter-district (ballasiw iti karayan) iti agmalmalem, ngem kaaduan, kangrunaan dagiti mapan daya ken Jakar/Bumthang pumanawda iti baetan iti 06:30 ken 07:30.

source: Translate this sentence from eng to ilo: As the inter-district buses are often full, it is advisable to purchase a ticket a few days in advance.
target: Gapu ta masansan a mapno dagiti agbiahe dagiti bus ditoy distrito, maisingasing ti pananggatang iti tiket a nasapsapa iti sumagmamano nga aldaw.

source: Translate this sentence from eng to ilo: Most districts are served by small Japanese Coaster Buses, which are comfortable and sturdy.
target: Kaaduan a distrito ket pagserserbian ti babassit a Bus a Japanese Coaster, a komportable ken nalagda.

source: Translate this sentence from eng to ilo: Shared taxis are a quick and comfortable means to travel to nearby places, such as Paro (Nu 150) and Punakha (Nu 200).
target: Dagiti agkadua a taxi ket napaspas ken komportable a pamay-an ti panagbiahe mapan iti asideg a lugar, a kas Paro (Nu 150) ken Punakha (Nu 200).

source: Translate this sentence from eng to ilo: The Oyapock River Bridge is a cable-stayed bridge. It spans the Oyapock River to link the cities of Oiapoque in Brazil and Saint-Georges de l'Oyapock in French Guiana.
target: Maysa a rangtay a naibitin babaen ti kable ti Oyapock River Bridge Lasatenna ti Oyapock River tapno maisilpo kadagiti siudad ti Oiapoque iti Brazil ken ti Saint-Georges de l'Oyapock iti French Guiana.

source: Translate this sentence from eng to ilo: The two towers rise to a height of 83 meters, it's 378 meters long and it has two lanes of 3.50 m wide.
target: 83 a metro ti katayag dagiti dua a torre, 378 metro ti kaatiddogna ken addaan iti dua a linia a 3.50 m ti kalawana.

source: Translate this sentence from eng to ilo: The vertical clearance under the bridge is 15 meters. Construction was completed in August 2011, it didn't open to traffic until March 2017.
target: Ti katayag ti rangtay ket 15 a metro. Ti pannakaaramidna ket nakompleto idi Agosto 2011, saan a nalukatan daytoy iti trapiko inggana idi Marso 2017.

source: Translate this sentence from eng to ilo: The bridge is scheduled to be fully operational in September 2017, when the Brazilian customs checkpoints are expected to be finished.
target: Ti rangtay ket naiskediul a mausaren inton Setiembre 2017, no kaano a manamnama a malpaston dagiti checkpoint ti custom.

source: Translate this sentence from eng to ilo: The Guaraní were the most significant indigenous group inhabiting what is now Eastern Paraguay, living as semi-nomadic hunters who also practised subsistence agriculture.
target: Dagiti Guarani ti kapapategan a katutubo a grupo nga agtaltalinaed idiay itatta a Makindaya a Paraguay, nga agbibiag a kas medio-agalla-alla a mangnganup nga agararamid met iti substansia nga agrikultura.

source: Translate this sentence from eng to ilo: The Chaco region was home to other groups of indigenous tribes such as the Guaycurú and Payaguá, who survived by hunting, gathering and fishing.
target: Ti rehion ti Chaco ket taeng dagiti dadduma a grupo dagiti nainsigudan a tribu kas kadagiti Guaycurú ken Payaguá, a nagbibiag babaen iti panaganup, panagburas ken panagkalap.

source: Translate this sentence from eng to ilo: In the 16th century Paraguay, formerly called "The Giant Province of the Indies", was born as a result of the encounter of Spanish conquerors with the native indigenous groups.
target: Idi maika-16 a siglo idiay Paraguay, dati a maawagan nga “Iti Higante a Probinsia Dagiti Indi”, ket naiyanak kas resulta ti laban dagiti manangparmek nga Espaniol ken dagiti katutubo a grupo.

source: Translate this sentence from eng to ilo: The Spaniards started the colonization period which lasted for three centuries.
target: Dagiti Español inrugida ti panawen ti panagsakopda a nagtultuloy iti tallo a siglo.

source: Translate this sentence from eng to ilo: Since the foundation of Asunción in 1537, Paraguay has managed to keep a lot of its indigenous character and identity.
target: Nangrugi idi naipasdek ti Asuncion idi 1537, nabaelan ti Paraguay nga agtalinaed ti adu a lokal a karakter ken kinasiasinoda.

source: Translate this sentence from eng to ilo: Argentina is well known for having one of the best polo teams and players in the world.
target: Nalatak ti Argentina gapu ta addaanda iti maysa kadagiti kalalaingan a grupo ti polo ken agay-ayam iti entero a lubong.

source: Translate this sentence from eng to ilo: The largest tournament of the year takes place in December at the polo fields in Las Cañitas.
target: Maangay inton Disiembre ti kadakkelan a panagsasalisal ti tawen iti katay-akan ti polo idiay Las Cañitas.

source: Translate this sentence from eng to ilo: Smaller tournaments and matches can also be seen here at other times of the year.
target: Ti babassit a turnamento ken lablaban ket mabalin met a mabuya ditoy ti sabali pay a paset ti tawen.

source: Translate this sentence from eng to ilo: For news on tournaments and where to buy tickets for polo matches, check Asociacion Argentina de Polo.
target: Para ti damag maipapan kadagiti torneo ken no ayanna makagatang ti tiket para kadagiti laban iti polo, kitaenyo iti Asociacion Argentina de Polo.

source: Translate this sentence from eng to ilo: The official Falklands currency is the Falkland pound (FKP) whose value is set equivalent to that of one British pound (GBP).
target: Ti opisial a kuarta iti Falklands ket iti Falklang pound (FKP) nga iti pategna ket naituding a kapada ti maysa a British pound (GBP).

source: Translate this sentence from eng to ilo: Money can be exchanged at the only bank in the islands which is located in Stanley across from the FIC West store.
target: Mabalin a maisukat ti kuarta iti maymaysa a banko kadagiti isla a masarakan iti Stanley iti ballasiw ti paggatangan ti FIC West.

source: Translate this sentence from eng to ilo: British pounds will generally be accepted anywhere in the islands and within Stanley credit cards and United States dollars are also often accepted.
target: Dagiti pound ti Britania ket mabalin a maakseptar sadinoman diay isla ken iti uneg ti Stanley credit cards ken ti doliar ti Estados Unidos ket masansan nga akseptaren.

source: Translate this sentence from eng to ilo: On the outlying islands credit cards will probably not be accepted, although British and United States currency may be taken; check with the owners in advance to determine what is an acceptable payment method.
target: Dagiti credit card nga aggapu kadagiti adayo nga isla ket sigurado a saan a maawat, ngem ti kuarta ti Britania ken Estados Unidos ket mabalin nga awatenda; umuna a damagem dagiti makinkukua tapno maammuam no ania ti maawat a pamay-an ti panagbayad.

source: Translate this sentence from eng to ilo: It is nearly impossible to exchange Falklands currency outside of the islands, so exchange money prior to leaving the islands.
target: Dandani imposible nga isukat ti kuarta iti Falklands iti ruar dagiti isla, isu nga agipasukat ti kuarta sakbay ti panagpanaw iti isla.

source: Translate this sentence from eng to ilo: Since Montevideo is south of the Equator, it is summer there when it's winter in the Northern Hemisphere and vice versa.
target: Gapu ta ti Montevideo ket abagatan ti Ekuador, panawen ti kalgaw idiay no panawen ti lam-ek idiay Makin-amianan a Hemispero ken agbinnatliktad.

source: Translate this sentence from eng to ilo: Montevideo is in the subtropics; in the summer months, temperatures above +30°C are common.
target: Ti Montevido ket adda ti subtropiko; iti bulbulan ti panagbabara, iti temperatura a sumurok +30°C ket gagangay laeng.

source: Translate this sentence from eng to ilo: The winter can be deceptively chilly: temperatures rarely go below freezing, but the wind and humidity combine to make it feel colder than what the thermometer says.
target: Ti pinaglalamiis ket mabalin a makaallilaw ti kinalamiisna: ti temperatura ket manmano a bumaba a permi, ngem ti angin ken dam-eg no agtipon ket mangpabalin a nalamlamiis ti riknana ngem ti ibagbaga ti thermometer.

source: Translate this sentence from eng to ilo: There are no particular "rainy" and "dry" seasons: the amount of rain stays roughly the same throughout the year.
target: Awan ti kangrunaan a “matutudo” ken “namaga” a panawen: ti kinaadu iti tudo agtalinaed a natutudo iti entero a tawen.

source: Translate this sentence from eng to ilo: Though many of the animals in the park are used to seeing humans, the wildlife is nonetheless wild and should not be fed or disturbed.
target: No man pay adu kadagiti ay-ayup iti parke ket tapno makita dagiti tattao, dagiti ayup latta ket naatap ken saan a mabalin a pakanen wenno buriburen.

source: Translate this sentence from eng to ilo: According to park authorities, stay at least 100 yards/meters away from bears and wolves and 25 yards/meters from all other wild animals!
target: Segun kadagiti autoridad ti parke, agtalinaed iti saan a nababbaba ngem 100 a yarda/metro a kaadayo kadagiti oso ken lobo ken 25 a yarda/metro a kaadayo kadagiti amin a sabali pay nga atap nga ayup!

source: Translate this sentence from eng to ilo: No matter how docile they may look, bison, elk, moose, bears, and nearly all large animals can attack.
target: Uray pay kasano kinaamoda a makitam, iti bison, ellk, moose, oso ken dadani amin a dadakkel nga ay-ayup ket mabalin a mangraut.

source: Translate this sentence from eng to ilo: Each year, dozens of visitors are injured because they didn't keep a proper distance. These animals are large, wild, and potentially dangerous, so give them their space.
target: Iti kada tawen, dinosdosena kadagiti bisita ti nadangran gapu ta saanda a nagtungpal iti umiso a distansia. Dadakkel, naatap, ken mabalin a napeggad dagitoy nga ayup, isu nga ited kadakuada ti espasioda.

source: Translate this sentence from eng to ilo: In addition, be aware that odors attract bears and other wildlife, so avoid carrying or cooking odorous foods and keep a clean camp.
target: Mainayon pay, ammuem a dagiti angot ket makaawis dagiti oso ken dadduma nga atap a biag, isu a liklikam ti agitugot wenno agluto ti naangot a makmakan ken pagtalinaedem a nadalus a pakarso.

source: Translate this sentence from eng to ilo: Apia is the capital of Samoa. The town is on the island of Upolu and has a population of just under 40,000.
target: Ti kapital ti Samoa ket Apia. Ti ili ket adda ayan ti isla iti Upolu ken addaan iti populasion a nakurang a 40,000.

source: Translate this sentence from eng to ilo: Apia was founded in the 1850s and has been the official capital of Samoa since 1959.
target: Napatakder ti Apia idi 1850s ken isu ti nagbalin a opisial a kapitolio ti Samoa manipud idi 1959.

source: Translate this sentence from eng to ilo: The harbor was the site of an infamous naval standoff in 1889 when seven ships from Germany, the US, and Britain refused to leave the harbor.
target: Ti baybay ket lugar iti nakaro a riri iti taaw idi 1889 no sadino a pito a barko a naggapu iti Germany, iti US, ken ti Britania saanna kayat ti pumanaw iti baybay.

source: Translate this sentence from eng to ilo: All the ships were sunk, except for one British cruiser. Nearly 200 American and German lives were lost.
target: Amin a barko ket limned, puera iti maysa a Briton a cruiser. Dumani 200 nga Amerikano ken Aleman ti natay.

source: Translate this sentence from eng to ilo: During the struggle for independence organised by the Mau movement, a peaceful gathering in the town resulted in the killing of the paramount chief Tupua Tamasese Lealofi III.
target: Idi madama ti panagrigat para iti panagwaywayas nga inorganisa iti movimiento a Mau, maysa a natalna a panaguummong idiay ili a nagresulta ti pannakapatay iti kangatuan nga ulo a ni Tupua Tamasese Lealofi III.

source: Translate this sentence from eng to ilo: There are many beaches, due to Auckland's straddling of two harbours. The most popular ones are in three areas.
target: Nagadu ti aplaya iti Auckland gapu ta addaan daytoy iti dua a sangladan . Dagiti kalalatakan ket adda iti tallo a lugar.

source: Translate this sentence from eng to ilo: North Shore beaches (in North Harbour district) are on the Pacific Ocean and stretch from Long Bay in the north to Devonport in the south.
target: Dagiti baybay iti North Shore (idiay distrito iti North Harbor) ket adda idiay Pacific Ocean ken agbennat manipud Long Bay idiay amianan agingga Devonport idiay abagatan.

source: Translate this sentence from eng to ilo: They are almost all sandy beaches with safe swimming, and most have shade provided by pohutukawa trees.
target: Dandanida amin a nadarat nga aplaya nga adda ti natalged a paglanguyan, ken kaadduan ket adda iti linongna a maited bayat dagiti kaykayo a pohutukawa.

source: Translate this sentence from eng to ilo: Tamaki Drive beaches are on the Waitemata Harbour, in the upmarket suburbs of Mission Bay and St Heliers in Central Auckland.
target: Dagiti aplaya idiay Tamaki Drive ket addada idiay Waitemata Harbour, idiay ngato ti palengke a kailian ti Mission Bay ken St Heliers idiay Central Auckland.

source: Translate this sentence from eng to ilo: These are sometimes-crowded family beaches with a good range of shops lining the shore. Swimming is safe.
target: No maminsan ket mapuspusek ti pamilia dagitoy nga aplaya nga adda ti nasayaat a paggatangan a nakalinia iti igid baybay. Natalged met iti panaglangoy.

source: Translate this sentence from eng to ilo: The main local beer is 'Number One', it is not a complex beer, but pleasant and refreshing. The other local beer is called "Manta".
target: Ti kangrunaan a lokal a serbesa ket “Numero Uno”, saan a komplikado daytoy a serbesa, ngem nasayaat ken makapresko. Diay sabali a lokal a serbesa ket maawagan a “Manta”.

source: Translate this sentence from eng to ilo: There are many French wines to be had, but the New Zealand and Australian wines might travel better.
target: Adu ti French nga arak a mabagitayo, ngem mabalin a nasaysayaat ti pannakaibiahe dagiti arak a manipud iti New Zealand ken Australia .

source: Translate this sentence from eng to ilo: The local tap water is perfectly safe to drink, but bottled water is easy to find if you are fearful.
target: Ti local a danum ti gripo ket natalged nga inumen, ngem ti danum a nakabotelia ket nalaka a sapulen no mabutengka.

source: Translate this sentence from eng to ilo: For Australians, the idea of 'flat white' coffee is foreign. A short black is 'espresso', cappuccino comes heaped high with cream (not froth), and tea is served without milk.
target: Para kadagiti Australiano, ganggannaet ti kapanunotan a 'daplat a puraw' a kape. 'Espresso' ti ababa a nangisit, nabuntuonan iti nangato a krema (saan a burek) ti cappuccino, ken maiserbi ti tsaa nga awan ti gatasna.

source: Translate this sentence from eng to ilo: The hot chocolate is up to Belgian standards. Fruit juices are pricey but excellent.
target: Ti napudot a tsokolate ket depende iti pagalagadan ti Belgian. Dagiti ubbog ti prutas ket nangina ngem nagsayaat.

source: Translate this sentence from eng to ilo: Many trips to the reef are made all year around, and injuries due to any of these causes on the reef are rare.
target: Adu a biahe a mapan iti reef ket maar-aramid iti entero a makatawen, ken manmano dagiti mangdadael kadagiti reef gapu kadagitoy.

source: Translate this sentence from eng to ilo: Still, take advice from authorities, obey all signs, and pay close attention to safety warnings.
target: Ngem, denggem latta ti balakad dagiti autoridad, surotem dagiti karatula, ken agbalin nga alerto kadagiti pakdaar maipapan iti kinatalged.

source: Translate this sentence from eng to ilo: Box jellyfish occur near beaches and near river estuaries from October to April north of 1770. They can occasionally be found outside these times.
target: ti kahon a karominas ket mabalin nga agpakita diay asideg igid baybay ken asideg sabangan ti karayan manipud Oktubre agingga Abril amianan iti 1770. Maminsan ket makitada met iti ruar dagitoy.

source: Translate this sentence from eng to ilo: Sharks do exist, however they rarely attack humans. Most sharks are scared of humans and would swim away.
target: Agtaltalinaed dagiti pating, ngem manmanoda laeng a mangraut iti tattao. Dagiti pating ket mabuteng kadagiti tattao ket aglangoyda nga umadayo.

source: Translate this sentence from eng to ilo: Saltwater Crocodiles do not actively live in the ocean, their primary habitat is in river estuaries north from Rockhampton.
target: Dagiti Buaya iti Danum-Apgad. Saan a gagangay nga agbibiag iti taaw dagiti buaya, ti nangruna a pagnaedan ket kadagiti estuario iti karayan nga adda iti amianan ti Rockhampton.

source: Translate this sentence from eng to ilo: Booking in advance gives the traveller peace of mind that they will have somewhere to sleep once they arrive at their destination.
target: Ti nasapa a panag-book ket mangmangted kadagiti biahero iti waya-waya nga addaan ti pagdagusan no sumangpetda iti papananda.

source: Translate this sentence from eng to ilo: Travel agents often have deals with specific hotels, although you may find it possible to book other forms of accommodation, like camping grounds, through a travel agent.
target: Masansan nga adda dagiti nagtulagan dagiti ahente ti biahe kadagiti nairanta a hotel, nupay kasta mabalin ti mangireserba kadagiti sabali pay a pagdagusan, kas kadagiti pagkampuan a lugar, babaen iti maysa nga ahente.

source: Translate this sentence from eng to ilo: Travel agents usually offer packages that include breakfast, transportation arrangements to/from the airport or even combined flight and hotel packages.
target: Dagiti ahente iti panagbiahe gagangayen a mangited iti pakete nga agraman pammigat, pagluganan aggapu ken mapan idiay airport wenno agkadua a biahe iti eroplano ken hotel.

source: Translate this sentence from eng to ilo: They can also hold the reservation for you if you need time to think about the offer or procure other documents for your destination (e.g. visa).
target: Mabalinda pay nga ipasardeng ti reserbasinmo no masapulmo pay ti oras tapno panunotem ti ididiayada wenno mangala kadagiti sabali a dokumento para iti papanam (kas koma iti visa).

source: Translate this sentence from eng to ilo: Any amendments or requests though should be coursed through the travel agent first and not directly with the hotel.
target: Aniaman a panagbalbaliw wenno dawat, masapul a maipadalan nga umuna iti ahente ti biahe ken saan a direkta nga iti hotel.

source: Translate this sentence from eng to ilo: For some festivals, the vast majority of the attendants to music festivals decide to camp on site, and most attendants consider it a vital part of the experience.
target: Para kadagiti dadduma a piesta, ti kaaduan a nangruna nga um-umay kadagiti piesta ti musika ket agdesision nga agkarso idiay mismo a lugar, ken kaadduan dagiti um-umay ket maibilangda a nangruna a parte dayta iti pannakapadas.

source: Translate this sentence from eng to ilo: If you want to be close to the action you're going to have to get in early to get a camping site close to the music.
target: No kayatmo a talaga nga asideg iti aksion kasapulam a mapan a nasapa idiay pagkarsonan nga asideg ti musika.

source: Translate this sentence from eng to ilo: Remember that even though music on the main stages may have finished, there may be sections of the festival that will keep playing music until late into the night.
target: Laglagipen nga uray pay nalpasen ti panagtokar ti musika kadagiti kangrunaan nga entablado, mabalin nga adda pay dagiti paset ti piesta nga agtultuloy nga agpatpatokar agingga iti kaadalman ti rabii.

source: Translate this sentence from eng to ilo: Some festivals have special camping areas for families with young children.
target: Iti dadduma a piesta ket adda ti espesial a lugar para iti kamping para iti pamilia nga adda ti ubbingna.

source: Translate this sentence from eng to ilo: If crossing the Northern Baltic in winter, check the cabin location, as going through ice causes quite horrible noise for those most affected.
target: No bumallasiw iti Makin-amianan a Baltic no panawen iti lam-ek, kitaen iti lugar ti kabin, gapu ta iti panagpagna iti yelo ket makingapu iti nakaro a tagari para kadagidiay maapektaran.

source: Translate this sentence from eng to ilo: Saint Petersburg cruises include time in town. Cruise passengers are exempted from visa requirements (check the terms).
target: Dagiti cruise ti Saint Petersburg ket adda laeng tiempo a maipalubos a kapautda iti ili. Saan a masapul nga adda visa dagiti pasahero (kitaem ti pagannurotan).

source: Translate this sentence from eng to ilo: Casinos typically make many efforts to maximize time and money spent by guests. Windows and clocks are usually absent, and exits can be hard to find.
target: Dagiti kasino ket masansan nga aramiden ti kabaelanda a paatiddogen ti oras ken kuarta a gasgastuen dagiti sangaili. Masansan nga awan iti tawa ken pag-orasanda, ken narigat a sapulen dagiti pagruaran.

source: Translate this sentence from eng to ilo: They usually have special food, drink and entertainment offers, to keep guests in a good mood, and keep them at the premise.
target: Kaaduananna ket adda ti espesial a makan, mainom ken pagraragsakan a maipaayda, tapno paragsaken dagiti sangailida, ken tapno saanda a tumalaw.

source: Translate this sentence from eng to ilo: Some venues offer alcoholic beverages on the house. However, drunkenness impairs judgement, and all good gamblers know the importance of staying sober.
target: Sumagmamano a lugar ket mangmangted ti libre nga arak. Uray pay no kasta, ti kinabartek ket mangikkat iti limpio, ken amin a nalaing a mannugal ket ammona iti importansia ti kinausaw.

source: Translate this sentence from eng to ilo: Anyone who's going to drive at high latitudes or over mountain passes should consider the possibility of snow, ice, or freezing temperatures.
target: Siasinoman nga agmaneho iti nangato a paset wenno iti rabaw iti bantay ket masapulna a maaddaan ti posibilidad ti niebe, yelo, wenno nakalamlamiis a temperatura.

source: Translate this sentence from eng to ilo: On icy and snowy roadways, friction is low and you cannot drive as if you were on bare asphalt.
target: Kadagiti nayelo ken naniebe a kalkalsada, nababa ti risiris ket saanka a makapagmaneho a kas no addaka iti aspalto.

source: Translate this sentence from eng to ilo: During blizzards, enough snow to get you stuck can fall in very little time.
target: No adda ti bagyo a niebe, naanay a niebe iti matnag nga inoran-oras a mabalin nga agpatalinaed kenka.

source: Translate this sentence from eng to ilo: Visibility may also be restricted by falling or blowing snow or by condensation or ice on vehicle windows.
target: Mabalin a malapdan ti panagkita gapu kadagiti agtintinag wenno maipalpallais a niebe wenno gapu iti panagagneb wenno yelo kadagiti tawa iti lugan.

source: Translate this sentence from eng to ilo: On the other hand, icy and snowy conditions are normal in many countries, and traffic goes on mostly uninterrupted all year round.
target: Iti sabali a bangir, gagangay iti adu a pagilian dagiti nayelo ken naniebe a kasasaad, ket agtultuloy latta ti trapiko a kaaduanna a di masingsinga iti sibubukel a makatawen.

source: Translate this sentence from eng to ilo: Safaris are perhaps the greatest tourism draw in Africa and the highlight for many visitors.
target: Mabalin a dagiti safari ti kadakkelan a pangawis ti turismo iti Africa ken isu ti kangrunaan para kadagiti adu a bisita.

source: Translate this sentence from eng to ilo: The term safari in popular use refers to overland travel to view the stunning African wildlife, particularly on savanna.
target: Iti sao a safari iti nalatak nga usarna ket mangtukoy kadagiti panagbiahe iti daga tapno makita iti nakakaskasdaaw nga atap a nabiag iti Africa, nangruna idiay savanna.

source: Translate this sentence from eng to ilo: Some animals, such as elephants and giraffes, tend to approach closely to cars and standard equipment will allow good viewing.
target: Dagiti dadduma nga ay-ayup, a kas koma ti elepante ken giraffe, ket mabalin nga umasideg kadagiti luglugan ken iti pagalagadan nga alikamen ket palubusanna ti nasayaat a panagbuya.

source: Translate this sentence from eng to ilo: Lions, cheetahs and leopards are sometimes shy and you will see them better with binoculars.
target: Dagiti leon, cheetah, ken leopardo no maminsan ket managbabain ket nasaysayaat ti pannakakita kadakuada no agusar iti largabista.

source: Translate this sentence from eng to ilo: A walking safari (also called a "bush walk", "hiking safari", or going "footing") consists of hiking, either for a few hours or several days.
target: Iti mapagpagna a safari (maawagan met a “bush walk”,“hiking safari”, wenno mapan ag-“footing”) iramanna ti panaguli, para iti mano laeng nga oras wenno mano nga al-aldaw.

source: Translate this sentence from eng to ilo: The Paralympics will take place from 24 August to 5 September 2021. Some events will be held in other locations throughout Japan.
target: Iti Paralympics ket maaramid manipud 24 iti Agosto agingga 5 iti Setiembre 2021. Iti dadduma a pasamak ket maaramid iti dadduma a lugar iti entero a Japan.

source: Translate this sentence from eng to ilo: Tokyo will be the only Asian city to have hosted two summer Olympics, having hosted the games in 1964.
target: Ti Tokyo ti kakaisuna a siudad iti Asia a namindua a nangsangaili iti Summer Olympics. Ti damo a panangsangailina iti paay-ayam ket iti 1964.

source: Translate this sentence from eng to ilo: If you booked your flights and accommodation for 2020 before the postponement was announced, you may have a tricky situation.
target: No nagpareserba dagiti biahem ken pagdagusan para iti 2020 sakbay a naiwaragawag ti pannakapasardengna, mabalin nga addaka ti narikot a situasion.

source: Translate this sentence from eng to ilo: Cancellation policies vary, but as of late March most coronavirus-based cancellation policies don't extend to July 2020, when the Olympics had been scheduled.
target: Agduduma dagiti annuroten iti panagkansela, ngem manipud idi Marso kaaduan kadagiti annuroten ti panagkansela a naibasar iti coronavirus ket saan a mailayon agingga iti Hulio 2020, nga isu ti pannaka-schedule ti Olympics.

source: Translate this sentence from eng to ilo: It's expected that most event tickets will cost between ¥2,500 and ¥130,000, with typical tickets costing around ¥7,000.
target: Manamnama a kaaduan kadagiti etiketa ket agbalor iti ¥2,500 ken ¥130,000, a dagiti gagangay nga etiketa ket agbalor iti ¥7,000.

source: Translate this sentence from eng to ilo: Ironing damp clothes can help them dry. Many hotels have an iron and ironing board available for loan, even if one is not present in the room.
target: Ti panagplantsa iti nabasa a bado ket makatulong tapno agmagada. Adu kadagiti hotel ket addaan ti plantsa ken kabalio a mabalinda nga ipabulod, uray no iti maysa ket awan idiay kuartona.

source: Translate this sentence from eng to ilo: If an iron isn't available, or if you don't fancy wearing ironed socks, then you can try using a hairdryer, if available.
target: No ti plantsa ket saan a magun-od, wenno saanmo a kayat nga agisuot ti naplantsa a medias, mabalinka a mangusar ti handryer, no adda magun-od.

source: Translate this sentence from eng to ilo: Be careful not to allow fabric to become too hot (which can cause shrinkage, or in extreme cases, scorch).
target: Agannad a saanmo a bay-an a pumudot unay ti tela (a makagapu nga agkarenken, wenno mauram pay ketdi).

source: Translate this sentence from eng to ilo: There are different ways of purifying water, some more effective against specific threats.
target: Adda nadumaduma a pamay-an tapno madalusan ti danum, adda pay mas epektibo kontra kadagiti espesipiko a peggad.

source: Translate this sentence from eng to ilo: In some areas boiling water for a minute is enough, in others several minutes are needed.
target: Iti dadduma a lugar ti panagpaburek ti danum ti maysa a minuto ket umanayen, iti sabali pay ket masapul ti nabaybayag.

source: Translate this sentence from eng to ilo: Filters vary in effectiveness, and should you have a concern, then you should consider buying your water in a sealed bottle from a reputable company.
target: Nadumaduma ti kinaepektibo dagiti sagatan, ket no addaanka ti pannakaseknan, ket mabalin a mapanunotmo a gatangen ti danummo a nakakarga ti seliado a bote aggapu iti mapagtalkan a kompania.

source: Translate this sentence from eng to ilo: Travellers may encounter animal pests that they are not familiar with in their home regions.
target: Mabalin a makasabat dagiti agbibiahe iti animal a peste a saanda pay a nakitkita iti naggappuanda.

source: Translate this sentence from eng to ilo: Pests can spoil food, cause irritation, or in a worse case cause allergic reactions, spread venom, or transmit infections.
target: Agdadael dagiti peste iti taraon, makaigapu iti iritasion, wenno iti nakaro a kaso ket makaigapu iti allergy, agiwaras iti gita, wenno agiyakar iti impeksion.

source: Translate this sentence from eng to ilo: Infectious diseases themselves, or dangerous animals that can injure or kill people by force, do not usually qualify as pests.
target: Dagiti makaakar a sakit, wenno napeggad nga ayup a mabalin a makadadangran wenno makapatay ti tao gapu iti puersa, ket saan a mabalin nga awagan a peste.

source: Translate this sentence from eng to ilo: Duty free shopping is the opportunity to buy goods exempted from taxes and excises at certain locations.
target: Ti panaggatang manipud kadagiti duty free ket oportunidad a gumatang iti bambanag nga awan ti buis ken kaltasna iti dadduma a lugar.

source: Translate this sentence from eng to ilo: Travellers bound for countries with heavy taxation can sometimes save a considerable amount of money, especially on products such as alcoholic beverages and tobacco.
target: Dagiti agbiahe a mapan iti pagilian nga adda nadagsen a panagbuis ket no maminsan agurnongda ti kanayonan a kantidad ti kuarta, aglalo dagidiay produkto a kas kadagiti mainom nga arak ken tabako.

source: Translate this sentence from eng to ilo: The stretch between Point Marion and Fairmont presents the most challenging driving conditions on the Buffalo-Pittsburgh Highway, passing frequently through isolated backwoods terrain.
target: Ti bennat nga adda iti baet ti Point Marion ken Fairmont ket mangidanon ti karirigatan a kondision iti panagmaneho idiay kalsada iti Buffalo-Pittsburgh, a kanayonmo malabsanan ti naisinsina nga aw-away a daga.

source: Translate this sentence from eng to ilo: If you're not used to driving on country roads, keep your wits about you: steep grades, narrow lanes, and sharp curves predominate.
target: No saanka a nasanay nga agmaneho kadagiti daldalan iti pagilian, pagtalinaeden ti kinasiribmo: narangkis unay a lugar, nailet a daldalan, ken natatadem a kurba ti kaaaduan.

source: Translate this sentence from eng to ilo: Posted speed limits are noticeably lower than in previous and subsequent sections — commonly 35-40 mph (56-64 km/h) — and strict obedience to them is even more important than otherwise.
target: Alternative: Dagiti nakapaskil nga speed limit ket makita a nababbaba ngem kadagiti umun-una ken sumarsaruno a seksion — gagangay a 35-40 mph (56-64 km/h) — ken nakaim-importante ti panangsurot kadagitoy.

source: Translate this sentence from eng to ilo: Curiously, though, mobile phone service is much stronger here than along many other stretches of the route, e.g. the Pennsylvania Wilds.
target: Nupay makapasiddaaw, napigpigsa ti serbisio ti mobile a telepono ditoy ngem iti adu a sabali a distansia ti ruta, kas pagarigan ti Pennsylvania Wilds.

source: Translate this sentence from eng to ilo: German pastries are quite good, and in Bavaria, are quite rich and varied, similar to those of their southern neighbor, Austria.
target: Dagiti sinam-it ti German ket naimas, ken idiay Bavaria, ket napusek ken agduduma, kapada dagidiay kukua ti kaarrubada, Austria.

source: Translate this sentence from eng to ilo: Fruit pastries are common, with apples cooked into pastries year round, and cherries and plums making their appearances during the summer.
target: Gagangayen dagiti tinapay nga adda prutasna, kas kadagiti mansanas a mailutluto kadagiti tinapay iti sibubukel a tawen, ken dagiti cherry ken plum nga agparang kabayatan ti kalgaw.

source: Translate this sentence from eng to ilo: Many German baked goods also feature almonds, hazelnuts, and other tree nuts. Popular cakes often pair particularly well with a cup of strong coffee.
target: Adu a tinapay ti Aleman ti addaan met kadagiti almond, hazelnut, ken dadduma pay a nagetta a bukbukel ti kayo. Masansan a naimas a maiparis dagiti nalatak a cake iti maysa a tasa ti naingel a kape.

source: Translate this sentence from eng to ilo: If you want some small though rich pastries, try what depending on region are called Berliner, Pfannkuchen or Krapfen.
target: No kayatmo ti babassit ngem nabaknang a tinapay, padasem ti inyaan nga agpannuray iti rehion a makuna a Berliner, Pfannkuchen wenno Krapfen.

source: Translate this sentence from eng to ilo: A curry is a dish based on herbs and spices, together with either meat or vegetables.
target: Ti curry ket maysa a lutona a nakabatay iti dadduma a yerba ken rekado, kadua iti aniaman ti karne wenno nateng.

source: Translate this sentence from eng to ilo: A curry can be either "dry" or "wet" depending on the amount of liquid.
target: Ti curry ket mabalin a “namaga” wenno “nabasa” depende ti kaadu ti danumna.

source: Translate this sentence from eng to ilo: In inland regions of Northern India and Pakistan, yogurt is commonly used in curries; in Southern India and some other coastal regions of the subcontinent, coconut milk is commonly used.
target: Kadagiti nauneg a rehion iti Umamianan nga India ken Pakistan, gagangay a mausar ti yogurt kadagiti potahe a curry; iti Umabagatan nga India ken sumagmamano a rehion iti igid ti baybay ti subkontinente, getta ti niog ti gagangay a masansan a mausar.

source: Translate this sentence from eng to ilo: With 17,000 islands to choose from, Indonesian food is an umbrella term covering a vast variety of regional cuisines found across the nation.
target: Adda ti 17,000 nga isla a pagpilian, ti makan idiay Indonesia ket naimbuklan daigiti adu a naduma-duma a makmakan ti rehion a makita iti entero a pagilian.

source: Translate this sentence from eng to ilo: But, if used without further qualifiers, the term tends to mean the food originally from the central and eastern parts of the main island Java.
target: Ngem, no inusar nga awan ti naanay a qualifiers, ti sao ken mabalin a makan a naggapu ti sentro ken amianan a parte ti baetan iti isla ti Java.

source: Translate this sentence from eng to ilo: Now widely available throughout the archipelago, Javanese cuisine features an array of simply seasoned dishes, the predominant flavorings the Javanese favor being peanuts, chillies, sugar (especially Javanese coconut sugar) and various aromatic spices.
target: Itan ket magatangmo ti entero a arkipelago, ti Javanese a makmakan ket mangiparparang iti adu a pagpilian ti nalag-an a natimplaan a putahe, dagiti pakailasinan a raman ti Javanese ket pumabor ti mani, sili, asukar (aglalo ti asukar ti niyog a Javanese) ken nadumaduma nga aromatiko a pagtimpla.

source: Translate this sentence from eng to ilo: Stirrups are supports for the rider's feet that hang down on either side of the saddle.
target: Dagiti stirrup ket suporta ti saka ti agluglugan nga agbibitin iti dua nga igid ti pagtugawan iti kabalio.

source: Translate this sentence from eng to ilo: They provide greater stability for the rider but can have safety concerns due to the potential for a rider's feet to get stuck in them.
target: Mangtedda ti naindaklan a kinatibker kadagiti nakalugan ngem addaan ti pakaseknan para iti kinatalged gapu ta mabalin a maidekket iti saka ti aglugan.

source: Translate this sentence from eng to ilo: If a rider is thrown from a horse but has a foot caught in the stirrup, they could be dragged if the horse runs away. To minimize this risk, a number of safety precautions can be taken.
target: No maregreg ti agluglugan iti kabalio ket maisab-it ti sakana iti stirrup, mabalin a maulod isuna no ti kabalio ket tumaray. Tapno makissayan ti peggad, sumagmamano a natalged a panagannad ti mabalin a maaramid.

source: Translate this sentence from eng to ilo: First, most riders wear riding boots with a heel and a smooth, quite narrow, sole.
target: Umuna, kaaduan kadagiti agsakay ket agisuot ti botas a panglugan nga addaan iti takon ken nalamuyot, akikid, a suelas.

source: Translate this sentence from eng to ilo: Next, some saddles, particularly English saddles, have safety bars that allow a stirrup leather to fall off the saddle if pulled backwards by a falling rider.
target: Sumaruno, sumagmamano a silia ti kabalio, lalo dagiti silia dagiti Ingles, ket addaan iti natalged a landok a mangisina iti lalat a suporta ti saka manipud iti silia no guyoden daytoy ti matmatnag a nakasakay.

source: Translate this sentence from eng to ilo: Cochamó Valley - Chile's premier climbing destination, known as the Yosemite of South America, with a variety of granite big walls and crags.
target: Cochamó Valley - Kamayatan a pagulian a bantay iti Chile, maawawagan a Yosemite iti Abagatan nga Amerika, nga addaan ti nadumaduma a dadakkel a pader ken bantay ti granite.

source: Translate this sentence from eng to ilo: Summits include breath-taking views from peaks. Climbers from all parts of the world are continually establishing new routes amongst its endless potential of walls.
target: Makita kadagiti tuktok ti bantay dagiti makatengngel-anges a buya manipud iti alimpatok. Agtultuloy dagiti mangnguli nga aggapu iti amin a parte ti lubong nga agar-aramid kadagiti kabarbaro a pagnaan kadagiti awan ungtona a mabalin a pagdalanan a didingna.

source: Translate this sentence from eng to ilo: Downhill snowsports, which include skiing and snowboarding, are popular sports involving sliding down snow-covered terrain with skis or a snowboard attached to your feet.
target: Nalatak nga isports dagiti agpasalog nga isports a para niebe, a pakairamanan ti panag-ski ken panag-snowboard, a kasapulan ti panagpauyas nga agpababa iti naaplagan iti niebe a pagdalanan babaen kadagiti ski wenno snowboard a maikapet iti saka.

source: Translate this sentence from eng to ilo: Skiing is a major travelling activity with many enthusiasts, occasionally known as "ski bums," planning entire vacations around skiing at a particular location.
target: Ti panag-ski ti kangrunaan nga aktibidad a panagbiahe nga adu dagiti mangayat, a gagangay a maawagan kas “ski bums,” ti mangplanplano kadagiti sibubukel a bakasion nga ag-ski iti maysa a lugar.

source: Translate this sentence from eng to ilo: The idea of skiing is very old — cave paintings depicting skiers date back as far as 5000 BC!
target: Ti kapanunotan ti panag-ski ket daan unayen - dagiti ladawan ti kueba nga ipakpakitana dagiti manag-ski ket naaramid iti kas kaadayo ti 5000 BC!

source: Translate this sentence from eng to ilo: Downhill skiing as a sport goes back to at least the 17th century, and in 1861 the first recreational ski club was opened by Norwegians in Australia.
target: Idi maika-17 a siglo ti panagpasalog a panag-iski a kas isport, ket idi 1861 Iinuktan dagiti Norweigan idiay Australia ti umuna a klab ti paglinglingayan nga iski

source: Translate this sentence from eng to ilo: Backpacking by ski: This activity is also called backcountry ski, ski touring or ski hiking.
target: Backpacking babaen iti ski: Maawagan pay daytoy nga aktibidad a kas panag-ski iti aw-away, ski touring wenno ski hiking.

source: Translate this sentence from eng to ilo: It is related to but usually not involving alpine style ski touring or mountaineering, the latter ones done in steep terrain and requiring much stiffer skis and boots.
target: Mainaig daytoy ngem gagangay a saanda iraman ti panagpasyar wenno panaguli iti bantay nga adda istilona nga alpine ski, ti naudi ket maubra iti narangkis a daga ken kasapula ti natangtangken a ski ken bota.

source: Translate this sentence from eng to ilo: Think of the skiing route as of a similar hiking route.
target: Panunotem a ti ruta ti panag-iski ket kasla ti ruta ti panaguli iti bantay.

source: Translate this sentence from eng to ilo: In good conditions you will be able to cover somewhat greater distances than walking – but only very seldom you will get the speeds of cross country skiing without a heavy backpack in groomed tracks.
target: Iti nasayaat a kondision ad-adayo ti madanunmo ngem no magmagnaka - ngem manmano laeng a madanunmo iti kapaspas ti panag-iski nga awan ti nadagsen a bitbitem kadagiti naiplastar a pag-iskian.

source: Translate this sentence from eng to ilo: Europe is a continent that is relatively small but with many independent countries. Under normal circumstances, travelling through multiple countries would mean having to go through visa applications and passport control multiple times.
target: Ti Europa ket maysa a kontinente a bassit ngem addaan adu nga independiente a nasion. Iti gagangay a kasasaad, ti panagbiahe iti adu a nasion ket kaduan ti panagala ti visa ken panagkontrol ti passport iti adu a beses.

source: Translate this sentence from eng to ilo: The Schengen zone, however, works somewhat like one country in this respect.
target: Ngem ti lugar ti Schengen, nupay kasta, agobra a kas maysa a pagilian iti daytoy a banag.

source: Translate this sentence from eng to ilo: As long as you stay in this zone, you can generally cross borders without going through passport control checkpoints again.
target: No la ketdi agtalinaedka kadagitoy a lugar, gagangay a makaballasiwka kadagiti beddeng a saankan nga aglasat kadagiti checkpoint a mangkonkontrol iti passport.

source: Translate this sentence from eng to ilo: Similarly, by having a Schengen visa, you do not need to apply for visas to each of the Schengen member countries separately, hence saving time, money and paperwork.
target: Kapadana, ti kaadda ti Schengen visam, saanmo a kasapulanen ti mangala kadagiti visa iti sabsabali a pagilian a miembro ti Schengen, pakaurnungam ti oras, kuarta ken papeles.

source: Translate this sentence from eng to ilo: There is no universal definition for which manufactured items are antiques. Some tax agencies define goods older than 100 years as antiques.
target: Awan ti unibersal a pannakaammo no kasano maibaga a ti maysa a banag ket antigo. Ti dadduma nga ahensia ti buwis ket ibagbagada a ti bambanag a nabaybayag ngem iti 100 a tawen a kas antigo.

source: Translate this sentence from eng to ilo: The definition has geographic variations, where the age limit might be shorter in places such as North America than in Europe.
target: Addaan ti depinisionna iti heograpiko panagduduma, a ti limitasion ti edad ket mabalin nga ab-ababa iti dadduma a luglugar kas iti Amianan nga America ngem iti Europa.

source: Translate this sentence from eng to ilo: Handicraft products might be defined as antiques, though they are younger than similar mass-produced goods.
target: Dagiti produkto nga inaramid ti ima ket mabalin a madepinar a nabayagen, uray pay no ub-ubingda kadagiti kapada a produkto a napataud a nakaad-adu.

source: Translate this sentence from eng to ilo: Reindeer husbandry is an important livelihood among the Sámi and the culture surrounding the trade is important also for many with other professions.
target: Ti panagtaraken ti ugsa ket nasisita a pagbiagan dagiti Sami ken ti kultura ti panaglako ket nasisita met para iti adu a sabali pay a pagubraan.

source: Translate this sentence from eng to ilo: Even traditionally, though, not all Sámi have been involved in big scale reindeer husbandry, but lived from fishing, hunting and similar, having reindeer mostly as draft animals.
target: Uray man pay iti tradision, ngem, saan amin a Sámi ket mairaman iti dinnakkel a panagtaraken ti ugsa, ngem nagbiagda bayat iti panagkalap, panagtiliw ti animal ken pada, a pagbalbalinen laeng ti ugsa a pangbunag nga ayup.

source: Translate this sentence from eng to ilo: Today many Sámi work in modern trades. Tourism is an important income in Sápmi, the Sámi area.
target: Kadagitoy ket adu a Sámi ti agububra iti baro a trabaho. Ti turismo ket maysa a nasisita a pagganansyaan iti Sápmi, ti paset ti Sámi.

source: Translate this sentence from eng to ilo: Though it is widely used, especially among non-Romani, the word "Gypsy" is often considered offensive because of its associations with negative stereotypes and inaccurate perceptions of Romani people.
target: Uray man pay nga ususaren ti kaaduan ti daytoy, aglalo kadagiti saan a Romani, ti sao a “Gypsy” ket maibilbilang a pammerdi gapu iti panakainaigna iti negatibo a sterotype ken saan a husto a panangkita ti tattao iti Romania.

source: Translate this sentence from eng to ilo: If the country you will be visiting becomes subject to a travel advisory, your travel health insurance or your trip cancellation insurance may be affected.
target: No iti pagilian a papanam ket agbalin nga addaan ti padamag ti panagbiahe, ti insurance ti salun-at ti panagbiahem wenno ti insurance ti panagkansela ti biahem ket mabalin a maapektaran.

source: Translate this sentence from eng to ilo: You may also wish to consult the advice of governments other than your own, but their advice is designed for their citizens.
target: Mabalinmo met a konsultaen ti pammagbaga dagiti gobierno a saan laeng a ti bukbukodmo, ngem ket nairanta pammagbagada a para kadagiti umilida.

source: Translate this sentence from eng to ilo: As one example, American citizens in the Middle East might face different situations from Europeans or Arabs.
target: Maysa a pagarigan, dagiti umili ti Amerika idiay Tengnga a Daya ket mabalin a sumango iti nadumaduma a kasasaad aggapu kadagiti taga-Europa wenno Arabo.

source: Translate this sentence from eng to ilo: Advisories are merely a brief summary of the political situation in one country.
target: Ti balbalakad ket maysa laeng nga ababa a pakagupgopan ti kasasaad ti pulitika iti maysa a pagilian.

source: Translate this sentence from eng to ilo: The views presented are often cursory, general and oversimplified compared to the more detailed information available elsewhere.
target: Dagiti kapanunotan a naipresenta ditoy ket masansan a parparawpaw, nalawa ken napasimple la unay kumpara kadagiti nadetdetalye nga impormasion a masarakan iti dadduma.

source: Translate this sentence from eng to ilo: Severe weather is the generic term for any dangerous weather phenomenon with the potential to cause damage, serious social disruption, or loss of human life.
target: Nakaro a tiempo ti awag iti aniaman a napeggad a tiempo nga adda iti kabaelanna a makaigapu iti dadael, seryoso a mangatipa ti kasasaad, wenno panangbawi iti biag ti tattao.

source: Translate this sentence from eng to ilo: Severe weather can occur anywhere in the world, and there are different types of it, which can depend on geography, topography, and atmospheric conditions.
target: Ti nakaro a tiempo ket mabalin a mapasamak sadinoman iti lubong, ken adu ti klasena, a mabalin a nakadependar iti heograpia, topograpia, ken iti kondision ti atmospera.

source: Translate this sentence from eng to ilo: High winds, hail, excessive precipitation, and wildfires are forms and effects of severe weather, as are thunderstorms, tornadoes, waterspouts, and cyclones.
target: Nangato nga angin, uraro, nalabes a tudo, ken puor iti kabakiran dagita ket kita ken epekto ti napalalo a tiempo, a kas kadagiti bagyo, allawig, alipugpog ti danum, ken ipo-ipo.

source: Translate this sentence from eng to ilo: Regional and seasonal severe weather phenomena include blizzards, snowstorms, ice storms, and dust storms.
target: Dagiti rehional ken napanawen a nakaro a penomena ti panawen ket pakairamanan ti, bagyo iti yelo, napigsa a niebe, ken bagyo ti tapok.

source: Translate this sentence from eng to ilo: Travellers are strongly advised to be aware of any risk of severe weather affecting their area as they may affect any travel plans.
target: Dagiti agbibiahe ket mabagaan nga agannad iti mabalin a peggad a gapu iti nakaro a tiempo a mabalin a makaapekto iti lugar a mabalin a maapektaran ti planoda a panagbiahe.

source: Translate this sentence from eng to ilo: Anyone planning a visit to a country that could be considered a war zone should get professional training.
target: Asinoman nga agplano a bumisita iti pagilian a mabalin a maibaga a lugar a paggugubatan ket masapul nga agala ti propesional a panagsanay.

source: Translate this sentence from eng to ilo: A search of the Internet for 'Hostile environment course' will probably provide the address of a local company.
target: Ti panangbirok iti Internet para iti “naranggas nga aglawlaw a kurso” ket mabalin a maited iti lokal a kompania.

source: Translate this sentence from eng to ilo: A course will normally cover all the issues discussed here in far greater detail, usually with practical experience.
target: Ti maysa a kurso ket gagangay a mangisuro amin nga isyu a napagsaritaan ditoy a mas detalyado, kaaduananna ket addaan ti praktikal a kapkapadasan.

source: Translate this sentence from eng to ilo: A course will normally be from 2-5 days and will involve role play, a lot of first aid and sometimes weapons training.
target: Ti kurso ket gagangay a manipud iti 2-5 nga aldaw ken pakairamanan ti panangtulad iti karakter, adu ti umuna a panangtaripato ken no maminsan ket panagsanay iti panagusar ti armas.

source: Translate this sentence from eng to ilo: Books and magazines dealing with wilderness survival are common, but publications dealing with war zones are few.
target: Dagiti libro ken magasin maipanggep iti panagbiag ti kasamsamekan ket adu, ngem dagiti naisurat maipanggep iti gubgubat ket manmano.

source: Translate this sentence from eng to ilo: Voyagers planning sex reassignment surgery abroad must ensure they're carrying valid documents for the return trip.
target: Dagiti agbibiahe nga addaan ti plano nga agpasukat ti sekso iti ballasiw-taaw ket masapul a siguraduenda nga tugotda dagiti balido a dokumento para iti panagsublida

source: Translate this sentence from eng to ilo: The willingness of governments to issue passports with gender not stated (X) or documents updated to match a desired name and gender varies.
target: Ti ayat iti gobierno a mangted ti pasaporte nga adda nakakabil a saan a naibaga ti sekso (X) wenno dagiti dokumento a napabaro tapno maibagay iti kayat a nagan wenno sekso ket nadumaduma.

source: Translate this sentence from eng to ilo: Willingness of foreign governments to honour these documents is just as widely variable.
target: Ti kinaayat dagiti gobierno iti sabali a pagilian a dayawen dagitoy a dokumento ket agduduma a banag.

source: Translate this sentence from eng to ilo: Searches at security checkpoints have also become far more intrusive in the post-September 11, 2001 era.
target: Imminget met unay ti panagbukitkit kadagiti checkpoint ti seguridad iti panawen kalpasan ti Setiembre 11, 2001.

source: Translate this sentence from eng to ilo: Pre-operative transgender people should not expect to pass through the scanners with their privacy and dignity intact.
target: Dagiti transgender a saan pay a naoperaan ket saan koma a mangnamnama a makalasat kadagiti iskaner nga addaan pay laeng ti pribado ken dignidad a sibubukel.

source: Translate this sentence from eng to ilo: Rip currents are the returning flow from waves breaking off the beach, often at a reef or similar.
target: Dagiti rip a kuriente ket dagiti agsubli a daloy ti dalluyon a mapmapan iti baybay, kaaduan ket iti reef wenno padana.

source: Translate this sentence from eng to ilo: Due to the underwater topology the return flow is concentrated at a few deeper sections, and a fast current to deep water may form there.
target: Gapu iti topolohia iti uneg ti danom ti daloy a pasubli ket naipatang iti manmano nga adalem a pasetna, ken ti napaspas a kuryente iti naadalem a danum ket mabalin a mangrugi sadiay.

source: Translate this sentence from eng to ilo: Most deaths happen as result of fatigue trying to swim back against the current, which may be impossible.
target: Kaaduan kadagiti ipapatay ket mapaspasamak a kas resulta ti pannakabannog iti panaglangoy kontra iti kuryente, a dandani imposible.

source: Translate this sentence from eng to ilo: As soon as you get out of the current, swimming back is no more difficult than normally.
target: Apaman a makaruarka iti kuriente, ti panaglangoy nga agsubli ket saan a narigaten.

source: Translate this sentence from eng to ilo: Try aiming somewhere where you are not caught again or, depending on your skills and on whether you have been noticed, you might want to wait for rescue.
target: Padasem a agyan iti lugar a saankan to matiliwen, wenno, depende iti kinalaingmo ken wenno no napansindakan, mabalin nga agurayka laengen iti pannakaisalakan.

source: Translate this sentence from eng to ilo: Re-entry shock comes on sooner than culture shock (there's less of a honeymoon phase), lasts longer, and can be more severe.
target: Ti panagserrek manen ti panagkigtot ket umay a nasapsapa ngem ti kigtot iti kultura (adda nababbaba ngem iti panawen ti honeymoon), nabaybayag pagpatenggaa na, ken mabalin a nakarkaro pay.

source: Translate this sentence from eng to ilo: Travellers who had an easy time adjusting to the new culture sometimes have a particularly hard time readjusting to their native culture.
target: Dagiti biahero nga alisto makibagay iti baro a kultura ket no dadduma ket marigatan nga agsubli iti bukodna a kultura.

source: Translate this sentence from eng to ilo: When returning home after living abroad, you've adapted to the new culture and lost some of your habits from your home culture.
target: No agsubli iti balay malpas a nagtalinaed idiay sabali a nasion, naalam dagiti baro a kultura ken naibbatam dagiti nakasanayam a naggapu iti kultura iti balay a naggapuam.

source: Translate this sentence from eng to ilo: When you went abroad at first, people were probably patient and understanding, knowing that travellers in a new country need to adapt.
target: No damom mapan iti ballasiw-taaw, dagiti tao ket mabalin a naanus ken mannakaawat, ammoda a ti biahero iti sabali a pagilian ket masapul a makipada.

source: Translate this sentence from eng to ilo: People may not anticipate that patience and understanding are also necessary for travellers returning home.
target: Mabalin a saan a namaen dagiti tattao a ti anus ken pannakaawat ket masapul met para kadagiti agbibiahe nga agawid.

source: Translate this sentence from eng to ilo: The pyramid sound and light show is one of the most interesting things in the area for kids.
target: Ti pabuya a silaw ken uni a piramida ket maysa kadagiti nakain-interesante a banag idiay lugar para kadagiti ubbing.

source: Translate this sentence from eng to ilo: You can see the pyramids in the dark and you can see them in silence before the show begins.
target: Makitam dagiti piramide iti kasipngetan ken makitam ida a naulimek sakbay a mangrugi ti pabuya.

source: Translate this sentence from eng to ilo: Usually you always here the sound of tourists and vendors. The story of the sound and light is just like a story book.
target: Masansan a kankanayon nga aridtoy iti uni dagiti turista ken aglaklako. Ti istoria ti uni ken silaw ket kasla met lang libro iti istoria.

source: Translate this sentence from eng to ilo: The Sphinx is set as the backdrop and the narrator of a long story.
target: Ti Sphinx ti pinagbalinda a buya ken agsasao iti atiddog nga estoria.

source: Translate this sentence from eng to ilo: The scenes are displayed on the pyramids and the different pyramids are lit up.
target: Dagiti buya ket naipakita idiay piramida ken iti sabsabali a piramida ket nasilawan.

source: Translate this sentence from eng to ilo: South Shetland Islands, discovered in 1819, are claimed by several nations and have the most bases, with sixteen active in 2020.
target: Ti South Shetland Islands, a nadiskubre iti 1819, ket tagtagikuaen dagiti sumagmamano a nasion ken addaan iti kaaduan a base, a sangapulo ken innem kadagitoy ti aktibo idi 2020.

source: Translate this sentence from eng to ilo: The archipelago lies 120 km north of the Peninsula. The largest is King George Island with the settlement of Villa Las Estrellas.
target: Ti arkipelago ket adda iti 120 a kilometro iti amianan ti Peninsula. Ti kadakkelan nga isla ket ti King George Island nga ayan ti Villa Las Estrellas.

source: Translate this sentence from eng to ilo: Others include Livingston Island, and Deception where the flooded caldera of a still-active volcano provides a spectacular natural harbour.
target: Ti dadduma iramanna ti Isla ti Livingston, ken Deception no ayanna ket iti nalayus a kaldera iti maysa nga aktibo pay laeng a bulkan ket mangted ti nakapinpintas a natural a baybay.

source: Translate this sentence from eng to ilo: Ellsworth Land is the region south of the Peninsula, bounded by the Bellingshausen Sea.
target: Ti Ellsworth Land ti rehiyon a makin-abagatan ti Peninsula, a kadikket ti Baybay Bellingshausen.

source: Translate this sentence from eng to ilo: The mountains of the Peninsula here merge into the plateau, then re-emerge to form the 360 km chain of the Ellsworth Mountains, bisected by the Minnesota Glacier.
target: Ti kabanbantayan iti Peninsula ditoy ket agtipon idiay banak, idi kuan rumuar manen tapno mangbukel ti 360 km a kadena iti Banbantay ti Ellsworth, nangbingay iti Minnesota Glacier.

source: Translate this sentence from eng to ilo: The northern part or Sentinel Range has Antarctica's highest mountains, the Vinson Massif, peaking at 4892 m Mount Vinson.
target: Ti umamianan a paset wenno Sentinel Range ket addaan kadagiti kangangatuan a kabambantayan ti Antarctica , ti Vinson Massif, nga agtayag iti 4892 a metro Mount Vinson.

source: Translate this sentence from eng to ilo: In remote locations, without cell phone coverage, a satellite phone may be your only option.
target: Kadagiti nasulinek a lugar, a di madanon ti serbisio ti cell phone, mabalin a ti satellite phone laeng ti piliem.

source: Translate this sentence from eng to ilo: A satellite phone is not generally a replacement for a mobile phone, as you have to be outdoors with clear line of sight to the satellite to make a phone call.
target: Ti satellite a telepono ket saan a naan-anay a kasukat para iti mobile phone, ta kasapulam a mapan iti ruar nga adda ti nalawag a linya iti kita idiay satellite tapno makaaramidka ti tawag.

source: Translate this sentence from eng to ilo: The service is frequently used by shipping, including pleasure craft, as well as expeditions who have remote data and voice needs.
target: Kanayon a maususar dagitoy babaen ti panangipatulod, a pakairamanan ti pleasure craft, kasta met kadagiti ekspedision nga agkasapulan ti adayo a koneksion ti data ken awag.

source: Translate this sentence from eng to ilo: Your local telephone service provider should be able to give more information about connecting to this service.
target: Ti lokal a mangmangted ti serbisio ti teleponom ket masapul a mabalin a mangted ti ad-adu pay nga impormasion panggep ti panagkonektar kadagitoy a serbisio.

source: Translate this sentence from eng to ilo: An increasingly more popular option for those planning a gap-year is to travel and learn.
target: Ti lumatlatak a pagpilian para kadagiti agplanplano ti baet ti tawen ket agbiahe ken agsursuro.

source: Translate this sentence from eng to ilo: This is especially popular with school leavers, allowing them to take a year out before university, without compromising their education.
target: Kangrunaan a nalatak daytoy kadagiti pumanaw ti eskuela, a mangipalubos kadakuada a mangala ti sangatawen sakbay ti unibersidad, a saanda isugal ti edukasion.

source: Translate this sentence from eng to ilo: In many cases, enrolling on a gap-year course abroad can actually improve your chances of moving into higher education back in your home country.
target: Kaaduanna, ti panagenrol iti kurso iti sabali a pagilian bayat ti gap-year ket mangted iti dakdakkel a tsansa a makastrekkanto iti nangatngato nga edukasion no agsublika iti pagiliam.

source: Translate this sentence from eng to ilo: Typically there will be a tuition fee to enroll in these educational programs.
target: Gagangay laeng nga adda ti bayadan a matrikula tapno makapalistaka kadagitoy a programa ti edukasion.

source: Translate this sentence from eng to ilo: Finland is a great boating destination. The "Land of a thousand lakes" has thousands of islands too, in the lakes and in the coastal archipelagos.
target: Ti Finland ket napintas a lugar a pagbangkaan. Ti “Daga iti ribo nga lawa” ket naaddaan ti rinibo-ribo met nga isla, kadagiti dan-aw ken kadagiti ili iti baybay.

source: Translate this sentence from eng to ilo: In the archipelagos and lakes you do not necessarily need a yacht.
target: Kadagiti arkipelago ken dan-aw saanmo a kasapulan ti yate.

source: Translate this sentence from eng to ilo: Although the coastal archipelagos and the biggest lakes are indeed big enough for any yacht, smaller boats or even a kayak offer a different experience.
target: Uray pay no dagiti napalawlawan iti baybay nga arkipelago ken dagiti kadadakkelan a dan-aw ket pudno a dakkel a makaanayen para iti aniaman a yate, mangipaay met iti naiduma a kapadasan dagiti babassit a bangka wenno uray kayak.

source: Translate this sentence from eng to ilo: Boating is a national pastime in Finland, with a boat to every seven or eight people.
target: Ti panagbangka  ti maysa a pagpalabasan ti oras dagiti tattao idiay Finland, maysa a bangka iti kada pito wenno walo a tattao.

source: Translate this sentence from eng to ilo: This is matched by Norway, Sweden and New Zealand, but otherwise quite unique (e.g. in the Netherlands the figure is one to forty).
target: Linabanan daytoy ti Norway, Sweden ken New Zealand, ngem sabsabali latta (e. g. Ti Netherlands ti bilangna ket maysa kada uppat a pulo).

source: Translate this sentence from eng to ilo: Most of the distinct Baltic Cruises feature an extended stay in St. Petersburg, Russia.
target: Kaaduan ti kangrunaan a Barko ti Baltic ket mangmangted ti pinaatiddog a panagtaeng idiay St. Petersburg, Russia.

source: Translate this sentence from eng to ilo: This means you can visit the historic city for a couple of full days while returning and sleeping on the ship at night.
target: Kayat a sawen daytoy a mabalinmo a bisitaen ti kadaanan a siudad iti dua a sibubukel nga aldaw kabayatan nga iti rabii, agsublika a maturog iti barko.

source: Translate this sentence from eng to ilo: If you only go ashore using shipboard excursions you will not need a separate visa (as of 2009).
target: No mapanka laeng sumanglad babaen ti panagpasiar kadagiti bapor ket saanmo kasapulan ti naisina a visa (idi pay 2009).

source: Translate this sentence from eng to ilo: Some cruises feature Berlin, Germany in the brochures. As you can see from the map above Berlin is no where near the sea and a visit to the city is not included in the price of the cruise.
target: Sumagmamano a barko a cruise ti mangiparang iti Berlin, Germany kadagiti brochure. Kas makitam iti mapa ti ngato, saan nga asideg ti Berlin iti baybay ken saan a nairaman ti panangbista iti siudad iti presio ti cruise.

source: Translate this sentence from eng to ilo: Travelling by plane can be a scary experience for people of all ages and backgrounds, particularly if they've not flown before or have experienced a traumatic event.
target: Mabalin a nakabutbuteng a padas ti panagbiahe iti eroplano para kadagiti tattao iti amin nga edad ken pakasaritaan ti biag, nangruna no dida pay nakapagbiahe idi wenno nakapadas iti kaam-amak a pasamak.

source: Translate this sentence from eng to ilo: It is not something to be ashamed of: it is no different from the personal fears and dislikes of other things that very many people have.
target: Daytoy ket maysa a banag a saan a masapul nga ibain: saan daytoy naisabsabali kadagiti personal a buteng ken saan a panangayat kadagiti dadduma a bambanag nga addan ti bassit a bilang ti tattao.

source: Translate this sentence from eng to ilo: For some, understanding something about how aircraft work and what happens during a flight may help to overcome a fear which is based on the unknown or on not being in control.
target: Para iti dadduma, ti panangawat no kasano nga umandar ti eroplano ken no ania ti mapaspasamak bayat ti panagtayab ket mabalin a makaparmek ti panagbuteng a naggapu iti awan wenno kinaawan ti kontrol.

source: Translate this sentence from eng to ilo: Courier companies are well paid for delivering things quickly. Frequently, time is very important with business documents, merchandise or spare parts for an urgent repair.
target: Dagiti kompania ti panagpaw-it ket nasayaat a mabaybayadan gapu iti napartak a serbisioda. Masansan a napateg ti oras para iti dokumento ti negosio, panaggatang wenno parpartes para iti alisto a panagtarimaan.

source: Translate this sentence from eng to ilo: On some routes, the larger companies have their own planes, but for other routes and smaller firms there was a problem.
target: Iti sumagmamano a ruta, addaan dagiti dadakkel a kompania iti bukodda nga eroplano, ngem adda problema para iti dadduma a ruta ken kadagiti basbassit a kompania.

source: Translate this sentence from eng to ilo: If they sent things by air freight, on some routes it may have taken days to get through unloading and customs.
target: No nagipatulodda babaen ti air friehgt, ti dadduma a ruta ket mabalin nga alaenna ti mano nga aldaw a lumasat iti panagibaba ken customs.

source: Translate this sentence from eng to ilo: The only way to get it through faster was to send it as checked luggage. Airline regulations will not allow them to send luggage without a passenger, which is where you come in.
target: Ti pamay-an laeng tapno makalasat a nadardaras ket ti panangipatulod kadagitoy kas nailista a bagahe. Dagiti linteg ti eroplano saanda a palubosan dagitoy nga ipaw-it dagiti bagahe nga awan pasaherona, ket kadagitoy a situasionka a sumrek.

source: Translate this sentence from eng to ilo: The obvious way of flying in first or business class is to fork out a thick wad of money for the privilege (or, better yet, get your company to do it for you).
target: Ti nalawag a wagas ti panagtayab ti umuna wenno pang-negosio a klase ket no agbayad ti adu a kuarta para iti pribilehio (wenno, nasaysayaat ket, bay-am a ti kompaniam ti mangaramid para kenka).

source: Translate this sentence from eng to ilo: However, this does not come cheap: as rough rules of thumb, you can expect to pay up to four times the normal economy fare for business, and eleven times for first class!
target: Ngem saan a nalaka ti bayad daytoy: no kuentaem, baka mamimpat iti presio ti gagangay nga economy class ti pletem para iti business class, ken mamin-onse met para iti first class!

source: Translate this sentence from eng to ilo: Generally speaking, there is no point in even looking for discounts for business or first-class seats on direct flights from A to B.
target: Iti kaaduanna, awan mamaayna nga uray agbirok kadagiti diskuento iti para negosio wenno primera-klase a tugtugaw kadagiti direkta a panagtayab manipud A a mapan iti B.

source: Translate this sentence from eng to ilo: Airlines know well that there is a certain core group of flyers who are willing to pay top dollar for the privilege of getting somewhere fast and in comfort, and charge accordingly.
target: Ammo dagiti airline  nga adda maysa a partikular a grupo dagiti managbiahe iti eroplano a sisasagana nga agbayad iti uray mano a doliar tapno laeng al-alisto ken mas komportableda a makadanon iti sadinoman a papananda, isu a singirenda ida iti maitutop.

source: Translate this sentence from eng to ilo: The capital of Moldova is Chişinău. The local language is Romanian, but Russian is widely used.
target: Ti kapitolio ti Modova ket Chişinău. Ti lokal a pagsasao ket Romanian, ngem Russian ti nalatak a maususar.

source: Translate this sentence from eng to ilo: Moldova is a multi-ethnic republic that has suffered from ethnic conflict.
target: Maysa a multi-etniko a republika ti Moldova a nagsagaba iti panaglalaban nga etniko.

source: Translate this sentence from eng to ilo: In 1994, this conflict led to the creation of the self-proclaimed Transnistria Republic in eastern Moldova, which has its own government and currency but is not recognised by any UN member country.
target: Idi 1994, daytoy a panagdangadang ket nagresulta iti pannakabukel ken pannakaiproklama a bukbukodna ti  Republika ti Transnistria iti makindaya a Moldova, nga addaan iti bukod a gobierno ken kuarta ngem saan a bigbigen ti aniaman a pagilian a miembro ti UN.

source: Translate this sentence from eng to ilo: Economic links have been re-established between these two parts of Moldova despite the failure in political negotiations.
target: Dagiti pagsilpuan ti ekonomiya ket naisubli iti baet dagitoy dua a paset ti Moldova uray pay madi nagbalin ti politikal a negosasion.

source: Translate this sentence from eng to ilo: The major religion in Moldova is Orthodox Christian.
target: Ti kangrunaan a relihion idiay Moldova ket Orthodox a kristiano.

source: Translate this sentence from eng to ilo: İzmir is the third largest city in Turkey with a population of around 3.7 million, the second biggest port after Istanbul, and a very good transport hub.
target: Ti İzmir ti maikatlo a kadadakkelan a siudad iti Turkey nga adda ti populasionna a dumanin 3.7 milyon, ti maikadua a kadadakkelan a porto kalpasan ti Istanbul, ken ti maysa a napintas a terminal.

source: Translate this sentence from eng to ilo: Once the ancient city of Smyrna, it is now a modern, developed, and busy commercial center, set around a huge bay and surrounded by mountains.
target: Naminsan ket dayta kadaanan a siudad ti Smyrna, ita ket baro, narang-ay, ken okupado a sentro ti negosio, naipasdek iti aglawlaw ti dakkel a luek ken napalikmutan ti bambantay.

source: Translate this sentence from eng to ilo: The broad boulevards, glass-fronted buildings and modern shopping centers are dotted with traditional red-tiled roofs, the 18th century market, and old mosques and churches, although the city has an atmosphere more of Mediterranean Europe than traditional Turkey.
target: Dagiti nalawa a kalsada, istruktura a sarming iti ruarna ken moderno a sentro ti paggatangan ket nadekorasionan ti nalabaga a baldosa nga atep, iti maika-18 siglo a palengke, daan a moske ken simbaan, uray no ti siudad mas addaan atmosperana a kasla Mediterranean Europe ngem tradisional a Turkey.

source: Translate this sentence from eng to ilo: The village of Haldarsvík offer views of the nearby island Eysturoy and has an unusual octagonal church.
target: Ti purok ti Haldarsvik ket agitukon ti makita iti kaabay nga isla ti Eysturoy ken ti naidumduma a simbaan a walo ti sulina.

source: Translate this sentence from eng to ilo: In the churchyard, there are interesting marble sculptures of doves over some tombs.
target: Itiparaangan ti simbaan, adda dagiti makapaawis a kitikit a marmol a kalapati a naiparabaw kadagiti dadduma a tanem.

source: Translate this sentence from eng to ilo: It's worth half an hour to stroll about the intriguing village.
target: Danonen ti kagudua oras ti panagpagna idiay makapaintriga nga ili.

source: Translate this sentence from eng to ilo: To the north and within easy reach is the romantic and fascinating town of Sintra and which was made famous to foreigners after a glowing account of its splendours recorded by Lord Byron.
target: Adda iti amianan ken nadaras a madanon ti romantiko ken makakayaw nga ili ti Sintra a nagbalin a nalatak kadagiti ganggannaet kalpasan ti panangisurat ni Lord Byron iti makaay-ayo a pannakailadawan ti kinapintasna.

source: Translate this sentence from eng to ilo: Scotturb Bus 403 travels regularly to Sintra, stopping at Cabo da Roca.
target: Ti Scotturb Bus 403 ket regular nga agbiahe iti Sintra, agsardeng idiay Cabo da Roca.

source: Translate this sentence from eng to ilo: Also to the north visit the great Sanctuary of Our Lady of Fatima (Shrine), a place of worldwide famous Marian apparitions.
target: Ken diay amianan, bisitaen ti dakkel a Sanctuary of Our Lady of Fatima (Sinantemplo), ti lugar ti nalatak ditoy lubong a pinagpakitaan ni Maria.

source: Translate this sentence from eng to ilo: Please remember that you are essentially visiting a mass grave site, as well as a site that has an almost incalculable meaning to a significant portion of the world's population.
target: Sapay koma ta napateg a lagipem a bumisbistaka iti lugar a nakataneman ti adu a tao, kasta met daytoy a lugar ket addan ti kaaduan a saan a makuenta a kaipanananna ti adu a paset iti populasion ti lubong.

source: Translate this sentence from eng to ilo: There are still many men and women alive who survived their time here, and many more who had loved ones who were murdered or worked to death there, Jews and non-Jews alike.
target: Adda pay ti adu a lallaki ken babbai a nabiag a nakalasatda iti panawenda ditoy, ken adu pay ti adda iti ay-ayatenna a pinatayda wenno pinagtrabahoda agingga a matay idiay, Hudio man wenno saan nga Hudio.

source: Translate this sentence from eng to ilo: Please treat the site with all of the dignity, solemnity and respect it deserves. Do not make jokes about the Holocaust or Nazis.
target: Tratuenyo koma ti lugar iti amin a dignidad, kinasagrado ken panagraem a maikari iti daytoy. Saankayo nga agangaw maipapan iti Holocaust wenno kadagiti Nazi.

source: Translate this sentence from eng to ilo: Do not deface the site by marking or scratching graffiti into structures.
target: Saanmo a dadaelen dayta lugar ti panangikabilmo ti marka wenno panagkarmot mo iti graffiti kadagita naipatakder.

source: Translate this sentence from eng to ilo: Barcelona's official languages are Catalan and Spanish. About a half prefer to speak Catalan, a vast majority understands it, and virtually everyone knows Spanish.
target: Dagiti opisial a pagsasao idiay Barcelona ket Catalan ken Espaniol. Nasurok kagudua ti mangayat nga agsao ti Catalan, kaaduan ket maawatanna daytoy, ken dandani amin ket ammona ti Espaniol.

source: Translate this sentence from eng to ilo: However, most signs are indicated only in Catalan because it is established by law as the first official language.
target: Ngem kaadduan kadagiti karatula ket nakasurat ti Catalan gapu ta isu daytoy ti naipasdek iti linteg nga umuna nga opisial a pagsasao.

source: Translate this sentence from eng to ilo: Yet, Spanish is also widely used in public transport and other facilities.
target: Ngem, ti Espaniol met ket nalawa ti pannakausarna iti pangpubliko a biahe ken sabali pay a pasilidad.

source: Translate this sentence from eng to ilo: Regular announcements in the Metro are made only in Catalan, but unplanned disruptions are announced by an automated system in a wide variety of languages including Spanish, English, French, Arabic and Japanese.
target: Ti regular a pammakdaar idiay Metro ket maaramid laeng idiay Catalan, ngem saan a naplano a panagsardeng ket ipakdaar ti sistema nga awtomatiko ti adu a nadumaduma a pagsasao agraman ti Espaniol, Ingles, Pranses, Arabiko ken Hapon.

source: Translate this sentence from eng to ilo: Parisians have a reputation for being egocentric, rude and arrogant.
target: Dagiti taga-Paris ket adda reputasionda a bagida laeng ti pampanunotenda, bastos ken napangas.

source: Translate this sentence from eng to ilo: While this is often only an inaccurate stereotype, the best way to get along in Paris still is to be on your best behavior, acting like someone who is "bien élevé" (well brought up). It will make getting about considerably easier.
target: Uray pay daytoy ket kaaduanna ket saan nga umno, ti kasayaatan latta tapno agtalinaedka iti Paris ket ti latta panagsingsingpetmo, agbalinka a kasla maysa a “bien élevé” (nasayaat a dimmakkel). Palakaenna ti pannakikaduam.

source: Translate this sentence from eng to ilo: Parisians' abrupt exteriors will rapidly evaporate if you display some basic courtesies.
target: Mapukaw a dagus dagiti di mapakpakadaan a galad dagiti Parisian no ipakitam ti sumagmamano a kangrunaan a panagdayaw.

source: Translate this sentence from eng to ilo: The Plitvice Lakes national park is heavily forested, mainly with beech, spruce, and fir trees, and features a mixture of Alpine and Mediterranean vegetation.
target: Ti nasional a parke ti Plitvice Lakes ket naraber ti kakaykaywanna, nangruna dagiti beech, scpruce, ken kayo ti fir, ken mangipakpakita ti naglaok a biag ti Alpine ken Mediterranean.

source: Translate this sentence from eng to ilo: It has a notably wide variety of plant communities, due to its range of microclimates, differing soils and varying levels of altitude.
target: Addaan daytoy ti nalawa a panagduduma ti komunitad ti mulmula, gapu iti sakup ti klima, agsasabali a daga ken nadumaduma a tukad ti kinangato.

source: Translate this sentence from eng to ilo: The area is also home to an extremely wide variety of animal and bird species.
target: Ti lugar ket pagtaltalinaedan met ti nadumaduma a klase ti ayup ken klase ti tumaytayab.

source: Translate this sentence from eng to ilo: Rare fauna such as the European brown bear, wolf, eagle, owl, lynx, wild cat and capercaillie can be found there, along with many more common species
target: Dagiti narasay nga ayup a kas kadagiti maradaga nga oso ti Europeo, lobo, agila, puwek, lynx, barang a pusa ken capercaillie ket makita sadiay, kadua pay ti adu a sapasap a klase.

source: Translate this sentence from eng to ilo: While visiting the monasteries, women are required to wear skirts covering the knees and have their shoulders covered, too.
target: Bayat ti panagpasiar kadagiti monasterio, dagiti babbai ket masapul nga agpalda a makalkaluban dagiti tumengda ken dagiti takyagda ket makaluban met.

source: Translate this sentence from eng to ilo: Most of the monasteries do provide wraps for women who come unprepared, but if you bring your own, especially one with bright colors, you'll get a smile from the monk or nun at the entrance.
target: Kaaduan kadagiti monasterio ti mangted iti pagkagay kadagiti babbai nga immay a saan a nakasagana, ngem no nangitugotka ti bukodmo, aglalo no natingra dagiti marisna, isemannaka kadagiti monghe wenno madre iti pagserrekan.

source: Translate this sentence from eng to ilo: Along the same line, men are required to wear trousers covering the knees.
target: Iti parehas a linia, kasapulan para kadagiti lalaki a mangibado ti pantalon a malingdanna ti tumeng.

source: Translate this sentence from eng to ilo: This too can be borrowed from the stock at the entrance but that clothing isn't washed after every user so you may not feel comfortable wearing these skirts. One size fits all for men!
