target: Daytoy met ket mabalin a buloden aggapu iti magun-odan idiay pagserrekan ngem dayta a kawes ket saan a nalabaan kalpasan a mausar isu a mabalin a saanka a komportable a mangisuot kadagita a palda. Maysa a kadakkel ket mabalin iti amin!

source: Translate this sentence from eng to ilo: Majorcan cuisine, like that of similar zones in the Mediterranean, is based on bread, vegetables and meat (specially pork), and uses olive oil throughout.
target: Dagiti makmakan a Majorcan, kas kadagidiay kapadana a sona ti Mediterranean, ket nakabase iti tinapay, nateng ken karne (kangrunaanna karne ti baboy), ken agus-usar amin ti lana ti olibo.

source: Translate this sentence from eng to ilo: A simple popular dinner, especially during the summer, is the Pa amb Oli: Bread with olive oil, tomato, and any available condiments such as cheese, tunafish, etc.
target: Maysa a simple a nalatak a pangrabii, aglalo iti kalgaw, ti Pa amb Oli: Tinapay nga addaan iti olive oil, kamatis, ken ania man nga adda a rekado a kas iti keso, ikan a tuna, ken dadduma pay.

source: Translate this sentence from eng to ilo: All nouns, alongside the word Sie for you, always begin with a capital letter, even in the middle of a sentence.
target: Amin a nombre, kadua dagita sao ni Sie para kenka, ket kanayon nga umuna ti dakkel a letra, uray no adda sadiay tengngana ti keddeng.

source: Translate this sentence from eng to ilo: This is an important way to distinguish between some verbs and objects.
target: Daytoy ket maysa a nangruna a wagas tapno mailasin ti baet ti mano a berbo ken bambanag.

source: Translate this sentence from eng to ilo: It also arguably makes reading easier, though writing is somewhat complicated by the need to find out whether a verb or adjective is used in a substantivized form.
target: Maibaga a nalaka ti panagbasa, ngem ti panagsurat adda met pagkakomplikadona gapu ta masapul a maammuam no ti verb wenno adjective ket mausar iti pormanana substantivized.

source: Translate this sentence from eng to ilo: Pronunciation is relatively easy in Italian since most words are pronounced exactly how they are written
target: Ti panagbalikas ket relatibo a nalaka iti Italiano gapu ta ti adu a sarita ket mabalikas nga eksakto no kasanoda maisurat.

source: Translate this sentence from eng to ilo: The main letters to watch out for are c and g, since their pronunciation varies based on the following vowel.
target: Iti kangrunaan a letra a kitaem ket c ken g, gapu ta ti panangbalikasda ket agduduma bayat ti sumaruno a patinig.

source: Translate this sentence from eng to ilo: Also, make sure to pronounce r and rr differently: caro means dear, whereas carro means chariot.
target: Kasta met, siguraduem a balikasen ti r ken rr nga agsabali: kayatna sawen ti caro ket ayatko, no ti kayatna sawen ti carro ket kalesa.

source: Translate this sentence from eng to ilo: Persian has a relatively easy and mostly regular grammar.
target: Ti Persian ket addaan ti nalaka ken simple a grammar.

source: Translate this sentence from eng to ilo: Therefore, reading this grammar primer would help you learn much about Persian grammar and understand phrases better.
target: Ngarud, ti panangbasa iti daytoy a primer ti grammar ket makatulong kenka a mangsursuro a nalaing iti grammar ti Persian ken tapno maawatam a nasayaat dagiti prase.

source: Translate this sentence from eng to ilo: Needless to say, if you know a Romance language, it will be easier for you to learn Portuguese.
target: Saanen a rumbeng nga ibaga, no ammom ti lengguahe ti Romansa, nalaklakam a maadal ti Portuguese.

source: Translate this sentence from eng to ilo: However, people who know a little Spanish may hastily conclude that Portuguese is close enough that it need not be studied separately.
target: Ngem dagiti tattao a makaammo ti bassit nga Espaniol ket mabalin a nalakada a maibaga a ti Portuges ket asideg a kapadana isu a saanen kasapulan ti maisina a panangadal kadagitoy.

source: Translate this sentence from eng to ilo: Pre-modern observatories are usually obsolete today, and remain as museums, or sites of education.
target: Gagangay a saan itan a maus-usar dagiti obserbatorio idi sakbay ti moderno a panawen, ket nagtalinaed lattan dagitoy a kas museo, wenno luglugar a pagadalan.

source: Translate this sentence from eng to ilo: As light pollution in their heyday was not the kind of problem it is today, they are usually located in cities or at campuses, easier to reach than those built in modern times.
target: Gapu ta iti nalag-an a polusion idi panawenda ket saan a ti tipo iti problema a kas itatta, gagangay a mabirukan isuda kadagiti siudad ken kampus, nadardaras a matawagan ngem dagiti naaramid idi moderno a panawen.

source: Translate this sentence from eng to ilo: Most modern research telescopes are enormous facilities in remote areas with favorable atmospheric conditions.
target: Kaaduan dagiti moderno a teleskopio a pangsarsarak ket dadakkel a pasilidad iti nasulimek a lugar a nawada ti kundision ti atmospera.

source: Translate this sentence from eng to ilo: Cherry blossom viewing, known as hanami, has been a part of Japanese culture since the 8th century.
target: Ti panagbuya iti cherry blossom, maaw-awagan a hanami, ket nagbalin a parte ti kultura ti Hapon sipud pay idi maika-8 a siglo.

source: Translate this sentence from eng to ilo: The concept came from China where plum blossoms were the flower of choice.
target: Ti konsepto ket naggapu iti Tsina no sadino a napili ket ti plum blossom a sabong.

source: Translate this sentence from eng to ilo: In Japan, the first cherry blossom parties were hosted by the emperor only for himself and other members of the aristocracy around the Imperial Court.
target: Idiay Japan, dagiti pagraragsak para ti umuna a cherry blossom ket i-host ti emperador para laeng iti bagbagina ken dadduma a miyembro iti aristokrasia iti aglawlaw ti Imperial a Korte.

source: Translate this sentence from eng to ilo: Plants look their best when in a natural environment, so resist the temptation to remove even "just one" specimen.
target: Makita iti kinasayaat dagiti mulmula no addaanda ti natural nga aglawlaw, isu a lappedam dayta pannakasulisog nga ikkaten duray pay “maysa laeng” a kita.

source: Translate this sentence from eng to ilo: If visiting a formally arranged garden, collecting "specimens" is also going to get you ejected, without discussion.
target: No bumisita ti pormal a naurnos a hardin, ti panagkolekta kadagiti “ispesimen” ket mabalin a mangpapanaw kenka, nga awan pagpapatanganen.

source: Translate this sentence from eng to ilo: Singapore is generally an extremely safe place to be and very easy to navigate, and you can buy almost anything after arriving.
target: Ti Singapore ket gagangay a nakaro a natalged a disso a papanan ken nalaka a ballasiwen, ken mabalinmo magatang ti dadani amin malpasmo a sumangpet.

source: Translate this sentence from eng to ilo: But being placed in the "high tropics" just a few degrees north of equator you will need to deal with both heat (always) and strong sun (when the sky is clear, more rarely).
target: Ngem ti pannakaipan iti “nangato a tropiko” a no mano laeng a digri iti amianan ti ekuador, masapul ti pannakasanaymo iti agpada a pudot (kanayon) ken napigsa nga init (no nalayang ti tangatang, nga ad-adda a manmano).

source: Translate this sentence from eng to ilo: There are also a few buses going north to Hebron, the traditional burial place of the Biblical patriarchs Abraham, Isaac, Jacob, and their wives.
target: Adda met ti mano a bus nga agturong iti amianan a mapan iti Hebron, iti tradisional a lugar a nakapunpunan dagiti Biblikal nga amma nga isuda Abraham, Isaac, Jacob ken dagiti assawada.

source: Translate this sentence from eng to ilo: Check that the bus you are thinking of taking goes into Hebron and not just to the nearby Jewish settlement of Kiryat Arba.
target: Kitaem ti bus a mapanpanunotmo a pagluganan no mapan iti Hebron ken saan laeng nga idiay asideg a pagtalinaedan dagiti Hudio idiay Kiryat Arba.

source: Translate this sentence from eng to ilo: Inland waterways can be a good theme to base a holiday around.
target: Dagiti dalan ti danum iti uneg ti daga ket nasayaat a tema a maibase iti holiday.

source: Translate this sentence from eng to ilo: For example visiting castles in the Loire Valley, the Rhine valley or taking a cruise to interesting cites on the Danube or boating along the Erie Canal.
target: Kas pagarigan ti panagbisita kadagiti kastilyo iti Loire Valley, iti Rhine Valley wenno panaglugan iti barko a mapan iti makapainteres a lugar idiay Danube wenno panagbangka idiay Erie Canal.

source: Translate this sentence from eng to ilo: They also define routes for popular hiking and cycling trails.
target: Depinarenda met ti ruta para iti nalatak a pagnaan ken pagbisikletaan a dalan.

topic: Reason to travel/Christmas and New Year
source: Translate this sentence from eng to ilo: Christmas is one of the most important holidays of Christianity, and is celebrated as the birthday of Jesus.
target: Ti Christmas ti maysa kadagiti napapateg nga okasion iti sangka-Kristianuan, ket matagiragsak daytoy kas pannakaiyanak ni Hesus.

topic: Reason to travel/Christmas and New Year
source: Translate this sentence from eng to ilo: Many of the traditions surrounding the holiday have been adopted also by non-believers in Christian countries and non-Christians around the world.
target: Adu kadagiti tradision a maar-aramid iti piesta ti inusar met dagiti saan a mamati a tattao nga adda kadagiti Kristiano a pagilian ken dagiti saan a Kristiano iti entero a lubong.

source: Translate this sentence from eng to ilo: There's a tradition to pass the Easter night awake at some exposed point to see the sunrise.
target: Addaan ti tradision a palabasen ti rabii ti Easter a siririing tapno makita ti panagruar ti init.

source: Translate this sentence from eng to ilo: There are of course Christian theological explanations for this tradition, but it may well be a pre-Christian Spring and Fertility ritual.
target: Adda dagiti teolohikal a palawag ti Kristiano para iti daytoy a tradision, ngem mabalin met a daytoy ket ritual a sakbay pay ti Kristianismo ti Panagungar ken Panagsikog.

source: Translate this sentence from eng to ilo: More traditional churches often hold an Easter Vigil on Saturday night during the Easter weekend, with the congregations often breaking into celebration at the stroke of midnight to celebrate Christ's resurrection.
target: Ad-adu pay a tradisional a simbaan ti mangiyusuat ti Panagkararag ti Semana iti rabii ti Sabado kabayatan ti Semana santa, nga adda dagiti kongregasion nga agselebrar iti tengnga rabii ti panagungar ni Kristo.

source: Translate this sentence from eng to ilo: All animals that originally arrived in the islands came here either by swimming, flying or floating.
target: Amin nga ayup a sigud a dimteng kadagiti isla, immayda babaen ti panaglangoy, panagtayab, wenno panagtapaw.

source: Translate this sentence from eng to ilo: Due to the long distance from the continent mammals were unable to make the journey making the giant tortoise the primary grazing animal in the Galapagos.
target: Gapu iti adayo a distansia manipud iti kontinente dagiti mamalya ket saan a nakaakar isu ti gapu a ti higante a tortoise ti kangrunaan nga animal a mangmangan ruot idiay Galapagos.

source: Translate this sentence from eng to ilo: Since the arrival of man to the Galapagos, many mammals have been introduced including goats, horses, cows, rats, cats and dogs.
target: Sipud idi simmangpet ti tao idiay Galapagos, adu a mamalia ti naiyam-ammo pakairamanan ti kalding, kabalio, baka, bao, pusa ken aso.

source: Translate this sentence from eng to ilo: If you visit the Arctic or Antarctic areas in the winter you will experience the polar night, which means that the sun doesn't rise above the horizon.
target: No bisitaem dagiti lugar idiay Arktika wenno Antarktika iti panawen ti lam-ek mapadasam ti rabii a polar, a kayatna sawen a saan nga umuli ti init iti ngato ti horizon.

source: Translate this sentence from eng to ilo: This offers a good opportunity to see the Aurora borealis, as the sky will be dark more or less around the clock.
target: Daytoy ket mangitukon ti nasayaat nga oportunidad a makita ti Aurora borealis, ta ti tangatang ket nasipsipnget dandani amin nga oras.

source: Translate this sentence from eng to ilo: As the areas are sparsely populated, and light pollution therefore often not a problem, you will also be able to enjoy the stars.
target: Gapu ta ti lugar ket saan unay a natao, ket ngarud saan a masansan a parikut ti polusion ti lawag, mabalinmo pay ragsaken a buyaen dagiti bituen.

source: Translate this sentence from eng to ilo: Japanese work culture is more hierarchical and formal that what Westerners may be used to.
target: Ad-adda a hierarchical ken formal ti kultura ti panagtrabaho dagiti Hapones ngem iti naikairuaman dagiti Taga-Laud.

source: Translate this sentence from eng to ilo: Suits are standard business attire, and coworkers call each other by their family names or by job titles.
